metadata.title: LearningO - Science / Listen
metadata.subject: Science
metadata.generated_for: Children with dyslexia and other learning differences, approx. ages 5-10
design_principles: Every question is answerable purely by ear - science facts, riddles, and stories are all spoken, not printed.
Content spans life science, physical science, and earth science, giving broad early exposure across all three strands.
Wrong options are never random. Each one names a specific, common science misconception or a plausible-but-wrong distractor.
Three difficulty bands rotate inside every type: easy for fluency, medium for the learning edge, happy for pure joy.
Safety rules and food-safety reasoning are treated as real science content, not just etiquette, and weighted accordingly.
Feedback praises the process, never the child's intelligence.
Higher-level types (multi-select, cause-effect, inference) build directly toward the reasoning skills real science later demands.
Safety, honesty and help-seeking items carry a mastery_weight above 1.0 so they surface in reports even when accuracy overall is high.

tts_guidance.note: Read audio_text exactly as written when read-aloud support is used. For sequence and multi-select items, pause 500ms between listed items.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: connecting a heard word to a known living thing or object
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Baseline science vocabulary check, isolated from reading.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: selecting an image that matches a simple spoken science statement
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Basic fact-to-image matching, a stepping stone into all later fact-based science questions.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: checking a spoken statement against known science facts
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Confirms the child listens to a full claim and evaluates it, not just reacts to a keyword.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: mapping a described sound to its real-world source
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Connects auditory discrimination (a core dyslexia-relevant skill) directly to science content.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: holding multiple descriptive clues in mind and reasoning to a single answer
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Riddle-style reasoning builds inference skill using content the child already half-knows, lowering the barrier to genuine reasoning practice.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: applying the living/non-living rule to a heard example
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: One of the most foundational life-science classifications, tested here in its purest form.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: mapping a described sense or function to its body part
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Body awareness is both a science topic and a genuinely useful self-knowledge skill.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: mapping a spoken weather or season description to the correct term or image
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Weather and seasons are observable, recurring science content that connects directly to daily planning.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: holding several spoken steps in mind and ordering them correctly
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Science processes (growth, life cycles, water cycle) are inherently sequential - this tests that structure directly.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: holding a category rule in mind while checking several options against it
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Multi-select tasks are more demanding than single-answer ones - every option must be actively evaluated.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: reasoning from a stated cause to its most likely effect
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Cause-and-effect reasoning is the seed of all later scientific prediction and experimentation.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: following and reasoning about a described simple investigation
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Introduces the idea of testing a question systematically, the core of scientific thinking.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: selecting the safe response to a described hazard or situation
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Directly practical science content - safety rules children need to internalise, not just recall.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: holding three spoken items in mind and identifying which breaks a shared pattern
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Odd-one-out is a demanding classification task - the rule must be inferred, not just applied.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: combining spoken facts to draw a conclusion not directly stated
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: The ceiling task of the module - genuine scientific inference from given information, not just fact recall.

difficulty_band.easy: Consolidation. Child should succeed ~90% of the time. Builds fluency and confidence.
difficulty_band.medium: Learning edge. Target ~65-75% success. This is where growth data lives.
difficulty_band.happy: Pure joy question. Near-certain success, silly or warm content, low mastery weight. Placed to reset mood after effort and to keep the session feeling like play.

reporting_recipes.skill_profile: Group accuracy by academic.skill and cognition.process to find the child's cognitive shape (e.g. strong discriminate / weak sequence).
reporting_recipes.life_skill_radar: Group accuracy by life_skill.domain across all subjects to build a 14-spoke life-skill radar chart per child.
reporting_recipes.dyslexia_error_map: Count wrong answers by distractor_insight value, not just by question. The distractor tells you WHY, so one wrong tap becomes a diagnosis.
reporting_recipes.attention_curve: Plot time_to_first_touch and accuracy against telemetry.session_position to find the child's real attention span, then cap session length there.
reporting_recipes.working_memory_ceiling: Accuracy vs cognition.working_memory_load. The load level where accuracy drops below 60% is the child's current WM ceiling - never exceed it during teaching.
reporting_recipes.confidence_calibration: Compare the wellbeing.confidence_prompt answer with actual correctness. Confident+wrong = misconception to correct. Unsure+right = needs reassurance, not more teaching.
reporting_recipes.impulsivity_index: Wrong answers where time_to_first_touch < 25% of expected_response_time_ms. High index means teach 'wait and think', not more content.
reporting_recipes.persistence_index: Retry rate and abandon rate on medium-band items. Falling persistence over weeks is an early wellbeing flag.
reporting_recipes.mood_trend: Track emotion_checkin responses over sessions. Two sad check-ins in a row should lower difficulty automatically for the next session.
reporting_recipes.personality_map: Aggregate personality_signal outcomes to describe tendencies (e.g. cautious, highly pro-social, low help-seeking) for the parent report.

wellbeing_rules: No question ever shows a countdown clock. Speed is rewarded, never punished.
Feedback praises the process ('you listened right to the end'), never the child's intelligence.
After two wrong answers the app shows how it works instead of asking again.
A happy-band question follows any run of three errors.
Every safety and help-seeking question points the child towards a trusted grown-up.

questions.audio_text: butterfly
hints: Picture something with colourful wings.
questions.worked_example: Listen for the word. Picture it in your mind before you look at the choices.

feedback.correct: Butterfly. Correctly matched. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: Picture what was described before choosing.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: mapping a spoken science word to its image

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Noticing small creatures around you is where real curiosity starts.

analysis.primary_construct: connecting a heard word to a known living thing or object
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Baseline science vocabulary check, isolated from reading.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Picking a same-category item (another animal, another plant) rather than a random one shows partial word recognition, worth noting.
analysis.parent_note: This confirms real-world science words are landing, not just being half-recognised.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Name things aloud together during any outdoor walk or nature moment.

analysis.primary_construct: checking a spoken statement against known science facts

feedback.correct: Vrai. La chaleur fait fondre la glace en eau. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Pense à ce qui arrive à la glace par une journée chaude.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute. Isso é verdade?
pt.audio_text: Se você deixar gelo no sol, ele vai derreter.
hints: O que acontece com o gelo quando ele esquenta?
pt.worked_example: Pense no que você já sabe. A afirmação combina com isso?

feedback.correct: Verdade. O calor derrete o gelo e o transforma em água. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Pense no que acontece com o gelo num dia quente.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. È vero?
it.audio_text: Se lasci del ghiaccio al sole, si scioglierà.
hints: Cosa succede al ghiaccio quando si scalda?
it.worked_example: Pensa a quello che già sai. Corrisponde alla frase?

feedback.correct: Vero. Il calore trasforma il ghiaccio in acqua. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a cosa succede al ghiaccio in una giornata calda.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Ist das wahr?
de.audio_text: Wenn du Eis in die Sonne legst, schmilzt es.
hints: Was passiert mit Eis, wenn es warm wird?
de.worked_example: Denk an das, was du schon weißt. Passt die Aussage dazu?

feedback.correct: Wahr. Wärme lässt Eis zu Wasser schmelzen. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Denk daran, was mit Eis an einem warmen Tag passiert.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Is het waar?
nl.audio_text: Als je ijs in de zon laat liggen, zal het smelten.
hints: Wat gebeurt er met ijs als het warm wordt?
nl.worked_example: Denk aan wat je al weet. Komt de uitspraak daarmee overeen?

feedback.correct: Waar. Warmte smelt ijs tot water. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan wat er met ijs gebeurt op een warme dag.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: Если оставить лёд на солнце, он растает.
hints: Что происходит с льдом, когда становится тепло?
ru.worked_example: Подумай о том, что ты уже знаешь. Совпадает ли утверждение с этим?

feedback.correct: Правда. Тепло превращает лёд в воду. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Подумай, что происходит с льдом в тёплый день.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Buzu güneşte bırakırsan erir.
hints: Buz ısındığında ne olur?
tr.worked_example: Zaten bildiklerini düşün. İfade onlarla uyuşuyor mu?

feedback.correct: Doğru. Sıcaklık buzu eritip suya dönüştürür. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Sıcak bir günde buza ne olduğunu düşün.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.audio_text: 如果把冰放在太阳下,它会融化。
hints: 冰变暖时会发生什么?
zh.worked_example: 想一想你已经知道的东西。这句话符合吗?

feedback.correct: 对。温暖会把冰融化成水。🧊
feedback.incorrect: 想一想在温暖的日子里冰会发生什么。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。これは本当かな?
ja.audio_text: 氷を太陽の下に置いておくと、溶ける。
hints: 氷が温まるとどうなる?
ja.worked_example: もう知っていることを考えよう。その内容は合っている?

feedback.correct: 正しい。暖かさで氷は溶けて水になる。🧊
feedback.incorrect: 暖かい日に氷がどうなるか考えよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 얼음을 햇빛 아래에 두면 녹을 거예요.
hints: 얼음이 따뜻해지면 어떻게 되나요?
ko.worked_example: 이미 알고 있는 것을 생각해 보세요. 그 말이 그것과 맞나요?

feedback.correct: 맞아요. 따뜻함은 얼음을 물로 녹여요. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: 따뜻한 날에 얼음이 어떻게 되는지 생각해 보세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Jika kamu meninggalkan es di bawah sinar matahari, es itu akan mencair.
hints: Apa yang terjadi pada es saat menjadi hangat?
id.worked_example: Pikirkan apa yang sudah kamu ketahui. Apakah pernyataan itu sesuai?

feedback.correct: Benar. Kehangatan mencairkan es menjadi air. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan apa yang terjadi pada es di hari yang hangat.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe. Điều này có đúng không?
vi.audio_text: Nếu bạn để đá ngoài nắng, nó sẽ tan.
hints: Điều gì xảy ra với đá khi nó ấm lên?
vi.worked_example: Nghĩ về điều bạn đã biết. Câu nói này có khớp với điều đó không?

feedback.correct: Đúng. Hơi ấm làm đá tan thành nước. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ về điều xảy ra với đá vào một ngày ấm.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.audio_text: All animals lay eggs.

distractor_insight.✅ Yes: overgeneralised a fact that's only true for some animals

hints: Do dogs and cats lay eggs, or are they born differently?
questions.worked_example: Think about what you already know. Does the statement match it?

feedback.correct: False. Not all animals lay eggs - some, like dogs, are born live. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Think about a dog or cat - do they come from an egg?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: verifying a simple spoken science fact

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Birds, fish, and reptiles lay eggs, but mammals like dogs are born live.

analysis.primary_construct: checking a spoken statement against known science facts
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Confirms the child listens to a full claim and evaluates it, not just reacts to a keyword.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Fast wrong answers regardless of content suggest guessing without processing the full statement.
analysis.parent_note: Checking a claim before accepting it is a habit worth building early, in science and everywhere else.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask 'how do you know?' after any true or false answer, gently.

es.instruction: Escucha. ¿Es verdad?
es.audio_text: Todos los animales ponen huevos.
hints: ¿Los perros y los gatos ponen huevos, o nacen de otra forma?
es.worked_example: Piensa en lo que ya sabes. ¿Coincide la afirmación con eso?

feedback.correct: Falso. No todos los animales ponen huevos - algunos, como los perros, nacen vivos. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en un perro o un gato - ¿vienen de un huevo?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute. Est-ce vrai ?
fr.audio_text: Tous les animaux pondent des œufs.
hints: Les chiens et les chats pondent-ils des œufs, ou naissent-ils différemment ?
fr.worked_example: Pense à ce que tu sais déjà. L'affirmation correspond-elle ?

feedback.correct: Faux. Tous les animaux ne pondent pas des œufs - certains, comme les chiens, naissent directement. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Pense à un chien ou un chat - viennent-ils d'un œuf ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute. Isso é verdade?
pt.audio_text: Todos os animais põem ovos.
hints: Cães e gatos põem ovos, ou nascem de forma diferente?
pt.worked_example: Pense no que você já sabe. A afirmação combina com isso?

feedback.correct: Falso. Nem todos os animais põem ovos - alguns, como os cães, nascem vivos. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Pense num cão ou gato - eles vêm de um ovo?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. È vero?
it.audio_text: Tutti gli animali depongono le uova.
hints: I cani e i gatti depongono le uova, o nascono in modo diverso?
it.worked_example: Pensa a quello che già sai. Corrisponde alla frase?

feedback.correct: Falso. Non tutti gli animali depongono le uova - alcuni, come i cani, nascono direttamente vivi. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a un cane o un gatto - nascono da un uovo?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Ist das wahr?
de.audio_text: Alle Tiere legen Eier.
hints: Legen Hunde und Katzen Eier, oder kommen sie anders zur Welt?
de.worked_example: Denk an das, was du schon weißt. Passt die Aussage dazu?

feedback.correct: Falsch. Nicht alle Tiere legen Eier – manche, wie Hunde, werden lebend geboren. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Denk an einen Hund oder eine Katze – kommen sie aus einem Ei?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Is het waar?
nl.audio_text: Alle dieren leggen eieren.
hints: Leggen honden en katten eieren, of worden ze anders geboren?
nl.worked_example: Denk aan wat je al weet. Komt de uitspraak daarmee overeen?

feedback.correct: Niet waar. Niet alle dieren leggen eieren - sommige, zoals honden, worden levend geboren. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan een hond of kat - komen ze uit een ei?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: Все животные откладывают яйца.
hints: Собаки и кошки откладывают яйца, или они рождаются по-другому?
ru.worked_example: Подумай о том, что ты уже знаешь. Совпадает ли утверждение с этим?

feedback.correct: Неправда. Не все животные откладывают яйца — некоторые, например собаки, рождаются живыми. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Подумай о собаке или кошке — появляются ли они из яйца?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Tüm hayvanlar yumurtlar.
hints: Köpekler ve kediler yumurtlar mı, yoksa farklı şekilde mi doğarlar?
tr.worked_example: Zaten bildiklerini düşün. İfade onlarla uyuşuyor mu?

feedback.correct: Yanlış. Tüm hayvanlar yumurtlamaz - köpekler gibi bazıları canlı doğar. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Bir köpeği veya kediyi düşün - onlar yumurtadan mı çıkar?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.audio_text: 所有动物都会产卵。
hints: 狗和猫会产卵吗,还是以不同的方式出生?
zh.worked_example: 想一想你已经知道的东西。这句话符合吗?

feedback.correct: 错。不是所有动物都产卵——有些动物,比如狗,是直接生出来的。🐶
feedback.incorrect: 想一想狗或猫——它们是从卵里出来的吗?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。これは本当かな?
ja.audio_text: すべての動物は卵を産む。
hints: イヌやネコは卵を産む、それとも違う生まれ方をする?
ja.worked_example: もう知っていることを考えよう。その内容は合っている?

feedback.correct: 間違い。すべての動物が卵を産むわけではない - イヌのように、生きたまま生まれる動物もいる。🐶
feedback.incorrect: イヌやネコを考えよう - 卵から生まれる?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 모든 동물은 알을 낳아요.
hints: 강아지와 고양이는 알을 낳나요, 아니면 다르게 태어나나요?
ko.worked_example: 이미 알고 있는 것을 생각해 보세요. 그 말이 그것과 맞나요?

feedback.correct: 틀렸어요. 모든 동물이 알을 낳는 건 아니에요 - 강아지 같은 동물은 새끼로 태어나요. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: 강아지나 고양이를 생각해 보세요 - 그들은 알에서 나오나요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Semua hewan bertelur.
hints: Apakah anjing dan kucing bertelur, atau mereka lahir dengan cara lain?
id.worked_example: Pikirkan apa yang sudah kamu ketahui. Apakah pernyataan itu sesuai?

feedback.correct: Salah. Tidak semua hewan bertelur - sebagian, seperti anjing, lahir langsung. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan seekor anjing atau kucing - apakah mereka berasal dari telur?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe. Điều này có đúng không?
vi.audio_text: Tất cả các loài động vật đều đẻ trứng.
hints: Chó và mèo đẻ trứng, hay được sinh ra theo cách khác?
vi.worked_example: Nghĩ về điều bạn đã biết. Câu nói này có khớp với điều đó không?

feedback.correct: Sai. Không phải tất cả động vật đều đẻ trứng - một số, như chó, được sinh ra trực tiếp. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ về một con chó hoặc mèo - chúng có nở ra từ trứng không?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.audio_text: You need your eyes to hear sounds.
hints: Which body part do you actually use to hear?
questions.worked_example: Think about what you already know. Does the statement match it?

feedback.correct: False. You use your ears to hear, not your eyes. 👂
feedback.incorrect: Think about which body part actually detects sound.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: verifying a simple spoken science fact

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Each sense has its own special body part - ears for hearing, eyes for seeing.

analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask 'how do you know?' after any true or false answer, gently.

es.instruction: Escucha. ¿Es verdad?
es.audio_text: Necesitas los ojos para oír sonidos.
hints: ¿Qué parte del cuerpo usas realmente para oír?
es.worked_example: Piensa en lo que ya sabes. ¿Coincide la afirmación con eso?

feedback.correct: Falso. Usas los oídos para oír, no los ojos. 👂
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en qué parte del cuerpo detecta realmente el sonido.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute. Est-ce vrai ?
fr.audio_text: Tu as besoin de tes yeux pour entendre des sons.
hints: Quelle partie du corps utilises-tu vraiment pour entendre ?
fr.worked_example: Pense à ce que tu sais déjà. L'affirmation correspond-elle ?

feedback.correct: Faux. Tu utilises tes oreilles pour entendre, pas tes yeux. 👂
feedback.incorrect: Pense à quelle partie du corps détecte vraiment le son.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute. Isso é verdade?
pt.audio_text: Você precisa dos olhos para ouvir sons.
hints: Qual parte do corpo você realmente usa para ouvir?
pt.worked_example: Pense no que você já sabe. A afirmação combina com isso?

feedback.correct: Falso. Você usa os ouvidos para ouvir, não os olhos. 👂
feedback.incorrect: Pense em qual parte do corpo realmente detecta o som.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. È vero?
it.audio_text: Hai bisogno degli occhi per sentire i suoni.
hints: Quale parte del corpo usi davvero per sentire?
it.worked_example: Pensa a quello che già sai. Corrisponde alla frase?

feedback.correct: Falso. Usi le orecchie per sentire, non gli occhi. 👂
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a quale parte del corpo rileva davvero i suoni.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Ist das wahr?
de.audio_text: Du brauchst deine Augen, um Geräusche zu hören.
hints: Welchen Körperteil benutzt du tatsächlich zum Hören?
de.worked_example: Denk an das, was du schon weißt. Passt die Aussage dazu?

feedback.correct: Falsch. Du hörst mit deinen Ohren, nicht mit deinen Augen. 👂
feedback.incorrect: Denk daran, welcher Körperteil tatsächlich Geräusche wahrnimmt.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Is het waar?
nl.audio_text: Je hebt je ogen nodig om geluiden te horen.
hints: Welk lichaamsdeel gebruik je eigenlijk om te horen?
nl.worked_example: Denk aan wat je al weet. Komt de uitspraak daarmee overeen?

feedback.correct: Niet waar. Je gebruikt je oren om te horen, niet je ogen. 👂
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan welk lichaamsdeel geluid echt waarneemt.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: Тебе нужны глаза, чтобы слышать звуки.
hints: Какую часть тела ты на самом деле используешь, чтобы слышать?
ru.worked_example: Подумай о том, что ты уже знаешь. Совпадает ли утверждение с этим?

feedback.correct: Неправда. Ты слышишь ушами, а не глазами. 👂
feedback.incorrect: Подумай, какая часть тела на самом деле улавливает звук.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Sesleri duymak için gözlerine ihtiyacın vardır.
hints: Duymak için gerçekte hangi organını kullanırsın?
tr.worked_example: Zaten bildiklerini düşün. İfade onlarla uyuşuyor mu?

feedback.correct: Yanlış. Duymak için gözlerini değil, kulaklarını kullanırsın. 👂
feedback.incorrect: Sesi gerçekte hangi organın algıladığını düşün.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.audio_text: 你需要用眼睛来听声音。
hints: 你实际上是用身体的哪个部位听声音的?
zh.worked_example: 想一想你已经知道的东西。这句话符合吗?

feedback.correct: 错。你是用耳朵听声音的,不是用眼睛。👂
feedback.incorrect: 想一想身体的哪个部位实际上能感知声音。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。これは本当かな?
ja.audio_text: 音を聞くには目が必要だ。
hints: 実際に聞くために使う体の部分はどこ?
ja.worked_example: もう知っていることを考えよう。その内容は合っている?

feedback.correct: 間違い。聞くために使うのは目ではなく耳だ。👂
feedback.incorrect: 実際に音を感じ取る体の部分を考えよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 소리를 들으려면 눈이 필요해요.
hints: 소리를 들을 때 실제로 사용하는 신체 부위는 무엇인가요?
ko.worked_example: 이미 알고 있는 것을 생각해 보세요. 그 말이 그것과 맞나요?

feedback.correct: 틀렸어요. 소리는 눈이 아니라 귀로 들어요. 👂
feedback.incorrect: 소리를 실제로 감지하는 신체 부위가 무엇인지 생각해 보세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Kamu membutuhkan matamu untuk mendengar suara.
hints: Bagian tubuh mana yang sebenarnya kamu gunakan untuk mendengar?
id.worked_example: Pikirkan apa yang sudah kamu ketahui. Apakah pernyataan itu sesuai?

feedback.correct: Salah. Kamu menggunakan telingamu untuk mendengar, bukan matamu. 👂
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan bagian tubuh mana yang sebenarnya mendeteksi suara.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe. Điều này có đúng không?
vi.audio_text: Bạn cần mắt để nghe âm thanh.
hints: Bộ phận nào bạn thực sự dùng để nghe?
vi.worked_example: Nghĩ về điều bạn đã biết. Câu nói này có khớp với điều đó không?

feedback.correct: Sai. Bạn dùng tai để nghe, không phải mắt. 👂
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ về bộ phận nào thực sự phát hiện âm thanh.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.audio_text: Trees make oxygen that we breathe.
hints: What do trees give out that helps us breathe?
questions.worked_example: Think about what you already know. Does the statement match it?

feedback.correct: True. Trees make oxygen. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Think about what trees release into the air that helps us.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: verifying a simple spoken science fact

academic.skill: identifying a source from an environmental or animal sound

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Owls are mostly active at night, which is why we mostly hear them then.

analysis.primary_construct: mapping a described sound to its real-world source
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Connects auditory discrimination (a core dyslexia-relevant skill) directly to science content.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Picking a visually similar but sonically wrong source suggests the sound itself, not the concept, needs more listening practice.
analysis.parent_note: Careful listening to real sounds is both a science skill and a literacy-supporting skill at once.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Play a 'guess the sound' game together using everyday household or outdoor noises.

feedback.incorrect: Pense nas três pistas juntas - branca e inverno são as principais.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta gli indizi. Tocca la risposta.
it.audio_text: Sono freddo. Sono bianco. Cado dal cielo in inverno. Cosa sono?
hints: Aspetta tutti e tre gli indizi prima di decidere.
it.worked_example: Aspetta ogni indizio prima di decidere. Ognuno restringe di più la scelta.

feedback.correct: Neve. Tutti e tre gli indizi corrispondono. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a tutti e tre gli indizi insieme - bianco e inverno sono decisivi.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre die Hinweise. Tippe die Antwort.
de.audio_text: Ich bin kalt. Ich bin weiß. Ich falle im Winter vom Himmel. Was bin ich?
hints: Warte auf alle drei Hinweise, bevor du dich entscheidest.
de.worked_example: Warte auf jeden Hinweis, bevor du dich entscheidest. Jeder schränkt es weiter ein.

feedback.correct: Schnee. Alle drei Hinweise passen. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Denk an alle drei Hinweise zusammen – weiß und Winter sind entscheidend.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar de aanwijzingen. Tik op het antwoord.
nl.audio_text: Ik ben koud. Ik ben wit. Ik val in de winter uit de lucht. Wat ben ik?
hints: Wacht op alle drie de aanwijzingen voordat je beslist.
nl.worked_example: Wacht op elke aanwijzing voordat je beslist. Elke aanwijzing maakt het antwoord duidelijker.

feedback.correct: Sneeuw. Alle drie de aanwijzingen kwamen overeen. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan alle drie de aanwijzingen samen - wit en winter zijn de belangrijkste.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: Я холодный. Я белый. Я падаю с неба зимой. Что я?
hints: Дождись всех трёх подсказок, прежде чем решать.
ru.worked_example: Дождись каждой подсказки, прежде чем решать. Каждая сужает выбор ещё больше.

feedback.correct: Снег. Все три подсказки совпали. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Подумай обо всех трёх подсказках вместе — белый цвет и зима здесь главное.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Soğuğum. Beyazım. Kışın gökyüzünden düşerim. Ben neyim?
hints: Karar vermeden önce üç ipucunu da bekle.

feedback.correct: Kar. Üç ipucu da eşleşti. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Üç ipucunu birlikte düşün - beyaz ve kış anahtar ipuçları.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.audio_text: 我很冷。我是白色的。我在冬天从天上落下来。我是什么?
hints: 等三条提示都说完再做决定。
zh.worked_example: 等所有提示都说完再做决定。每一条都会进一步缩小范围。

feedback.correct: 雪。三条提示都对上了。❄️
feedback.incorrect: 把三条提示放在一起想——白色和冬天是关键。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: ヒントを聞こう。答えをタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: わたしは冷たい。白い。冬に空から降ってくる。わたしは何?
hints: 3つのヒントすべてを待ってから決めよう。
ja.worked_example: 決める前に、すべてのヒントを待とう。それぞれのヒントでさらに絞られていくよ。

feedback.correct: 雪。3つのヒントすべてに合っていたね。❄️
feedback.incorrect: 3つのヒントすべてを考えよう - 白いことと冬というのがカギになるよ。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 나는 차가워요. 나는 하얀색이에요. 나는 겨울에 하늘에서 내려요. 나는 무엇일까요?
hints: 결정하기 전에 세 가지 힌트를 모두 들어보세요.
ko.worked_example: 결정하기 전에 모든 힌트를 끝까지 들어보세요. 힌트마다 답이 점점 좁혀져요.

feedback.correct: 눈이에요. 세 가지 힌트가 모두 맞았어요. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: 세 가지 힌트를 모두 함께 생각해 보세요 - 하얀색과 겨울이 핵심이에요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Aku dingin. Aku berwarna putih. Aku turun dari langit saat musim dingin. Apakah aku?
hints: Tunggu ketiga petunjuknya sebelum memutuskan.
id.worked_example: Tunggu setiap petunjuk sebelum memutuskan. Setiap petunjuk semakin mempersempitnya.

feedback.correct: Salju. Ketiga petunjuk cocok. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan ketiga petunjuk bersamaan - putih dan musim dingin adalah kuncinya.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe các gợi ý. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.audio_text: Tôi lạnh. Tôi màu trắng. Tôi rơi từ trời vào mùa đông. Tôi là gì?
hints: Đợi nghe hết cả ba gợi ý trước khi quyết định.
vi.worked_example: Đợi từng gợi ý trước khi quyết định. Mỗi gợi ý thu hẹp dần đáp án.

feedback.correct: Tuyết. Cả ba gợi ý đều khớp. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ về cả ba gợi ý cùng lúc - màu trắng và mùa đông là chìa khóa.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen to the clues. Tap the answer.
questions.audio_text: I have wings. I am not a bird. I visit flowers. I have colourful patterns. What am I?

distractor_insight.🐦: has wings but IS a bird, contradicting one clue
distractor_insight.🐝: visits flowers but usually less colourful patterns

hints: Wait for all four clues before deciding - one clue rules out a bird.
questions.worked_example: Wait for every clue before deciding. Each one narrows it down further.

feedback.correct: A butterfly. All four clues matched. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: One clue says 'not a bird'. Which flying, colourful creature fits everything?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: combining several spoken clues to identify something

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Ruling out a plausible-but-wrong answer is a real reasoning skill.

analysis.primary_construct: holding multiple descriptive clues in mind and reasoning to a single answer
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Riddle-style reasoning builds inference skill using content the child already half-knows, lowering the barrier to genuine reasoning practice.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Answering after only the first clue, before all clues are given, shows impulsivity rather than a knowledge gap.
analysis.parent_note: This is real reasoning practice wrapped in a fun guessing game.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Make up simple 'I'm thinking of something that...' riddles together at home.

es.instruction: Escucha las pistas. Toca la respuesta.

feedback.incorrect: Una pista dice 'no soy un ave'. ¿Qué criatura voladora y colorida encaja con todo?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute les indices. Touche la réponse.

fr.worked_example: Attends chaque indice avant de décider. Chacun réduit un peu plus les possibilités.

feedback.correct: Un papillon. Les quatre indices correspondent. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: Un indice dit 'pas un oiseau'. Quelle créature volante et colorée correspond à tout ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.worked_example: Espere cada pista antes de decidir. Cada uma reduz mais as opções.

feedback.correct: Uma borboleta. As quatro pistas combinaram. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: Uma pista diz “não sou um pássaro”. Que criatura voadora e colorida combina com tudo?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta gli indizi. Tocca la risposta.

hints: Aspetta tutti e quattro gli indizi prima di decidere - uno esclude l'uccello.
it.worked_example: Aspetta ogni indizio prima di decidere. Ognuno restringe di più la scelta.

feedback.incorrect: Un indizio dice 'non è un uccello'. Quale creatura volante e colorata corrisponde a tutto?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre die Hinweise. Tippe die Antwort.

feedback.incorrect: Een aanwijzing zegt 'geen vogel'. Welk vliegend, kleurrijk wezen past bij alles?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: У меня есть крылья. Я не птица. Я посещаю цветы. У меня цветные узоры. Кто я?
hints: Дождись всех четырёх подсказок, прежде чем решать — одна из них исключает птицу.

feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

zh.audio_text: 我是圆的。我外面很硬。我里面有一只小鸡在长大。我是什么?
hints: 等三条提示都说完再做决定——里面有东西在长大。
zh.worked_example: 等所有提示都说完再做决定。每一条都会进一步缩小范围。

feedback.correct: 蛋。三条提示都对上了。🥚
feedback.incorrect: 把三条提示放在一起想——尤其是关于长大的那部分。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: ヒントを聞こう。答えをタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: わたしは丸い。外側は硬い。中でヒナが育っている。わたしは何?
hints: 決める前に3つのヒントすべてを待とう - 中で何かが育っているよ。
ja.worked_example: 決める前に、すべてのヒントを待とう。それぞれのヒントでさらに絞られていくよ。

feedback.correct: 卵。3つのヒントすべてに合っていたね。🥚
feedback.incorrect: 3つのヒントすべてを考えよう - 特に、育っている部分がカギだよ。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 나는 둥글어요. 나는 바깥쪽이 딱딱해요. 나는 안에서 병아리가 자라고 있어요. 나는 무엇일까요?
hints: 결정하기 전에 세 가지 힌트를 모두 들어보세요 - 안에서 무언가가 자라고 있어요.
ko.worked_example: 결정하기 전에 모든 힌트를 끝까지 들어보세요. 힌트마다 답이 점점 좁혀져요.

feedback.correct: 알이에요. 세 가지 힌트가 모두 맞았어요. 🥚
feedback.incorrect: 세 가지 힌트를 모두 생각해 보세요 - 특히 자라고 있다는 부분을 생각해 보세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Aku bulat. Aku keras di luar. Aku punya anak ayam yang tumbuh di dalam. Apakah aku?
hints: Tunggu ketiga petunjuknya sebelum memutuskan - ada sesuatu yang tumbuh di dalam.
id.worked_example: Tunggu setiap petunjuk sebelum memutuskan. Setiap petunjuk semakin mempersempitnya.

feedback.correct: Telur. Ketiga petunjuk cocok. 🥚
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan ketiga petunjuk - terutama bagian tentang tumbuh.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe các gợi ý. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.audio_text: Tôi hình tròn. Tôi cứng ở bên ngoài. Tôi có một chú gà con đang lớn bên trong. Tôi là gì?
hints: Đợi nghe hết cả ba gợi ý trước khi quyết định - có thứ gì đó đang lớn lên bên trong.
vi.worked_example: Đợi từng gợi ý trước khi quyết định. Mỗi gợi ý thu hẹp dần đáp án.

feedback.correct: Trứng. Cả ba gợi ý đều khớp. 🥚
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ về cả ba gợi ý - đặc biệt là phần nói về việc đang lớn lên.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen to the clues. Tap the answer.
questions.audio_text: I am tall. I have leaves. Birds build nests in me. What am I?

distractor_insight.🏠: shares tall category, but no leaves or bird nests
distractor_insight.🗼: shares tall category, but no leaves or bird nests

hints: Wait for all three clues before deciding.
questions.worked_example: Wait for every clue before deciding. Each one narrows it down further.

feedback.correct: A tree. All three clues matched. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Think about all three clues together - leaves and nests are key.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: combining several spoken clues to identify something

life_skill.hidden_lesson: A single tree can be home to dozens of different creatures.

analysis.primary_construct: holding multiple descriptive clues in mind and reasoning to a single answer
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Riddle-style reasoning builds inference skill using content the child already half-knows, lowering the barrier to genuine reasoning practice.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Answering after only the first clue, before all clues are given, shows impulsivity rather than a knowledge gap.
analysis.parent_note: This is real reasoning practice wrapped in a fun guessing game.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Make up simple 'I'm thinking of something that...' riddles together at home.

es.instruction: Escucha las pistas. Toca la respuesta.
es.audio_text: Soy alto. Tengo hojas. Las aves hacen nidos en mí. ¿Qué soy?
hints: Espera las tres pistas antes de decidir.
es.worked_example: Espera cada pista antes de decidir. Cada una va reduciendo las opciones.

feedback.correct: Un árbol. Las tres pistas coinciden. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en las tres pistas juntas - las hojas y los nidos son la clave.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute les indices. Touche la réponse.
fr.audio_text: Je suis grand. J'ai des feuilles. Les oiseaux font leur nid en moi. Qui suis-je ?
hints: Attends les trois indices avant de décider.
fr.worked_example: Attends chaque indice avant de décider. Chacun réduit un peu plus les possibilités.

feedback.correct: Un arbre. Les trois indices correspondent. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Réfléchis aux trois indices ensemble - les feuilles et les nids sont la clé.
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute as pistas. Toque na resposta.
pt.audio_text: Eu sou alta. Eu tenho folhas. Os pássaros constroem ninhos em mim. O que sou eu?
hints: Espere todas as três pistas antes de decidir.
pt.worked_example: Espere cada pista antes de decidir. Cada uma reduz mais as opções.

feedback.correct: Uma árvore. As três pistas combinaram. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Pense nas três pistas juntas - folhas e ninhos são as principais.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta gli indizi. Tocca la risposta.
it.audio_text: Sono alto. Ho le foglie. Gli uccelli costruiscono nidi su di me. Cosa sono?
hints: Aspetta tutti e tre gli indizi prima di decidere.
it.worked_example: Aspetta ogni indizio prima di decidere. Ognuno restringe di più la scelta.

feedback.correct: Un albero. Tutti e tre gli indizi corrispondono. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a tutti e tre gli indizi insieme - le foglie e i nidi sono decisivi.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre die Hinweise. Tippe die Antwort.
de.audio_text: Ich bin groß. Ich habe Blätter. Vögel bauen Nester in mir. Was bin ich?
hints: Warte auf alle drei Hinweise, bevor du dich entscheidest.
de.worked_example: Warte auf jeden Hinweis, bevor du dich entscheidest. Jeder schränkt es weiter ein.

feedback.correct: Ein Baum. Alle drei Hinweise passen. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Denk an alle drei Hinweise zusammen – Blätter und Nester sind entscheidend.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar de aanwijzingen. Tik op het antwoord.
nl.audio_text: Ik ben hoog. Ik heb bladeren. Vogels bouwen nesten in mij. Wat ben ik?
hints: Wacht op alle drie de aanwijzingen voordat je beslist.
nl.worked_example: Wacht op elke aanwijzing voordat je beslist. Elke aanwijzing maakt het antwoord duidelijker.

feedback.correct: Een boom. Alle drie de aanwijzingen kwamen overeen. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan alle drie de aanwijzingen samen - bladeren en nesten zijn de belangrijkste.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: Я высокое. У меня есть листья. Птицы строят во мне гнёзда. Что я?
hints: Дождись всех трёх подсказок, прежде чем решать.
ru.worked_example: Дождись каждой подсказки, прежде чем решать. Каждая сужает выбор ещё больше.

feedback.correct: Дерево. Все три подсказки совпали. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Подумай обо всех трёх подсказках вместе — листья и гнёзда здесь главное.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Uzunum. Yapraklarım var. Kuşlar içimde yuva yapar. Ben neyim?
hints: Karar vermeden önce üç ipucunu da bekle.
tr.worked_example: Karar vermeden önce her ipucunu bekle. Her biri seçimi daha da daraltır.

feedback.correct: Bir ağaç. Üç ipucu da eşleşti. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Üç ipucunu birlikte düşün - yapraklar ve yuvalar anahtar.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.audio_text: 我很高。我有叶子。鸟会在我身上搭窝。我是什么?
hints: 等三条提示都说完再做决定。
zh.worked_example: 等所有提示都说完再做决定。每一条都会进一步缩小范围。

feedback.correct: 树。三条提示都对上了。🌳
feedback.incorrect: 把三条提示放在一起想——叶子和鸟窝是关键。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: ヒントを聞こう。答えをタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: わたしは高い。葉がある。鳥がわたしの中に巣を作る。わたしは何?
hints: 3つのヒントすべてを待ってから決めよう。
ja.worked_example: 決める前に、すべてのヒントを待とう。それぞれのヒントでさらに絞られていくよ。

feedback.correct: 木。3つのヒントすべてに合っていたね。🌳
feedback.incorrect: 3つのヒントすべてを考えよう - 葉と巣がカギになるよ。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 나는 키가 커요. 나는 잎이 있어요. 새들이 내 안에 둥지를 지어요. 나는 무엇일까요?
hints: 결정하기 전에 세 가지 힌트를 모두 들어보세요.
ko.worked_example: 결정하기 전에 모든 힌트를 끝까지 들어보세요. 힌트마다 답이 점점 좁혀져요.

feedback.correct: 나무예요. 세 가지 힌트가 모두 맞았어요. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: 세 가지 힌트를 모두 함께 생각해 보세요 - 잎과 둥지가 핵심이에요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Aku tinggi. Aku punya daun. Burung membangun sarang di diriku. Apakah aku?
hints: Tunggu ketiga petunjuknya sebelum memutuskan.
id.worked_example: Tunggu setiap petunjuk sebelum memutuskan. Setiap petunjuk semakin mempersempitnya.

feedback.correct: Pohon. Ketiga petunjuk cocok. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan ketiga petunjuk bersamaan - daun dan sarang adalah kuncinya.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe các gợi ý. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.audio_text: Tôi cao. Tôi có lá. Chim làm tổ trên tôi. Tôi là gì?
hints: Đợi nghe hết cả ba gợi ý trước khi quyết định.
vi.worked_example: Đợi từng gợi ý trước khi quyết định. Mỗi gợi ý thu hẹp dần đáp án.

feedback.correct: Cây. Cả ba gợi ý đều khớp. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ về cả ba gợi ý cùng lúc - lá cây và tổ chim là chìa khóa.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen to the clues. Tap the answer.
questions.audio_text: I start small and green. I never move on my own. I need sunlight and water. I might grow a flower one day. What am I?

distractor_insight.🐛: small but moves on its own, contradicting a clue
distractor_insight.🍄: doesn't need sunlight the same way, and rarely flowers

hints: Wait for all four clues - one clue is about never moving.
questions.worked_example: Wait for every clue before deciding. Each one narrows it down further.

feedback.correct: A plant or seedling. All four clues matched, including the tricky 'never moves' one. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: One clue rules out anything that moves on its own. What green thing needs light and water?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: combining several spoken clues to identify something

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Careful listening for every single clue, even a subtle one like 'never moves', is real detective thinking.

analysis.primary_construct: holding multiple descriptive clues in mind and reasoning to a single answer
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Riddle-style reasoning builds inference skill using content the child already half-knows, lowering the barrier to genuine reasoning practice.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Answering after only the first clue, before all clues are given, shows impulsivity rather than a knowledge gap.
analysis.parent_note: This is real reasoning practice wrapped in a fun guessing game.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Make up simple 'I'm thinking of something that...' riddles together at home.

es.instruction: Escucha las pistas. Toca la respuesta.
es.audio_text: Empiezo pequeño y verde. Nunca me muevo por mi cuenta. Necesito luz del sol y agua. Puede que algún día crezca una flor. ¿Qué soy?
hints: Espera las cuatro pistas - una pista habla de nunca moverse.
es.worked_example: Espera cada pista antes de decidir. Cada una va reduciendo las opciones.

feedback.correct: Una planta o plántula. Las cuatro pistas coinciden, incluyendo la truculenta 'nunca me muevo'. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Una pista descarta cualquier cosa que se mueva por sí misma. ¿Qué cosa verde necesita luz y agua?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute les indices. Touche la réponse.
fr.audio_text: Je commence petite et verte. Je ne me déplace jamais seule. J'ai besoin de soleil et d'eau. Je pourrais faire une fleur un jour. Qui suis-je ?
hints: Attends les quatre indices - un indice parle de ne jamais se déplacer.
fr.worked_example: Attends chaque indice avant de décider. Chacun réduit un peu plus les possibilités.

feedback.correct: Une plante ou une jeune pousse. Les quatre indices correspondent, y compris celui, délicat, de 'ne jamais se déplacer'. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Un indice exclut tout ce qui se déplace seul. Quelle chose verte a besoin de lumière et d'eau ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute as pistas. Toque na resposta.
pt.audio_text: Eu começo pequena e verde. Eu nunca me movo por conta própria. Eu preciso de luz do sol e água. Posso crescer uma flor um dia. O que sou eu?
hints: Espere todas as quatro pistas - uma pista é sobre nunca se mover.
pt.worked_example: Espere cada pista antes de decidir. Cada uma reduz mais as opções.

feedback.correct: Uma planta ou muda. As quatro pistas combinaram, incluindo a difícil “nunca se move”. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Uma pista elimina qualquer coisa que se mova por conta própria. Que coisa verde precisa de luz e água?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta gli indizi. Tocca la risposta.
it.audio_text: Inizio piccola e verde. Non mi muovo mai da sola. Ho bisogno di luce del sole e acqua. Potrei far crescere un fiore un giorno. Cosa sono?
hints: Aspetta tutti e quattro gli indizi - uno parla di non muoversi mai.
it.worked_example: Aspetta ogni indizio prima di decidere. Ognuno restringe di più la scelta.

feedback.correct: Una pianta o un germoglio. Tutti e quattro gli indizi corrispondono, incluso quello insidioso del 'non si muove mai'. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Un indizio esclude qualsiasi cosa che si muova da sola. Quale cosa verde ha bisogno di luce e acqua?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre die Hinweise. Tippe die Antwort.
de.audio_text: Ich beginne klein und grün. Ich bewege mich nie von selbst. Ich brauche Sonnenlicht und Wasser. Eines Tages wachse ich vielleicht eine Blüte. Was bin ich?
hints: Warte auf alle vier Hinweise – ein Hinweis handelt davon, sich niemals zu bewegen.
de.worked_example: Warte auf jeden Hinweis, bevor du dich entscheidest. Jeder schränkt es weiter ein.

feedback.correct: Eine Pflanze oder ein Keimling. Alle vier Hinweise passen, auch der knifflige Hinweis über das Nicht-Bewegen. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Ein Hinweis schließt alles aus, was sich von selbst bewegt. Welches grüne Ding braucht Licht und Wasser?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar de aanwijzingen. Tik op het antwoord.
nl.audio_text: Ik begin klein en groen. Ik beweeg nooit zelf. Ik heb zonlicht en water nodig. Ik kan ooit een bloem krijgen. Wat ben ik?
hints: Wacht op alle vier de aanwijzingen - één aanwijzing gaat over nooit bewegen.
nl.worked_example: Wacht op elke aanwijzing voordat je beslist. Elke aanwijzing maakt het antwoord duidelijker.

feedback.correct: Een plant of zaailing. Alle vier de aanwijzingen kwamen overeen, inclusief de lastige 'beweegt nooit'. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Een aanwijzing sluit alles uit dat zelf beweegt. Welk groen ding heeft licht en water nodig?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: Я начинаю маленьким и зелёным. Я никогда не двигаюсь сам. Мне нужны солнечный свет и вода. Однажды на мне может вырасти цветок. Что я?
hints: Дождись всех четырёх подсказок — одна из них о том, что я никогда не двигаюсь.
ru.worked_example: Дождись каждой подсказки, прежде чем решать. Каждая сужает выбор ещё больше.

feedback.correct: Растение или росток. Все четыре подсказки совпали, включая хитрую подсказку про то, что оно никогда не двигается. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Одна подсказка исключает всё, что двигается само. Какая зелёная вещь нуждается в свете и воде?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Küçük ve yeşil başlarım. Kendi başıma asla hareket etmem. Güneş ışığına ve suya ihtiyacım var. Bir gün bir çiçek açabilirim. Ben neyim?
hints: Dört ipucunu da bekle - bir ipucu asla hareket etmemekle ilgili.
tr.worked_example: Karar vermeden önce her ipucunu bekle. Her biri seçimi daha da daraltır.

feedback.correct: Bir bitki veya fide. Dört ipucu da eşleşti, zorlayıcı 'asla hareket etmeme' ipucu da dahil. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Bir ipucu, kendi başına hareket eden her şeyi eler. Işığa ve suya ihtiyacı olan yeşil şey nedir?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.audio_text: 我一开始又小又绿。我从不自己移动。我需要阳光和水。我有一天可能会开出花。我是什么?
hints: 等四条提示都说完——有一条提示是关于从不移动的。
zh.worked_example: 等所有提示都说完再做决定。每一条都会进一步缩小范围。

feedback.correct: 植物或幼苗。四条提示都对上了,包括"从不移动"这个有点刁钻的提示。🌱
feedback.incorrect: 有一条提示排除了任何能自己移动的东西。什么绿色的东西需要光和水?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: ヒントを聞こう。答えをタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: わたしは小さくて緑色から始まる。自分では決して動かない。太陽の光と水が必要だ。いつか花が咲くかもしれない。わたしは何?
hints: 4つのヒントすべてを待とう - 1つのヒントは決して動かないことについてだよ。
ja.worked_example: 決める前に、すべてのヒントを待とう。それぞれのヒントでさらに絞られていくよ。

feedback.correct: 植物(または苗)。「決して動かない」という難しいヒントも含めて、4つのヒントすべてに合っていたね。🌱
feedback.incorrect: 1つのヒントで、自分で動くものではないとわかる。光と水が必要な緑のものは何?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 나는 작고 초록색으로 시작해요. 나는 스스로 움직이지 않아요. 나는 햇빛과 물이 필요해요. 나는 언젠가 꽃을 피울 수도 있어요. 나는 무엇일까요?
hints: 네 가지 힌트를 모두 들어보세요 - 한 힌트는 절대 움직이지 않는다는 것이에요.
ko.worked_example: 결정하기 전에 모든 힌트를 끝까지 들어보세요. 힌트마다 답이 점점 좁혀져요.

feedback.correct: 식물(새싹)이에요. 까다로운 '절대 움직이지 않는다'는 힌트까지, 네 가지 힌트가 모두 맞았어요. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: 한 힌트는 스스로 움직이는 것은 아니라고 해요. 빛과 물이 필요한 초록색인 것은 무엇인가요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Aku mulai kecil dan hijau. Aku tidak pernah bergerak sendiri. Aku membutuhkan sinar matahari dan air. Aku mungkin akan tumbuh bunga suatu hari. Apakah aku?
hints: Tunggu keempat petunjuknya - satu petunjuk tentang tidak pernah bergerak.
id.worked_example: Tunggu setiap petunjuk sebelum memutuskan. Setiap petunjuk semakin mempersempitnya.

feedback.correct: Tumbuhan atau bibit. Keempat petunjuk cocok, termasuk petunjuk sulit 'tidak pernah bergerak'. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Satu petunjuk menyingkirkan apa pun yang bergerak sendiri. Benda hijau apa yang membutuhkan cahaya dan air?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe các gợi ý. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.audio_text: Tôi bắt đầu nhỏ và màu xanh. Tôi không bao giờ tự di chuyển. Tôi cần ánh sáng mặt trời và nước. Có thể một ngày tôi sẽ nở hoa. Tôi là gì?
hints: Đợi nghe hết cả bốn gợi ý - một gợi ý nói về việc không bao giờ di chuyển.
vi.worked_example: Đợi từng gợi ý trước khi quyết định. Mỗi gợi ý thu hẹp dần đáp án.

feedback.correct: Một cây hoặc cây non. Cả bốn gợi ý đều khớp, kể cả gợi ý khó 'không bao giờ di chuyển'. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Một gợi ý loại trừ bất cứ thứ gì tự di chuyển. Vật màu xanh nào cần ánh sáng và nước?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen to the clues. Tap the answer.
questions.audio_text: I am found deep underground. I am not alive. I formed over millions of years. Diamonds are one kind of me. What am I?

distractor_insight.💎: is one example given in the clue, but the answer is the broader category

hints: Wait for all four clues - the answer is the broader category, not just diamonds.
questions.worked_example: Wait for every clue before deciding. Each one narrows it down further.

feedback.correct: Rock (or mineral). All four clues matched, including the broader category. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Diamonds are one example given, but what's the bigger category being described?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: combining several spoken clues to identify something

life_skill.primary: Combining several clues to reason about a category
life_skill.hidden_lesson: Recognising that an example isn't the same as the whole category is advanced reasoning.

analysis.primary_construct: holding multiple descriptive clues in mind and reasoning to a single answer
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Riddle-style reasoning builds inference skill using content the child already half-knows, lowering the barrier to genuine reasoning practice.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Answering after only the first clue, before all clues are given, shows impulsivity rather than a knowledge gap.
analysis.parent_note: This is real reasoning practice wrapped in a fun guessing game.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Make up simple 'I'm thinking of something that...' riddles together at home.

es.instruction: Escucha las pistas. Toca la respuesta.
es.audio_text: Se me encuentra muy bajo tierra. No estoy viva. Me formé a lo largo de millones de años. Los diamantes son un tipo de mí. ¿Qué soy?
hints: Espera las cuatro pistas - la respuesta es la categoría más amplia, no solo los diamantes.
es.worked_example: Espera cada pista antes de decidir. Cada una va reduciendo las opciones.

feedback.correct: Roca (o mineral). Las cuatro pistas coinciden, incluyendo la categoría más amplia. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Los diamantes son un ejemplo dado, pero ¿cuál es la categoría más grande que se describe?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute les indices. Touche la réponse.
fr.audio_text: On me trouve loin sous terre. Je ne suis pas vivante. Je me suis formée en des millions d'années. Les diamants sont une de mes sortes. Qui suis-je ?
hints: Attends les quatre indices - la réponse est la catégorie plus large, pas seulement les diamants.
fr.worked_example: Attends chaque indice avant de décider. Chacun réduit un peu plus les possibilités.

feedback.correct: Roche (ou minéral). Les quatre indices correspondent, y compris la catégorie plus large. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Les diamants sont un exemple donné, mais quelle est la catégorie plus large décrite ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute as pistas. Toque na resposta.
pt.audio_text: Eu sou encontrada bem debaixo da terra. Eu não sou viva. Eu me formei ao longo de milhões de anos. Diamantes são um tipo de mim. O que sou eu?
hints: Espere todas as quatro pistas - a resposta é a categoria mais ampla, não só diamantes.
pt.worked_example: Espere cada pista antes de decidir. Cada uma reduz mais as opções.

feedback.correct: Rocha (ou mineral). As quatro pistas combinaram, incluindo a categoria mais ampla. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Diamantes são um exemplo dado, mas qual é a categoria maior sendo descrita?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta gli indizi. Tocca la risposta.
it.audio_text: Mi si trova in profondità sottoterra. Non sono vivo. Mi sono formato in milioni di anni. I diamanti sono un mio tipo. Cosa sono?
hints: Aspetta tutti e quattro gli indizi - la risposta è la categoria più ampia, non solo i diamanti.
it.worked_example: Aspetta ogni indizio prima di decidere. Ognuno restringe di più la scelta.

feedback.correct: Roccia (o minerale). Tutti e quattro gli indizi corrispondono, inclusa la categoria più ampia. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: I diamanti sono un esempio dato, ma qual è la categoria più grande descritta?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre die Hinweise. Tippe die Antwort.
de.audio_text: Ich befinde mich tief unter der Erde. Ich bin nicht lebend. Ich entstand über Millionen von Jahren. Diamanten sind eine Art von mir. Was bin ich?
hints: Warte auf alle vier Hinweise – die Antwort ist die größere Kategorie, nicht nur Diamanten.
de.worked_example: Warte auf jeden Hinweis, bevor du dich entscheidest. Jeder schränkt es weiter ein.

feedback.correct: Gestein (oder Mineral). Alle vier Hinweise passen, einschließlich der größeren Kategorie. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Diamanten sind nur ein genanntes Beispiel – welche größere Kategorie wird hier beschrieben?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar de aanwijzingen. Tik op het antwoord.
nl.audio_text: Ik word diep onder de grond gevonden. Ik ben niet levend. Ik ontstond over miljoenen jaren. Diamanten zijn een soort van mij. Wat ben ik?
hints: Wacht op alle vier de aanwijzingen - het antwoord is de bredere categorie, niet alleen diamanten.
nl.worked_example: Wacht op elke aanwijzing voordat je beslist. Elke aanwijzing maakt het antwoord duidelijker.

feedback.correct: Steen (of mineraal). Alle vier de aanwijzingen kwamen overeen, inclusief de bredere categorie. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Diamanten zijn een gegeven voorbeeld, maar wat is de grotere categorie die beschreven wordt?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: Меня находят глубоко под землёй. Я не живое. Я формировалось миллионы лет. Алмазы — один из моих видов. Что я?
hints: Дождись всех четырёх подсказок — ответ — это более широкая категория, а не просто алмазы.
ru.worked_example: Дождись каждой подсказки, прежде чем решать. Каждая сужает выбор ещё больше.

feedback.correct: Горная порода (или минерал). Все четыре подсказки совпали, включая более широкую категорию. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Алмазы — это один из приведённых примеров, но какая более крупная категория описывается?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Yerin çok altında bulunurum. Canlı değilim. Milyonlarca yıl içinde oluştum. Elmaslar benim bir türümdür. Ben neyim?
hints: Dört ipucunu da bekle - cevap sadece elmaslar değil, daha geniş bir kategoridir.
tr.worked_example: Karar vermeden önce her ipucunu bekle. Her biri seçimi daha da daraltır.

feedback.correct: Kaya (veya mineral). Dört ipucu da eşleşti, daha geniş kategori de dahil. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Elmaslar verilen bir örnektir, ama anlatılan daha büyük kategori nedir?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.audio_text: 我在地底深处被发现。我没有生命。我是经过几百万年形成的。钻石是我的一种。我是什么?
hints: 等四条提示都说完——答案是更大的分类,不只是钻石。
zh.worked_example: 等所有提示都说完再做决定。每一条都会进一步缩小范围。

feedback.correct: 岩石(或矿物)。四条提示都对上了,包括那个更大的分类。🪨
feedback.incorrect: 钻石只是举出的一个例子,但描述的是哪个更大的分类?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: ヒントを聞こう。答えをタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: わたしは地下の深くで見つかる。生きていない。何百万年もかけてできた。ダイヤモンドはわたしの一種だ。わたしは何?
hints: 4つのヒントすべてを待とう - 答えはダイヤモンドだけでなく、もっと広い種類のことだよ。
ja.worked_example: 決める前に、すべてのヒントを待とう。それぞれのヒントでさらに絞られていくよ。

feedback.correct: 岩石(または鉱物)。もっと広い種類のことも含めて、4つのヒントすべてに合っていたね。🪨
feedback.incorrect: ダイヤモンドは1つの例として出てきたけど、説明されているもっと大きな種類は何?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 나는 땅속 깊은 곳에서 발견돼요. 나는 생물이 아니에요. 나는 수백만 년에 걸쳐 만들어졌어요. 다이아몬드는 내 한 종류예요. 나는 무엇일까요?
hints: 네 가지 힌트를 모두 들어보세요 - 답은 다이아몬드만이 아니라 더 넓은 범주예요.
ko.worked_example: 결정하기 전에 모든 힌트를 끝까지 들어보세요. 힌트마다 답이 점점 좁혀져요.

feedback.correct: 돌(또는 광물)이에요. 더 넓은 범주까지, 네 가지 힌트가 모두 맞았어요. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: 다이아몬드는 하나의 예시로 주어졌을 뿐, 설명되고 있는 더 큰 범주는 무엇인가요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Aku ditemukan jauh di bawah tanah. Aku tidak hidup. Aku terbentuk selama jutaan tahun. Berlian adalah salah satu jenisku. Apakah aku?
hints: Tunggu keempat petunjuknya - jawabannya adalah kategori yang lebih luas, bukan hanya berlian.
id.worked_example: Tunggu setiap petunjuk sebelum memutuskan. Setiap petunjuk semakin mempersempitnya.

feedback.correct: Batu (atau mineral). Keempat petunjuk cocok, termasuk kategori yang lebih luas. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Berlian adalah salah satu contoh yang diberikan, tapi apa kategori yang lebih besar yang dijelaskan?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe các gợi ý. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.audio_text: Tôi được tìm thấy sâu dưới lòng đất. Tôi không phải là sinh vật sống. Tôi hình thành qua hàng triệu năm. Kim cương là một loại của tôi. Tôi là gì?
hints: Đợi nghe hết cả bốn gợi ý - đáp án là nhóm lớn hơn, không chỉ là kim cương.
vi.worked_example: Đợi từng gợi ý trước khi quyết định. Mỗi gợi ý thu hẹp dần đáp án.

feedback.correct: Đá (hoặc khoáng vật). Cả bốn gợi ý đều khớp, kể cả nhóm lớn hơn đó. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Kim cương chỉ là một ví dụ được đưa ra, nhưng nhóm lớn hơn đang được mô tả là gì?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen. Is it living or non-living?
questions.audio_text: a dog

distractor_insight.Non-living: missed that it grows, eats, and breathes

hints: Does a dog grow, eat, and breathe?
questions.worked_example: Does it grow, eat, and need air? If yes, it's living.

feedback.correct: Living. Correctly classified. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Think about whether a dog grows, eats, and breathes.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: classifying something as living or non-living from a description

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Anything that grows, eats, and breathes is a living thing.

analysis.primary_construct: applying the living/non-living rule to a heard example
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: One of the most foundational life-science classifications, tested here in its purest form.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Classifying a moving non-living thing (like a car or cloud) as living shows movement, not the full living-things criteria, is driving the answer.
analysis.parent_note: This rule (grows, breathes, needs food) comes up again and again throughout later biology.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Sort real objects and creatures into living and non-living together at home.

es.instruction: Escucha. ¿Es un ser vivo o no?
es.audio_text: un perro
hints: ¿Un perro crece, come y respira?
es.worked_example: ¿Crece, come y necesita aire? Si es así, es un ser vivo.

feedback.correct: Vivo. Correctamente clasificado. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en si un perro crece, come y respira.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute. Est-ce vivant ou non-vivant ?
fr.audio_text: un chien
hints: Un chien grandit, mange et respire-t-il ?
fr.worked_example: Est-ce que ça grandit, mange et a besoin d'air ? Si oui, c'est vivant.

feedback.correct: Vivant. Correctement classé. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Réfléchis à si un chien grandit, mange et respire.
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute. É vivo ou não vivo?
pt.audio_text: um cachorro
hints: Um cachorro cresce, come e respira?
pt.worked_example: Isso cresce, come e precisa de ar? Se sim, é vivo.

feedback.correct: Vivo. Classificado corretamente. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Pense se um cachorro cresce, come e respira.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. È vivente o non vivente?
it.audio_text: un cane
hints: Un cane cresce, mangia e respira?
it.worked_example: Cresce, mangia e ha bisogno di aria? Se sì, è vivente.

feedback.correct: Vivente. Classificato correttamente. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Pensa se un cane cresce, mangia e respira.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Ist es lebend oder nicht lebend?
de.audio_text: ein Hund
hints: Wächst, isst und atmet ein Hund?
de.worked_example: Wächst es, isst es und braucht es Luft? Wenn ja, ist es lebend.

feedback.correct: Lebend. Richtig eingeordnet. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Denk daran, ob ein Hund wächst, isst und atmet.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Is het levend of niet-levend?
nl.audio_text: een hond
hints: Groeit, eet en ademt een hond?
nl.worked_example: Groeit het, eet het, en heeft het lucht nodig? Zo ja, dan is het levend.

feedback.correct: Levend. Goed geclassificeerd. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan of een hond groeit, eet en ademt.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: собака
hints: Собака растёт, ест и дышит?
ru.worked_example: Оно растёт, ест и нуждается в воздухе? Если да, то оно живое.

feedback.correct: Живое. Правильно классифицировано. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Подумай, растёт ли собака, ест ли и дышит ли она.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: bir köpek
hints: Bir köpek büyür, yer ve nefes alır mı?
tr.worked_example: Büyür mü, yer mi ve havaya ihtiyacı var mı? Evetse, canlıdır.

feedback.correct: Canlı. Doğru sınıflandırıldı. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Bir köpeğin büyüyüp büyümediğini, yiyip yemediğini ve nefes alıp almadığını düşün.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 听。这是有生命的还是无生命的?
zh.audio_text: 一只狗
hints: 狗会生长、进食、呼吸吗?
zh.worked_example: 它会生长、进食、需要空气吗?如果是,那它就是有生命的。

feedback.correct: 有生命。分类正确。🐶
feedback.incorrect: 想一想狗是否会生长、进食、呼吸。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。生き物か、生き物ではないかな?
ja.audio_text: イヌ
hints: イヌは育って、食べて、呼吸する?
ja.worked_example: 育って、食べて、空気が必要?もしそうなら、それは生き物だ。

feedback.correct: 生き物。正しく分けられたね。🐶
feedback.incorrect: イヌが育って、食べて、呼吸するか考えよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 강아지
hints: 강아지는 자라고, 먹고, 숨을 쉬나요?
ko.worked_example: 자라고, 먹고, 공기가 필요한가요? 그렇다면 생물이에요.

feedback.correct: 생물이에요. 맞게 분류했어요. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: 강아지가 자라고, 먹고, 숨을 쉬는지 생각해 보세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Dengarkan. Apakah ini hidup atau tak hidup?
id.audio_text: seekor anjing
hints: Apakah anjing tumbuh, makan, dan bernapas?
id.worked_example: Apakah ia tumbuh, makan, dan membutuhkan udara? Jika ya, itu hidup.

feedback.correct: Hidup. Benar diklasifikasikan. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan apakah anjing tumbuh, makan, dan bernapas.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe. Đây là vật sống hay không sống?
vi.audio_text: một con chó
hints: Chó có lớn lên, ăn và thở không?
vi.worked_example: Nó có lớn lên, ăn và cần không khí không? Nếu có, nó là vật sống.

feedback.correct: Sống. Phân loại đúng. 🐶
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ xem chó có lớn lên, ăn và thở không.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen. Is it living or non-living?
questions.audio_text: a rock

distractor_insight.Living: assumed all natural things are living

hints: Does a rock grow, eat, or breathe?
questions.worked_example: Does it grow, eat, and need air? If yes, it's living.

feedback.correct: Non-living. Correctly classified. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: A rock is natural, but does it grow, eat, or breathe?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: classifying something as living or non-living from a description

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Natural doesn't automatically mean living - rocks are natural but non-living.

analysis.primary_construct: applying the living/non-living rule to a heard example
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: One of the most foundational life-science classifications, tested here in its purest form.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Classifying a moving non-living thing (like a car or cloud) as living shows movement, not the full living-things criteria, is driving the answer.
analysis.parent_note: This rule (grows, breathes, needs food) comes up again and again throughout later biology.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Sort real objects and creatures into living and non-living together at home.

es.instruction: Escucha. ¿Es un ser vivo o no?
es.audio_text: una roca
hints: ¿Una roca crece, come o respira?
es.worked_example: ¿Crece, come y necesita aire? Si es así, es un ser vivo.

feedback.correct: No vivo. Correctamente clasificado. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Una roca es natural, pero ¿crece, come o respira?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute. Est-ce vivant ou non-vivant ?
fr.audio_text: une pierre
hints: Une pierre grandit-elle, mange-t-elle ou respire-t-elle ?
fr.worked_example: Est-ce que ça grandit, mange et a besoin d'air ? Si oui, c'est vivant.

feedback.correct: Non-vivant. Correctement classé. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Une pierre est naturelle, mais grandit-elle, mange-t-elle ou respire-t-elle ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen. Is it living or non-living?
questions.audio_text: a tree

distractor_insight.Non-living: missed that trees grow and need water and air

hints: Does a tree grow and need water?

academic.skill: classifying something as living or non-living from a description

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Plants are living things too, even though they don't move around.

analysis.primary_construct: applying the living/non-living rule to a heard example
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: One of the most foundational life-science classifications, tested here in its purest form.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Classifying a moving non-living thing (like a car or cloud) as living shows movement, not the full living-things criteria, is driving the answer.
analysis.parent_note: This rule (grows, breathes, needs food) comes up again and again throughout later biology.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Sort real objects and creatures into living and non-living together at home.

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。体の部分をタップしよう。
