hints: 聞くこととバランスを取ること、両方の役目をする部分はどこ?
ja.worked_example: その役目を実際にする体の部分を考えよう。

feedback.correct: 耳。難しい2つの役目のヒントでも、正しく選べたね。👂
feedback.incorrect: 体の中で、聞くこととバランスを取ることの両方をする部分がある - どこ?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 이것을 사용해서 균형도 잡고, 소리도 들어요.
hints: 듣기와 균형, 두 가지 일을 모두 하는 부위는 무엇인가요?
ko.worked_example: 이 일을 실제로 하는 신체 부위가 무엇인지 생각해 보세요.

feedback.correct: 귀예요. 까다로운 두 가지 역할 힌트에도 맞게 선택했어요. 👂
feedback.incorrect: 몸속 한 부위가 듣기와 균형을 모두 담당해요 - 그게 무엇인가요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Kamu menggunakan ini untuk menjaga keseimbangan, selain untuk mendengar.
hints: Bagian mana yang punya dua tugas: mendengar DAN menjaga keseimbangan?
id.worked_example: Pikirkan bagian tubuhmu mana yang sebenarnya melakukan tugas ini.

feedback.correct: Telinga. Benar dicocokkan, meskipun petunjuk tugas gandanya cukup rumit. 👂
feedback.incorrect: Satu bagian di tubuhmu melakukan tugas mendengar DAN keseimbangan - bagian mana itu?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe. Chạm vào bộ phận cơ thể.
vi.audio_text: Bạn dùng bộ phận này để giữ thăng bằng, cũng như để nghe.
hints: Bộ phận nào làm hai việc: nghe VÀ giữ thăng bằng?
vi.worked_example: Nghĩ về bộ phận cơ thể nào thực sự làm công việc này.

feedback.correct: Tai. Khớp đúng, dù có gợi ý khó về hai nhiệm vụ. 👂
feedback.incorrect: Có một bộ phận trong cơ thể bạn làm cả việc nghe và giữ thăng bằng - đó là gì?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.audio_text: You use this organ to filter your blood and remove waste.

distractor_insight.heart: a different vital organ with a different job
distractor_insight.lungs: a different vital organ with a different job

hints: Which organ's whole job is cleaning your blood?
questions.worked_example: Think about which part of your body actually does this job.

feedback.correct: Kidneys. Correctly matched - a genuinely lesser-known organ fact. 🫘
feedback.incorrect: This organ's main job is filtering waste out of your blood - which one is it?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: connecting a sense or action to the correct body part

life_skill.hidden_lesson: You have two kidneys, and even one alone can do the whole job if needed.

analysis.primary_construct: mapping a described sense or function to its body part
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Body awareness is both a science topic and a genuinely useful self-knowledge skill.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Confusing a paired sense-organ (ear for hearing vs eye for seeing) suggests the specific mapping, not general body knowledge, needs support.
analysis.parent_note: Knowing which part does what helps a child describe their own needs and feelings more precisely.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Play a 'what does this do' game pointing to different body parts together.

es.instruction: Escucha. Toca la parte del cuerpo.
es.audio_text: Usas este órgano para filtrar tu sangre y eliminar los desechos.
hints: ¿Qué órgano tiene como función principal limpiar tu sangre?
es.worked_example: Piensa en qué parte de tu cuerpo hace realmente esta función.

feedback.correct: Riñones. Correctamente identificado - un dato de un órgano poco conocido. 🫘
feedback.incorrect: La función principal de este órgano es filtrar los desechos de tu sangre - ¿cuál es?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute. Touche la partie du corps.
fr.audio_text: Tu utilises cet organe pour filtrer ton sang et éliminer les déchets.
hints: Quel organe a pour seul travail de nettoyer ton sang ?
fr.worked_example: Réfléchis à quelle partie de ton corps fait vraiment ce travail.

feedback.correct: Les reins. Correctement associé - un fait vraiment peu connu sur cet organe. 🫘
feedback.incorrect: Le travail principal de cet organe est de filtrer les déchets de ton sang - lequel est-ce ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute. Toque na parte do corpo.
pt.audio_text: Você usa este órgão para filtrar seu sangue e remover resíduos.
hints: O trabalho de qual órgão é inteiramente limpar seu sangue?
pt.worked_example: Pense em qual parte do seu corpo realmente faz esse trabalho.

feedback.correct: Rins. Combinado corretamente - um fato sobre um órgão realmente pouco conhecido. 🫘
feedback.incorrect: O trabalho principal deste órgão é filtrar os resíduos do seu sangue - qual é ele?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. Tocca la parte del corpo.
it.audio_text: Usi questo organo per filtrare il sangue e rimuovere le scorie.
hints: Quale organo ha il compito di pulire il sangue?
it.worked_example: Pensa a quale parte del corpo svolge davvero questo compito.

feedback.correct: Reni. Risposta corretta - un fatto davvero poco conosciuto su questo organo. 🫘
feedback.incorrect: Il compito principale di questo organo è filtrare le scorie dal sangue - quale è?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Tippe den Körperteil.
de.audio_text: Dieses Organ benutzt du, um dein Blut zu filtern und Abfallstoffe zu entfernen.
hints: Welches Organ hat die einzige Aufgabe, dein Blut zu reinigen?
de.worked_example: Denk daran, welcher Körperteil diese Aufgabe tatsächlich übernimmt.

feedback.correct: Nieren. Richtig zugeordnet – eine wirklich weniger bekannte Tatsache über ein Organ. 🫘
feedback.incorrect: Die Hauptaufgabe dieses Organs ist es, Abfallstoffe aus deinem Blut zu filtern – welches ist es?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Tik op het lichaamsdeel.
nl.audio_text: Je gebruikt dit orgaan om je bloed te filteren en afvalstoffen te verwijderen.
hints: Welk orgaan heeft als enige taak je bloed te reinigen?
nl.worked_example: Denk aan welk deel van je lichaam deze taak echt uitvoert.

feedback.correct: Nieren. Goed gekoppeld - een echt minder bekend feit over organen. 🫘
feedback.incorrect: Dit orgaan heeft als hoofdtaak afvalstoffen uit je bloed te filteren - welk orgaan is dat?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: Ты используешь этот орган, чтобы фильтровать кровь и удалять отходы.
hints: Какой орган целиком занимается очисткой твоей крови?
ru.worked_example: Подумай, какая часть твоего тела на самом деле выполняет эту работу.

feedback.correct: Почки. Правильно сопоставлено — действительно малоизвестный факт об органе. 🫘
feedback.incorrect: Главная работа этого органа — фильтровать отходы из твоей крови — какой это орган?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Bu organı kanını süzmek ve atıkları atmak için kullanırsın.
hints: Hangi organın tüm işi kanını temizlemektir?
tr.worked_example: Vücudunun hangi bölümünün bu işi gerçekten yaptığını düşün.

feedback.correct: Böbrekler. Doğru eşleştirildi - gerçekten az bilinen bir organ bilgisi. 🫘
feedback.incorrect: Bu organın ana işi kanından atıkları süzmektir - hangisi?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.audio_text: 你用这个器官过滤血液,排出废物。
hints: 哪个器官的主要工作就是清洁血液?
zh.worked_example: 想一想身体的哪个部位实际负责这件事。

feedback.correct: 肾脏。匹配正确——这是一个真正不太为人所知的器官知识。🫘
feedback.incorrect: 这个器官的主要工作是过滤血液中的废物——是哪一个?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。体の部分をタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: この器官を血液をろ過して、老廃物を取り除くために使う。
hints: 血液をきれいにすることが仕事の器官はどこ?
ja.worked_example: その役目を実際にする体の部分を考えよう。

feedback.correct: 腎臓。あまり知られていない器官の知識も、正しく選べたね。🫘
feedback.incorrect: この器官の主な仕事は、血液から老廃物をろ過することだ - どれ?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 이 기관을 사용해서 피를 걸러내고 노폐물을 없애요.
hints: 피를 깨끗하게 하는 것이 전부인 기관은 무엇인가요?
ko.worked_example: 이 일을 실제로 하는 신체 부위가 무엇인지 생각해 보세요.

feedback.correct: 콩팥이에요. 잘 알려지지 않은 기관에 대한 사실까지 맞게 선택했어요. 🫘
feedback.incorrect: 이 기관의 주된 역할은 피에서 노폐물을 걸러내는 거예요 - 그게 무엇인가요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Kamu menggunakan organ ini untuk menyaring darahmu dan membuang zat sisa.
hints: Organ mana yang seluruh tugasnya membersihkan darahmu?
id.worked_example: Pikirkan bagian tubuhmu mana yang sebenarnya melakukan tugas ini.

feedback.correct: Ginjal. Benar dicocokkan - fakta organ yang sungguh kurang dikenal. 🫘
feedback.incorrect: Tugas utama organ ini adalah menyaring zat sisa dari darahmu - organ mana itu?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe. Chạm vào bộ phận cơ thể.
vi.audio_text: Bạn dùng cơ quan này để lọc máu và loại bỏ chất thải.
hints: Cơ quan nào có nhiệm vụ duy nhất là làm sạch máu của bạn?
vi.worked_example: Nghĩ về bộ phận cơ thể nào thực sự làm công việc này.

feedback.correct: Thận. Khớp đúng - một thông tin về cơ quan ít được biết đến. 🫘
feedback.incorrect: Cơ quan này có nhiệm vụ chính là lọc chất thải ra khỏi máu bạn - đó là cơ quan nào?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.audio_text: It is cold and snow is falling. What season is it?

distractor_insight.Summer: opposite season, hot rather than cold
distractor_insight.Spring: a milder season, doesn't usually have heavy snow

hints: Which season is coldest, with snow?
questions.worked_example: Picture the weather described. Which season fits that picture?

feedback.correct: Winter. Correctly matched. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Think about which season is coldest with snow.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: connecting weather or seasonal description to the correct concept

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Different parts of the world have very different winters.

analysis.primary_construct: mapping a spoken weather or season description to the correct term or image
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Weather and seasons are observable, recurring science content that connects directly to daily planning.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Confusing similar seasons (spring/autumn) based on a shared feature (mild temperature) is a specific, correctable pattern.
analysis.parent_note: Weather knowledge helps a child dress themselves appropriately and plan their own day.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Discuss the weather and season together each morning, out loud.

es.instruction: Escucha. Toca la respuesta.
es.audio_text: Hace frío y está cayendo nieve. ¿Qué estación es?
hints: ¿Qué estación es la más fría, con nieve?
es.worked_example: Imagina el clima descrito. ¿Qué estación encaja con esa imagen?

feedback.correct: Invierno. Correctamente identificado. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en qué estación es la más fría, con nieve.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute. Touche la réponse.
fr.audio_text: Il fait froid et la neige tombe. Quelle saison est-ce ?
hints: Quelle saison est la plus froide, avec de la neige ?
fr.worked_example: Imagine le temps décrit. Quelle saison correspond à cette image ?

feedback.correct: Hiver. Correctement associé. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Réfléchis à quelle saison est la plus froide avec de la neige.
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute. Toque na resposta.
pt.audio_text: Está frio e está nevando. Que estação é essa?
hints: Qual estação é a mais fria, com neve?
pt.worked_example: Imagine o clima descrito. Qual estação combina com essa imagem?

feedback.correct: Inverno. Combinado corretamente. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Pense em qual estação é a mais fria, com neve.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. Tocca la risposta.
it.audio_text: Fa freddo e sta nevicando. Che stagione è?
hints: Quale stagione è la più fredda, con la neve?
it.worked_example: Immagina il tempo descritto. Quale stagione corrisponde a questa immagine?

feedback.correct: Inverno. Risposta corretta. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a quale stagione è la più fredda, con la neve.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Tippe die Antwort.
de.audio_text: Es ist kalt und Schnee fällt. Welche Jahreszeit ist das?
hints: Welche Jahreszeit ist am kältesten, mit Schnee?
de.worked_example: Stell dir das beschriebene Wetter vor. Welche Jahreszeit passt zu diesem Bild?

feedback.correct: Winter. Richtig zugeordnet. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Denk daran, welche Jahreszeit am kältesten ist, mit Schnee.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Tik op het antwoord.
nl.audio_text: Het is koud en het sneeuwt. Welk seizoen is het?
hints: Welk seizoen is het koudst, met sneeuw?
nl.worked_example: Stel je het beschreven weer voor. Welk seizoen past bij dat beeld?

feedback.correct: Winter. Goed gekoppeld. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan welk seizoen het koudst is met sneeuw.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: Холодно, и падает снег. Какое время года?
hints: Какое время года самое холодное, со снегом?
ru.worked_example: Представь описанную погоду. Какое время года соответствует этой картине?

feedback.correct: Зима. Правильно сопоставлено. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Подумай, какое время года самое холодное, со снегом.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Hava soğuk ve kar yağıyor. Hangi mevsim bu?
hints: Hangi mevsim en soğuk ve karlıdır?
tr.worked_example: Anlatılan havayı gözünde canlandır. Hangi mevsim bu tabloya uyuyor?

feedback.correct: Kış. Doğru eşleştirildi. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Hangi mevsimin en soğuk ve karlı olduğunu düşün.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.audio_text: 天气很冷,还下着雪。这是什么季节?
hints: 哪个季节最冷、还会下雪?
zh.worked_example: 想象描述中的天气。哪个季节符合这个画面?

feedback.correct: 冬天。匹配正确。❄️
feedback.incorrect: 想一想哪个季节最冷,还会下雪。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。答えをタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: 寒くて雪が降っている。今はどの季節?
hints: 雪が降る、いちばん寒い季節はどれ?
ja.worked_example: 説明されている天気を想像しよう。どの季節がその様子に合う?

feedback.correct: 冬。正しく選べたね。❄️
feedback.incorrect: 雪が降る、いちばん寒い季節を考えよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 날씨가 춥고 눈이 내리고 있어요. 지금은 어떤 계절일까요?
hints: 가장 춥고 눈이 내리는 계절은 무엇인가요?
ko.worked_example: 설명된 날씨를 떠올려 보세요. 어떤 계절이 그 모습에 맞나요?

feedback.correct: 겨울이에요. 맞게 선택했어요. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: 눈이 내리는 가장 추운 계절이 무엇인지 생각해 보세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Cuacanya dingin dan salju turun. Musim apa ini?
hints: Musim mana yang paling dingin, dengan salju?
id.worked_example: Bayangkan cuaca yang dijelaskan. Musim mana yang cocok dengan gambaran itu?

feedback.correct: Musim dingin. Benar dicocokkan. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan musim mana yang paling dingin dengan salju.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.audio_text: Trời lạnh và tuyết đang rơi. Đó là mùa nào?
hints: Mùa nào lạnh nhất, có tuyết?
vi.worked_example: Hình dung thời tiết được mô tả. Mùa nào khớp với hình ảnh đó?

feedback.correct: Mùa đông. Khớp đúng. ❄️
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ về mùa nào lạnh nhất và có tuyết.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.audio_text: It is hot and sunny, and school is out for the holidays. What season is it?

distractor_insight.Winter: opposite season, cold rather than hot
distractor_insight.Autumn: a milder season with cooling weather

hints: Which season is hottest?
questions.worked_example: Picture the weather described. Which season fits that picture?

feedback.correct: Summer. Correctly matched. ☀️
feedback.incorrect: Think about which season is hottest with the longest days.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: connecting weather or seasonal description to the correct concept

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Summer has the longest days of the whole year.

analysis.primary_construct: mapping a spoken weather or season description to the correct term or image
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Weather and seasons are observable, recurring science content that connects directly to daily planning.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Confusing similar seasons (spring/autumn) based on a shared feature (mild temperature) is a specific, correctable pattern.
analysis.parent_note: Weather knowledge helps a child dress themselves appropriately and plan their own day.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Discuss the weather and season together each morning, out loud.

es.instruction: Escucha. Toca la respuesta.
es.audio_text: Hace calor y hay sol, y la escuela está de vacaciones. ¿Qué estación es?
hints: ¿Qué estación es la más calurosa?
es.worked_example: Imagina el clima descrito. ¿Qué estación encaja con esa imagen?

feedback.correct: Verano. Correctamente identificado. ☀️
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en qué estación es la más calurosa y con los días más largos.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute. Touche la réponse.
fr.audio_text: Il fait chaud et ensoleillé, et l'école est finie pour les vacances. Quelle saison est-ce ?
hints: Quelle saison est la plus chaude ?
fr.worked_example: Imagine le temps décrit. Quelle saison correspond à cette image ?

feedback.correct: Été. Correctement associé. ☀️
feedback.incorrect: Réfléchis à quelle saison est la plus chaude avec les jours les plus longs.
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute. Toque na resposta.
pt.audio_text: Está quente e ensolarado, e a escola está de férias. Que estação é essa?
hints: Qual estação é a mais quente?
pt.worked_example: Imagine o clima descrito. Qual estação combina com essa imagem?

feedback.correct: Verão. Combinado corretamente. ☀️
feedback.incorrect: Pense em qual estação é a mais quente, com os dias mais longos.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. Tocca la risposta.
it.audio_text: Fa caldo e c'è il sole, e la scuola è chiusa per le vacanze. Che stagione è?
hints: Quale stagione è la più calda?
it.worked_example: Immagina il tempo descritto. Quale stagione corrisponde a questa immagine?

feedback.correct: Estate. Risposta corretta. ☀️
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a quale stagione è la più calda, con le giornate più lunghe.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Tippe die Antwort.
de.audio_text: Es ist heiß und sonnig, und die Schule hat Ferien. Welche Jahreszeit ist das?
hints: Welche Jahreszeit ist am heißesten?
de.worked_example: Stell dir das beschriebene Wetter vor. Welche Jahreszeit passt zu diesem Bild?

id.audio_text: Salju turun pada bulan Juli. Di bagian dunia mana hal itu sebenarnya bisa masuk akal?

feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.audio_text: Tuyết đang rơi vào tháng Bảy. Ở đâu trên thế giới điều đó có thể thực sự hợp lý?
options: Nam bán cầu, nơi các mùa bị đảo ngược
Không nơi nào - tháng Bảy lúc nào cũng là mùa hè ở mọi nơi

accepted_answers: Nam bán cầu, nơi các mùa bị đảo ngược
hints: Mọi nơi trên thế giới có mùa hè cùng lúc không?

feedback.correct: Nam bán cầu - các mùa ở đó ngược với phía bắc. Suy luận thực sự nâng cao, làm đúng. 🌍
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ xem liệu mọi nơi trên thế giới có cùng một mùa vào cùng thời điểm không.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.audio_text: A place has almost no seasons at all - it stays hot and humid nearly all year. What kind of place might that be?
options: Near the equator, in a tropical climate
On top of a very tall mountain
questions.correct_answer: Near the equator, in a tropical climate
accepted_answers: Near the equator, in a tropical climate

distractor_insight.Near the North Pole: the opposite climate, extremely cold, not hot
distractor_insight.On top of a very tall mountain: mountains are typically cold, not hot

hints: Which part of the world tends to stay warm nearly all year round?
questions.worked_example: Picture the weather described. Which season fits that picture?

feedback.correct: Near the equator - tropical places stay warm nearly all year. Genuinely advanced reasoning, correctly worked out. 🌴
feedback.incorrect: Think about which part of the world doesn't experience big seasonal changes.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: connecting weather or seasonal description to the correct concept

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Places near the equator get roughly the same amount of sunlight all year round.

analysis.primary_construct: mapping a spoken weather or season description to the correct term or image
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Weather and seasons are observable, recurring science content that connects directly to daily planning.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Confusing similar seasons (spring/autumn) based on a shared feature (mild temperature) is a specific, correctable pattern.
analysis.parent_note: Weather knowledge helps a child dress themselves appropriately and plan their own day.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Discuss the weather and season together each morning, out loud.

es.instruction: Escucha. Toca la respuesta.
es.audio_text: Un lugar casi no tiene estaciones - se mantiene caluroso y húmedo casi todo el año. ¿Qué tipo de lugar podría ser?
options: Cerca del ecuador, en un clima tropical
En la cima de una montaña muy alta
es.correct_answer: Cerca del ecuador, en un clima tropical
accepted_answers: Cerca del ecuador, en un clima tropical
hints: ¿Qué parte del mundo suele mantenerse cálida casi todo el año?

feedback.correct: Cerca del ecuador - los lugares tropicales se mantienen cálidos casi todo el año. Un razonamiento realmente avanzado, resuelto correctamente. 🌴
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en qué parte del mundo no experimenta grandes cambios de estación.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute. Touche la réponse.
fr.audio_text: Un endroit n'a presque pas de saisons du tout - il reste chaud et humide presque toute l'année. Quel genre d'endroit cela pourrait-il être ?

Au sommet d'une très haute montagne
fr.correct_answer: Près de l'équateur, dans un climat tropical
accepted_answers: Près de l'équateur, dans un climat tropical

feedback.incorrect: Réfléchis à quelle partie du monde ne connaît pas de grands changements de saisons.
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute. Toque na resposta.
pt.audio_text: Um lugar quase não tem estações - ele permanece quente e úmido quase todo o ano. Que tipo de lugar pode ser esse?
options: Perto da linha do equador, em um clima tropical
No topo de uma montanha muito alta
pt.correct_answer: Perto da linha do equador, em um clima tropical
accepted_answers: Perto da linha do equador, em um clima tropical

feedback.incorrect: Pense em qual parte do mundo não passa por grandes mudanças de estação.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. Tocca la risposta.
it.audio_text: Un luogo non ha quasi stagioni - resta caldo e umido quasi tutto l'anno. Che tipo di luogo potrebbe essere?
options: Vicino all'equatore, in un clima tropicale
In cima a una montagna molto alta
it.correct_answer: Vicino all'equatore, in un clima tropicale
accepted_answers: Vicino all'equatore, in un clima tropicale
hints: Quale parte del mondo tende a restare calda quasi tutto l'anno?
it.worked_example: Immagina il tempo descritto. Quale stagione corrisponde a questa immagine?

feedback.correct: Vicino all'equatore - i luoghi tropicali restano caldi quasi tutto l'anno. Ragionamento davvero avanzato, risolto correttamente. 🌴
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a quale parte del mondo non vive grandi cambiamenti stagionali.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Tippe die Antwort.
de.audio_text: Ein Ort hat fast keine Jahreszeiten – er bleibt fast das ganze Jahr heiß und feucht. Was für ein Ort könnte das sein?
options: Nahe am Äquator, in einem tropischen Klima
de.correct_answer: Nahe am Äquator, in einem tropischen Klima
accepted_answers: Nahe am Äquator, in einem tropischen Klima
hints: Welcher Teil der Welt bleibt fast das ganze Jahr warm?
de.worked_example: Stell dir das beschriebene Wetter vor. Welche Jahreszeit passt zu diesem Bild?

feedback.correct: Nahe am Äquator – tropische Orte bleiben fast das ganze Jahr warm. Wirklich fortgeschrittenes Denken, richtig durchdacht. 🌴
feedback.incorrect: Denk daran, welcher Teil der Welt keine großen jahreszeitlichen Veränderungen erlebt.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Tik op het antwoord.
nl.audio_text: Een plek heeft bijna helemaal geen seizoenen - het blijft bijna het hele jaar heet en vochtig. Wat voor plek zou dat kunnen zijn?
options: Dicht bij de evenaar, in een tropisch klimaat
Op de top van een heel hoge berg
nl.correct_answer: Dicht bij de evenaar, in een tropisch klimaat
accepted_answers: Dicht bij de evenaar, in een tropisch klimaat
hints: Welk deel van de wereld blijft bijna het hele jaar warm?
nl.worked_example: Stel je het beschreven weer voor. Welk seizoen past bij dat beeld?

feedback.correct: Dicht bij de evenaar - tropische plekken blijven bijna het hele jaar warm. Echt geavanceerde redenering, goed uitgewerkt. 🌴
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan welk deel van de wereld geen grote seizoensveranderingen ervaart.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: В одном месте почти нет времён года — там почти весь год жарко и влажно. Каким может быть это место?
hints: Какая часть мира обычно остаётся тёплой почти весь год?

tr.audio_text: Bir yerde neredeyse hiç mevsim yoktur - yılın büyük bölümünde sıcak ve nemli kalır. Bu ne tür bir yer olabilir?
hints: Dünyanın hangi bölgesi yılın neredeyse tamamında sıcak kalır?

feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.audio_text: 有一个地方几乎没有季节变化——几乎整年都很热、很潮湿。这可能是什么样的地方?

在一座非常高的山顶上
zh.correct_answer: 靠近赤道的热带气候区
accepted_answers: 靠近赤道的热带气候区
hints: 世界上哪个地区几乎整年都很温暖?

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。答えをタップしよう。

feedback.incorrect: 季節による大きな変化がない地域はどこか考えよう。

feedback.incorrect: 계절 변화가 크지 않은 세계의 지역이 어디인지 생각해 보세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Sebuah tempat hampir tidak memiliki musim sama sekali - tetap panas dan lembap hampir sepanjang tahun. Tempat seperti apa itu mungkin?
options: Di atas gunung yang sangat tinggi

feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.audio_text: Một nơi hầu như không có mùa nào cả - nó nóng và ẩm quanh năm. Đó có thể là nơi như thế nào?

Trên đỉnh một ngọn núi rất cao
vi.correct_answer: Gần đường xích đạo, trong vùng khí hậu nhiệt đới
accepted_answers: Gần đường xích đạo, trong vùng khí hậu nhiệt đới

feedback.correct: Gần đường xích đạo - những nơi nhiệt đới ấm quanh năm. Suy luận thực sự nâng cao, làm đúng. 🌴
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ về phần nào của thế giới không trải qua những thay đổi mùa lớn.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen to the steps. Put them in order.
questions.audio_text: First an egg. Then a caterpillar. Then a cocoon. Then a butterfly.
hints: The egg always comes first in this life cycle.
questions.worked_example: Picture the whole process. What absolutely has to happen first?

feedback.correct: Egg, caterpillar, cocoon, butterfly - the whole life cycle, in order. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: Which stage is the very beginning of a butterfly's life?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: sequencing a spoken science process

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Every butterfly goes through all four of these stages, in exactly this order.

analysis.primary_construct: holding several spoken steps in mind and ordering them correctly
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Science processes (growth, life cycles, water cycle) are inherently sequential - this tests that structure directly.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Correct final state but wrong middle order shows the process's outcome, not its stages, is understood.
analysis.parent_note: Understanding that science happens in stages, not all at once, is a big conceptual step.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Talk through a familiar process (like making toast) in careful order together.

es.instruction: Escucha los pasos. Ponlos en orden.

feedback.incorrect: Quelle étape marque le tout début de la vie d'un papillon ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute os passos. Coloque-os em ordem.

feedback.incorrect: Qual estágio é o início da vida de uma borboleta?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta i passaggi. Mettili in ordine.

feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Слушай шаги. Расставь их по порядку.

feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

zh.instruction: 听步骤。把它们按顺序排列。

feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 手順を聞こう。正しい順番に並べよう。
ja.audio_text: まず卵。それから幼虫。それからさなぎ。それからチョウ。
hints: この一生のサイクルでは、卵がいつも最初だ。
ja.worked_example: 全体の流れを想像しよう。絶対に最初に起こることは何?

feedback.correct: 卵、幼虫、さなぎ、チョウ - 一生のサイクル全部を順番にできたね。🦋
feedback.incorrect: チョウの一生のいちばん最初の段階はどれ?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 먼저 알이에요. 그다음 애벌레예요. 그다음 번데기예요. 그다음 나비예요.
hints: 이 한살이에서는 알이 항상 가장 먼저예요.
ko.worked_example: 전체 과정을 떠올려 보세요. 가장 먼저 일어나야 하는 일은 무엇인가요?

feedback.correct: 알, 애벌레, 번데기, 나비 - 한살이 전체를 순서대로 맞혔어요. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: 나비의 삶에서 가장 처음 단계는 무엇인가요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Pertama telur. Lalu ulat. Lalu kepompong. Lalu kupu-kupu.
hints: Telur selalu datang pertama dalam siklus hidup ini.
id.worked_example: Bayangkan seluruh prosesnya. Apa yang pasti harus terjadi lebih dulu?

feedback.correct: Telur, ulat, kepompong, kupu-kupu - seluruh siklus hidup, secara berurutan. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: Tahap mana yang menjadi awal mula kehidupan kupu-kupu?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe các bước. Sắp xếp theo đúng thứ tự.
vi.audio_text: Đầu tiên là trứng. Sau đó là sâu bướm. Sau đó là nhộng. Sau đó là bướm.
hints: Trứng luôn xuất hiện đầu tiên trong vòng đời này.
vi.worked_example: Hãy hình dung toàn bộ quá trình. Điều gì chắc chắn phải xảy ra đầu tiên?

feedback.correct: Trứng, sâu bướm, nhộng, bướm - toàn bộ vòng đời, theo đúng thứ tự. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: Giai đoạn nào là khởi đầu của cuộc đời con bướm?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen to the steps. Put them in order.
questions.audio_text: First plant the seed. Then water it. Then it sprouts. Then it grows into a plant.
hints: Nothing can sprout before it's planted.
questions.worked_example: Picture the whole process. What absolutely has to happen first?

feedback.correct: Plant, water, sprout, grow - the whole process, in order. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: What has to happen before a seed can even sprout?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: sequencing a spoken science process

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Every plant follows roughly this same order, just at different speeds.

analysis.primary_construct: holding several spoken steps in mind and ordering them correctly
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Science processes (growth, life cycles, water cycle) are inherently sequential - this tests that structure directly.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Correct final state but wrong middle order shows the process's outcome, not its stages, is understood.
analysis.parent_note: Understanding that science happens in stages, not all at once, is a big conceptual step.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Talk through a familiar process (like making toast) in careful order together.

es.instruction: Escucha los pasos. Ponlos en orden.
es.audio_text: Primero plantas la semilla. Luego la riegas. Luego brota. Luego se convierte en una planta.
hints: Nada puede brotar antes de ser plantado.
es.worked_example: Imagina todo el proceso. ¿Qué tiene que pasar primero sin duda?

feedback.correct: Plantar, regar, brotar, crecer - todo el proceso, en orden. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: ¿Qué tiene que pasar antes de que una semilla pueda brotar?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute les étapes. Mets-les dans l'ordre.
fr.audio_text: D'abord on plante la graine. Puis on l'arrose. Puis elle germe. Puis elle devient une plante.
hints: Rien ne peut germer avant d'être planté.
fr.worked_example: Imagine tout le processus. Qu'est-ce qui doit absolument arriver en premier ?

feedback.correct: Planter, arroser, germer, grandir - tout le processus, dans l'ordre. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Que doit-il se passer avant qu'une graine puisse même germer ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute os passos. Coloque-os em ordem.
pt.audio_text: Primeiro plante a semente. Depois regue-a. Depois ela brota. Depois ela cresce e se torna uma planta.
options: crescer e se tornar uma planta
correct_answer: crescer e se tornar uma planta
accepted_answers: crescer e se tornar uma planta
hints: Nada pode brotar antes de ser plantado.
pt.worked_example: Imagine todo o processo. O que precisa acontecer primeiro, sem dúvida?

feedback.correct: Plantar, regar, brotar, crescer - todo o processo, em ordem. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: O que precisa acontecer antes que uma semente possa brotar?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta i passaggi. Mettili in ordine.
it.audio_text: Prima pianta il seme. Poi lo bagni. Poi germoglia. Poi diventa una pianta.
hints: Niente può germogliare prima di essere piantato.
it.worked_example: Immagina tutto il processo. Cosa deve assolutamente accadere prima?

feedback.correct: Pianta, bagna, germoglia, cresce - tutto il processo, in ordine. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Cosa deve succedere prima che un seme possa germogliare?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

de.instruction: Höre die Schritte. Bringe sie in die richtige Reihenfolge.
de.audio_text: Zuerst den Samen pflanzen. Dann wässern. Dann keimt er. Dann wächst er zu einer Pflanze.
hints: Nichts kann keimen, bevor es gepflanzt wurde.
de.worked_example: Stell dir den ganzen Vorgang vor. Was muss unbedingt zuerst passieren?

feedback.correct: Pflanzen, wässern, keimen, wachsen – der ganze Vorgang, in der richtigen Reihenfolge. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Was muss passieren, bevor ein Samen überhaupt keimen kann?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar de stappen. Zet ze in de juiste volgorde.
nl.audio_text: Eerst plant je het zaadje. Dan geef je het water. Dan ontkiemt het. Dan groeit het uit tot een plant.
hints: Niets kan ontkiemen voordat het geplant is.
nl.worked_example: Stel je het hele proces voor. Wat moet absoluut eerst gebeuren?

feedback.correct: Planten, water geven, ontkiemen, groeien - het hele proces, in volgorde. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Wat moet er gebeuren voordat een zaadje zelfs kan ontkiemen?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Слушай шаги. Расставь их по порядку.
ru.audio_text: Сначала посади семя. Потом полей его. Потом оно прорастает. Потом оно превращается в растение.
hints: Ничего не может прорасти, прежде чем будет посажено.
ru.worked_example: Представь весь процесс. Что обязательно должно произойти первым?

feedback.correct: Посади, полей, прорастание, рост — весь процесс, по порядку. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Что должно произойти, прежде чем семя сможет прорасти?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Önce tohumu ek. Sonra onu sula. Sonra filizlenir. Sonra bir bitkiye dönüşür.
hints: Ekilmeden hiçbir şey filizlenemez.
tr.worked_example: Tüm süreci gözünde canlandır. İlk önce mutlaka ne olması gerekir?

feedback.correct: Ek, sula, filizlen, büyü - tüm süreç, sırasıyla. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Bir tohum filizlenmeden önce ne olması gerekir?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 听步骤。把它们按顺序排列。
zh.audio_text: 先种下种子。然后浇水。然后它发芽。然后长成植物。
hints: 没有种下,就不可能发芽。
zh.worked_example: 想象整个过程。什么是绝对必须最先发生的?

feedback.correct: 种植、浇水、发芽、生长——整个过程,顺序正确。🌱
feedback.incorrect: 种子发芽之前,必须先发生什么?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 手順を聞こう。正しい順番に並べよう。
ja.audio_text: まず種を植える。それから水をやる。それから芽が出る。それから植物に育つ。
hints: 植えられる前に、何も芽を出すことはできない。
ja.worked_example: 全体の流れを想像しよう。絶対に最初に起こることは何?

feedback.correct: 植える、水をやる、芽が出る、育つ - 全部の過程を順番にできたね。🌱
feedback.incorrect: 種が芽を出す前に、何が起こる必要がある?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 먼저 씨앗을 심어요. 그다음 물을 줘요. 그다음 싹이 나요. 그다음 식물로 자라요.
hints: 심기 전에는 아무것도 싹을 틔울 수 없어요.
ko.worked_example: 전체 과정을 떠올려 보세요. 가장 먼저 일어나야 하는 일은 무엇인가요?

feedback.correct: 심기, 물 주기, 싹 나기, 자라기 - 전체 과정을 순서대로 맞혔어요. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: 씨앗이 싹을 틔우기도 전에 무슨 일이 먼저 일어나야 하나요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Pertama tanam bijinya. Lalu siram dengan air. Lalu ia bertunas. Lalu ia tumbuh menjadi tumbuhan.
hints: Tidak ada yang bisa bertunas sebelum ditanam.
id.worked_example: Bayangkan seluruh prosesnya. Apa yang pasti harus terjadi lebih dulu?

feedback.correct: Tanam, siram, bertunas, tumbuh - seluruh proses, secara berurutan. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Apa yang harus terjadi sebelum biji bisa bertunas?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe các bước. Sắp xếp theo đúng thứ tự.
vi.audio_text: Đầu tiên gieo hạt. Sau đó tưới nước. Sau đó nó nảy mầm. Sau đó nó lớn thành cây.
hints: Không có gì nảy mầm được trước khi nó được gieo.
vi.worked_example: Hãy hình dung toàn bộ quá trình. Điều gì chắc chắn phải xảy ra đầu tiên?

feedback.correct: Gieo hạt, tưới nước, nảy mầm, lớn lên - toàn bộ quá trình, theo đúng thứ tự. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Điều gì phải xảy ra trước khi hạt có thể nảy mầm?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen to the steps. Put them in order.
questions.audio_text: First clouds form. Then it rains. Then puddles form. Then the sun dries them up.
hints: Rain can't happen before clouds form.
questions.worked_example: Picture the whole process. What absolutely has to happen first?

feedback.correct: Clouds, rain, puddles, dry - the whole cycle, in order. 🌦️
feedback.incorrect: What has to happen in the sky before it can rain?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: sequencing a spoken science process

life_skill.hidden_lesson: This little cycle repeats constantly, all around the world.

analysis.primary_construct: holding several spoken steps in mind and ordering them correctly
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Science processes (growth, life cycles, water cycle) are inherently sequential - this tests that structure directly.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Correct final state but wrong middle order shows the process's outcome, not its stages, is understood.
analysis.parent_note: Understanding that science happens in stages, not all at once, is a big conceptual step.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Talk through a familiar process (like making toast) in careful order together.

es.instruction: Escucha los pasos. Ponlos en orden.
es.audio_text: Primero se forman las nubes. Luego llueve. Luego se forman charcos. Luego el sol los seca.
hints: No puede llover antes de que se formen las nubes.
es.worked_example: Imagina todo el proceso. ¿Qué tiene que pasar primero sin duda?

feedback.correct: Nubes, lluvia, charcos, secar - todo el ciclo, en orden. 🌦️
feedback.incorrect: ¿Qué tiene que pasar en el cielo antes de que pueda llover?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute les étapes. Mets-les dans l'ordre.
fr.audio_text: D'abord des nuages se forment. Puis il pleut. Puis des flaques se forment. Puis le soleil les assèche.
hints: La pluie ne peut pas arriver avant que les nuages se forment.
fr.worked_example: Imagine tout le processus. Qu'est-ce qui doit absolument arriver en premier ?

feedback.correct: Nuages, pluie, flaques, séchage - tout le cycle, dans l'ordre. 🌦️
feedback.incorrect: Que doit-il se passer dans le ciel avant qu'il puisse pleuvoir ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute os passos. Coloque-os em ordem.
pt.audio_text: Primeiro as nuvens se formam. Depois chove. Depois se formam poças. Depois o sol as seca.
hints: A chuva não pode acontecer antes de as nuvens se formarem.
pt.worked_example: Imagine todo o processo. O que precisa acontecer primeiro, sem dúvida?

feedback.correct: Nuvens, chuva, poças, secar - todo o ciclo, em ordem. 🌦️
feedback.incorrect: O que precisa acontecer no céu antes que possa chover?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta i passaggi. Mettili in ordine.
it.audio_text: Prima si formano le nuvole. Poi piove. Poi si formano le pozzanghere. Poi il sole le asciuga.
hints: Non può piovere prima che si formino le nuvole.
it.worked_example: Immagina tutto il processo. Cosa deve assolutamente accadere prima?

feedback.correct: Nuvole, pioggia, pozzanghere, asciugatura - tutto il ciclo, in ordine. 🌦️
feedback.incorrect: Cosa deve succedere nel cielo prima che possa piovere?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

de.instruction: Höre die Schritte. Bringe sie in die richtige Reihenfolge.
de.audio_text: Zuerst bilden sich Wolken. Dann regnet es. Dann bilden sich Pfützen. Dann trocknet die Sonne sie aus.
hints: Regen kann nicht fallen, bevor sich Wolken gebildet haben.
de.worked_example: Stell dir den ganzen Vorgang vor. Was muss unbedingt zuerst passieren?

feedback.correct: Wolken, Regen, Pfützen, trocknen – der ganze Kreislauf, in der richtigen Reihenfolge. 🌦️
feedback.incorrect: Was muss am Himmel passieren, bevor es regnen kann?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar de stappen. Zet ze in de juiste volgorde.
nl.audio_text: Eerst vormen zich wolken. Dan regent het. Dan vormen zich plassen. Dan droogt de zon ze op.
hints: Regen kan niet gebeuren voordat wolken zich vormen.
nl.worked_example: Stel je het hele proces voor. Wat moet absoluut eerst gebeuren?

feedback.correct: Wolken, regen, plassen, opdrogen - de hele cyclus, in volgorde. 🌦️
feedback.incorrect: Wat moet er in de lucht gebeuren voordat het kan regenen?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Слушай шаги. Расставь их по порядку.
ru.audio_text: Сначала образуются облака. Потом идёт дождь. Потом образуются лужи. Потом солнце их высушивает.
hints: Дождь не может пойти, прежде чем образуются облака.
ru.worked_example: Представь весь процесс. Что обязательно должно произойти первым?

feedback.correct: Облака, дождь, лужи, высушивание — весь цикл, по порядку. 🌦️
feedback.incorrect: Что должно произойти в небе, прежде чем пойдёт дождь?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Önce bulutlar oluşur. Sonra yağmur yağar. Sonra su birikintileri oluşur. Sonra güneş onları kurutur.
hints: Bulutlar oluşmadan yağmur yağamaz.
tr.worked_example: Tüm süreci gözünde canlandır. İlk önce mutlaka ne olması gerekir?

feedback.correct: Bulutlar, yağmur, su birikintileri, kuruma - tüm döngü, sırasıyla. 🌦️
feedback.incorrect: Yağmur yağmadan önce gökyüzünde ne olması gerekir?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 听步骤。把它们按顺序排列。
zh.audio_text: 先形成云。然后下雨。然后形成水坑。然后太阳把它们晒干。
hints: 没有先形成云,就不可能下雨。
zh.worked_example: 想象整个过程。什么是绝对必须最先发生的?

feedback.correct: 云、雨、水坑、晒干——整个循环,顺序正确。🌦️
feedback.incorrect: 下雨之前,天空中必须先发生什么?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 手順を聞こう。正しい順番に並べよう。
ja.audio_text: まず雲ができる。それから雨が降る。それから水たまりができる。それから太陽が乾かす。
hints: 雲ができる前に、雨は降らない。
ja.worked_example: 全体の流れを想像しよう。絶対に最初に起こることは何?

feedback.correct: 雲、雨、水たまり、乾く - 全部のサイクルを順番にできたね。🌦️
feedback.incorrect: 雨が降る前に、空で何が起こる必要がある?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 먼저 구름이 생겨요. 그다음 비가 내려요. 그다음 물웅덩이가 생겨요. 그다음 해가 그것을 말려요.
hints: 구름이 생기기 전에는 비가 내릴 수 없어요.
ko.worked_example: 전체 과정을 떠올려 보세요. 가장 먼저 일어나야 하는 일은 무엇인가요?

feedback.correct: 구름, 비, 물웅덩이, 마르기 - 전체 순환을 순서대로 맞혔어요. 🌦️
feedback.incorrect: 비가 내리기 전에 하늘에서 무슨 일이 먼저 일어나야 하나요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Pertama awan terbentuk. Lalu hujan turun. Lalu air menggenang. Lalu matahari mengeringkannya.
hints: Hujan tidak bisa turun sebelum awan terbentuk.
id.worked_example: Bayangkan seluruh prosesnya. Apa yang pasti harus terjadi lebih dulu?

feedback.correct: Awan, hujan, air menggenang, kering - seluruh siklus, secara berurutan. 🌦️
feedback.incorrect: Apa yang harus terjadi di langit sebelum hujan bisa turun?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe các bước. Sắp xếp theo đúng thứ tự.
vi.audio_text: Đầu tiên mây hình thành. Sau đó mưa rơi. Sau đó vũng nước đọng lại. Sau đó nắng làm khô chúng.
hints: Mưa không thể xảy ra trước khi mây hình thành.
vi.worked_example: Hãy hình dung toàn bộ quá trình. Điều gì chắc chắn phải xảy ra đầu tiên?

feedback.correct: Mây, mưa, vũng nước, khô - toàn bộ vòng tuần hoàn, theo đúng thứ tự. 🌦️
feedback.incorrect: Điều gì phải xảy ra trên trời trước khi mưa có thể rơi?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen to the steps. Put them in order.
questions.audio_text: First you wake up hungry. Then you eat food. Then your body digests it. Then you feel full of energy.
hints: Digestion happens after eating, before you feel the energy.
questions.worked_example: Picture the whole process. What absolutely has to happen first?

feedback.correct: Hungry, eat, digest, energised - the whole process, in order. 🍽️
feedback.incorrect: What has to happen between eating and feeling energised?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: sequencing a spoken science process

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Your body needs a little time to turn food into usable energy.

analysis.primary_construct: holding several spoken steps in mind and ordering them correctly
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Science processes (growth, life cycles, water cycle) are inherently sequential - this tests that structure directly.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Correct final state but wrong middle order shows the process's outcome, not its stages, is understood.
analysis.parent_note: Understanding that science happens in stages, not all at once, is a big conceptual step.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Talk through a familiar process (like making toast) in careful order together.

es.instruction: Escucha los pasos. Ponlos en orden.
es.audio_text: Primero te despiertas con hambre. Luego comes. Luego tu cuerpo lo digiere. Luego te sientes lleno de energía.
hints: La digestión ocurre después de comer, antes de sentir la energía.
es.worked_example: Imagina todo el proceso. ¿Qué tiene que pasar primero sin duda?

feedback.correct: Hambre, comer, digerir, con energía - todo el proceso, en orden. 🍽️
feedback.incorrect: ¿Qué tiene que pasar entre comer y sentirte con energía?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute les étapes. Mets-les dans l'ordre.
fr.audio_text: D'abord tu te réveilles affamé. Puis tu manges. Puis ton corps le digère. Puis tu te sens plein d'énergie.
hints: La digestion se passe après avoir mangé, avant de sentir l'énergie.
fr.worked_example: Imagine tout le processus. Qu'est-ce qui doit absolument arriver en premier ?

feedback.correct: Affamé, manger, digérer, énergisé - tout le processus, dans l'ordre. 🍽️
feedback.incorrect: Que doit-il se passer entre manger et se sentir plein d'énergie ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute os passos. Coloque-os em ordem.
pt.audio_text: Primeiro você acorda com fome. Depois você come. Depois seu corpo digere a comida. Depois você se sente cheio de energia.
hints: A digestão acontece depois de comer, antes de você sentir a energia.
pt.worked_example: Imagine todo o processo. O que precisa acontecer primeiro, sem dúvida?

feedback.correct: Fome, comer, digerir, energizado - todo o processo, em ordem. 🍽️
feedback.incorrect: O que precisa acontecer entre comer e se sentir energizado?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta i passaggi. Mettili in ordine.
it.audio_text: Prima ti svegli affamato. Poi mangi. Poi il tuo corpo lo digerisce. Poi ti senti pieno di energia.
hints: La digestione avviene dopo aver mangiato, prima di sentire l'energia.
it.worked_example: Immagina tutto il processo. Cosa deve assolutamente accadere prima?

feedback.correct: Affamato, mangia, digerisce, energico - tutto il processo, in ordine. 🍽️
feedback.incorrect: Cosa deve succedere tra il mangiare e il sentirsi pieno di energia?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

de.instruction: Höre die Schritte. Bringe sie in die richtige Reihenfolge.
de.audio_text: Zuerst wachst du hungrig auf. Dann isst du etwas. Dann verdaut dein Körper es. Dann fühlst du dich voller Energie.
hints: Die Verdauung passiert nach dem Essen, bevor du die Energie fühlst.
de.worked_example: Stell dir den ganzen Vorgang vor. Was muss unbedingt zuerst passieren?

feedback.correct: Hungrig, essen, verdauen, voller Energie – der ganze Vorgang, in der richtigen Reihenfolge. 🍽️
feedback.incorrect: Was muss zwischen dem Essen und dem Energie-Gefühl passieren?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar de stappen. Zet ze in de juiste volgorde.
nl.audio_text: Eerst word je hongerig wakker. Dan eet je voedsel. Dan verteert je lichaam het. Dan voel je je vol energie.
hints: Vertering gebeurt na het eten, voordat je de energie voelt.
nl.worked_example: Stel je het hele proces voor. Wat moet absoluut eerst gebeuren?

feedback.correct: Hongerig, eten, verteren, energiek - het hele proces, in volgorde. 🍽️
feedback.incorrect: Wat moet er gebeuren tussen eten en je energiek voelen?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Слушай шаги. Расставь их по порядку.
ru.audio_text: Сначала ты просыпаешься голодным. Потом ты ешь еду. Потом твой организм её переваривает. Потом ты чувствуешь прилив энергии.
hints: Пищеварение происходит после еды, прежде чем ты почувствуешь энергию.
ru.worked_example: Представь весь процесс. Что обязательно должно произойти первым?

feedback.correct: Голод, еда, пищеварение, энергия — весь процесс, по порядку. 🍽️
feedback.incorrect: Что должно произойти между едой и ощущением прилива энергии?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Önce acıkmış şekilde uyanırsın. Sonra yemek yersin. Sonra vücudun onu sindirir. Sonra enerjin dolar.
hints: Sindirim, yemekten sonra ve enerjiyi hissetmeden önce gerçekleşir.
tr.worked_example: Tüm süreci gözünde canlandır. İlk önce mutlaka ne olması gerekir?

feedback.correct: Acıkma, yeme, sindirim, enerji - tüm süreç, sırasıyla. 🍽️
feedback.incorrect: Yemek yemek ile enerji dolu hissetmek arasında ne olması gerekir?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 听步骤。把它们按顺序排列。
zh.audio_text: 先你饿醒了。然后你吃东西。然后身体消化食物。然后你感到精力充沛。
hints: 消化发生在吃东西之后,感到精力充沛之前。
zh.worked_example: 想象整个过程。什么是绝对必须最先发生的?

feedback.correct: 饥饿、吃东西、消化、充满活力——整个过程,顺序正确。🍽️
feedback.incorrect: 吃东西和感到精力充沛之间,必须先发生什么?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 手順を聞こう。正しい順番に並べよう。
ja.audio_text: まずお腹を空かせて起きる。それから食べ物を食べる。それから体がそれを消化する。それからエネルギーに満ちていると感じる。
options: お腹を空かせて起きる
エネルギーに満ちていると感じる
correct_answer: お腹を空かせて起きる
エネルギーに満ちていると感じる
accepted_answers: お腹を空かせて起きる
エネルギーに満ちていると感じる
hints: 消化は食べた後、エネルギーを感じる前に起こる。
ja.worked_example: 全体の流れを想像しよう。絶対に最初に起こることは何?

feedback.correct: 空腹、食べる、消化、元気 - 全部の過程を順番にできたね。🍽️
feedback.incorrect: 食べることと元気に感じることの間に、何が起こる必要がある?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 먼저 배고프게 잠에서 깨요. 그다음 음식을 먹어요. 그다음 몸이 그것을 소화해요. 그다음 기운이 넘치는 걸 느껴요.
hints: 소화는 먹은 후, 기운을 느끼기 전에 일어나요.
ko.worked_example: 전체 과정을 떠올려 보세요. 가장 먼저 일어나야 하는 일은 무엇인가요?

feedback.correct: 배고픔, 먹기, 소화, 기운 넘침 - 전체 과정을 순서대로 맞혔어요. 🍽️
feedback.incorrect: 먹는 것과 기운이 넘치는 것을 느끼는 것 사이에 무슨 일이 일어나야 하나요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Pertama kamu bangun dalam keadaan lapar. Lalu kamu makan makanan. Lalu tubuhmu mencernanya. Lalu kamu merasa penuh energi.
hints: Pencernaan terjadi setelah makan, sebelum kamu merasakan energinya.
id.worked_example: Bayangkan seluruh prosesnya. Apa yang pasti harus terjadi lebih dulu?

feedback.correct: Lapar, makan, mencerna, berenergi - seluruh proses, secara berurutan. 🍽️
feedback.incorrect: Apa yang harus terjadi di antara makan dan merasa berenergi?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe các bước. Sắp xếp theo đúng thứ tự.
vi.audio_text: Đầu tiên bạn thức dậy và đói. Sau đó bạn ăn thức ăn. Sau đó cơ thể bạn tiêu hóa nó. Sau đó bạn cảm thấy đầy năng lượng.
hints: Tiêu hóa xảy ra sau khi ăn, trước khi bạn cảm thấy có năng lượng.
vi.worked_example: Hãy hình dung toàn bộ quá trình. Điều gì chắc chắn phải xảy ra đầu tiên?

feedback.correct: Đói, ăn, tiêu hóa, đầy năng lượng - toàn bộ quá trình, theo đúng thứ tự. 🍽️
feedback.incorrect: Điều gì phải xảy ra giữa việc ăn và cảm thấy có năng lượng?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen to the steps. Put them in order.
questions.audio_text: First the volcano builds up pressure. Then it erupts. Then lava flows out. Then it cools into new rock.
hints: Pressure builds quietly for a long time before anything happens.
questions.worked_example: Picture the whole process. What absolutely has to happen first?

feedback.correct: Pressure, erupt, flow, cool - the whole process, in order. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: What happens deep underground for a long time before an eruption?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: sequencing a spoken science process

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Volcanoes can be quiet for years while pressure slowly builds underground.

analysis.primary_construct: holding several spoken steps in mind and ordering them correctly
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Science processes (growth, life cycles, water cycle) are inherently sequential - this tests that structure directly.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Correct final state but wrong middle order shows the process's outcome, not its stages, is understood.
analysis.parent_note: Understanding that science happens in stages, not all at once, is a big conceptual step.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Talk through a familiar process (like making toast) in careful order together.

es.instruction: Escucha los pasos. Ponlos en orden.
es.audio_text: Primero el volcán acumula presión. Luego entra en erupción. Luego la lava fluye hacia afuera. Luego se enfría y se convierte en roca nueva.
hints: La presión se acumula en silencio durante mucho tiempo antes de que pase algo.
es.worked_example: Imagina todo el proceso. ¿Qué tiene que pasar primero sin duda?

feedback.correct: Presión, erupción, flujo, enfriar - todo el proceso, en orden. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: ¿Qué pasa en el fondo bajo tierra durante mucho tiempo antes de una erupción?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute les étapes. Mets-les dans l'ordre.
fr.audio_text: D'abord le volcan accumule de la pression. Puis il entre en éruption. Puis la lave s'écoule. Puis elle refroidit en nouvelle roche.
hints: La pression s'accumule tranquillement pendant longtemps avant que quoi que ce soit n'arrive.
fr.worked_example: Imagine tout le processus. Qu'est-ce qui doit absolument arriver en premier ?

feedback.correct: Pression, éruption, écoulement, refroidissement - tout le processus, dans l'ordre. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: Que se passe-t-il profondément sous terre pendant longtemps avant une éruption ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute os passos. Coloque-os em ordem.
pt.audio_text: Primeiro o vulcão acumula pressão. Depois ele entra em erupção. Depois a lava flui para fora. Depois ela esfria e se transforma em rocha nova.
options: esfriar e se transformar em rocha nova
correct_answer: esfriar e se transformar em rocha nova
accepted_answers: esfriar e se transformar em rocha nova
hints: A pressão se acumula silenciosamente por muito tempo antes de qualquer coisa acontecer.
pt.worked_example: Imagine todo o processo. O que precisa acontecer primeiro, sem dúvida?

feedback.correct: Pressão, erupção, fluxo, esfriar - todo o processo, em ordem. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: O que acontece no subsolo por muito tempo antes de uma erupção?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta i passaggi. Mettili in ordine.
it.audio_text: Prima il vulcano accumula pressione. Poi erutta. Poi la lava fuoriesce. Poi si raffredda formando nuova roccia.
hints: La pressione si accumula silenziosamente per molto tempo prima che accada qualcosa.
it.worked_example: Immagina tutto il processo. Cosa deve assolutamente accadere prima?

feedback.correct: Pressione, eruzione, flusso, raffreddamento - tutto il processo, in ordine. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: Cosa succede in profondità nel sottosuolo per molto tempo prima di un'eruzione?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

de.instruction: Höre die Schritte. Bringe sie in die richtige Reihenfolge.
de.audio_text: Zuerst baut der Vulkan Druck auf. Dann bricht er aus. Dann fließt Lava heraus. Dann kühlt sie zu neuem Gestein ab.
hints: Der Druck baut sich lange Zeit leise auf, bevor etwas passiert.
de.worked_example: Stell dir den ganzen Vorgang vor. Was muss unbedingt zuerst passieren?

feedback.correct: Druck, Ausbruch, Fließen, Abkühlen – der ganze Vorgang, in der richtigen Reihenfolge. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: Was passiert lange Zeit tief unter der Erde, bevor es zu einem Ausbruch kommt?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar de stappen. Zet ze in de juiste volgorde.
nl.audio_text: Eerst bouwt de vulkaan druk op. Dan barst hij uit. Dan stroomt lava naar buiten. Dan koelt het af tot nieuw gesteente.
hints: Druk bouwt zich lang stilletjes op voordat er iets gebeurt.
nl.worked_example: Stel je het hele proces voor. Wat moet absoluut eerst gebeuren?

feedback.correct: Druk, uitbarsten, stromen, afkoelen - het hele proces, in volgorde. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: Wat gebeurt er diep onder de grond lange tijd voordat een uitbarsting plaatsvindt?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Слушай шаги. Расставь их по порядку.
ru.audio_text: Сначала в вулкане нарастает давление. Потом он извергается. Потом вытекает лава. Потом она застывает в новую породу.
hints: Давление нарастает незаметно долгое время, прежде чем что-то произойдёт.
ru.worked_example: Представь весь процесс. Что обязательно должно произойти первым?

feedback.correct: Давление, извержение, поток лавы, застывание — весь процесс, по порядку. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: Что происходит глубоко под землёй долгое время перед извержением?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Önce volkanda basınç birikir. Sonra patlar. Sonra lav dışarı akar. Sonra soğuyarak yeni kayaya dönüşür.
hints: Hiçbir şey olmadan önce basınç uzun süre sessizce birikir.
tr.worked_example: Tüm süreci gözünde canlandır. İlk önce mutlaka ne olması gerekir?

feedback.correct: Basınç, patlama, akış, soğuma - tüm süreç, sırasıyla. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: Bir patlamadan önce yerin çok altında uzun süre ne olur?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 听步骤。把它们按顺序排列。
zh.audio_text: 先火山积累压力。然后它爆发。然后岩浆流出来。然后它冷却成新的岩石。
hints: 压力会在很长一段时间里悄悄积累,然后才发生任何事。
zh.worked_example: 想象整个过程。什么是绝对必须最先发生的?

feedback.correct: 积累压力、爆发、流出、冷却——整个过程,顺序正确。🌋
feedback.incorrect: 在爆发之前,地底深处会发生什么,持续很长时间?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 手順を聞こう。正しい順番に並べよう。
ja.audio_text: まず火山に圧力がたまる。それから噴火する。それから溶岩が流れ出す。それから冷えて新しい岩になる。
options: 冷えて新しい岩になる
correct_answer: 冷えて新しい岩になる
accepted_answers: 冷えて新しい岩になる
hints: 何かが起こる前に、圧力は長い間静かにたまっていく。
ja.worked_example: 全体の流れを想像しよう。絶対に最初に起こることは何?

feedback.correct: 圧力、噴火、流れる、冷える - 全部の過程を順番にできたね。🌋
feedback.incorrect: 噴火の前、地下深くで長い間何が起きている?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 먼저 화산에 압력이 쌓여요. 그다음 폭발해요. 그다음 용암이 흘러나와요. 그다음 식어서 새로운 돌이 돼요.
hints: 아무 일이 일어나기 전, 오랫동안 조용히 압력이 쌓여요.
ko.worked_example: 전체 과정을 떠올려 보세요. 가장 먼저 일어나야 하는 일은 무엇인가요?

feedback.correct: 압력, 폭발, 흐르기, 식기 - 전체 과정을 순서대로 맞혔어요. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: 폭발 전에 땅속 깊은 곳에서 오랫동안 무슨 일이 일어나나요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Pertama gunung berapi membangun tekanan. Lalu ia meletus. Lalu lava mengalir keluar. Lalu lava mendingin menjadi batu baru.
hints: Tekanan membangun diam-diam untuk waktu yang lama sebelum terjadi apa-apa.
id.worked_example: Bayangkan seluruh prosesnya. Apa yang pasti harus terjadi lebih dulu?

feedback.correct: Tekanan, meletus, mengalir, mendingin - seluruh proses, secara berurutan. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: Apa yang terjadi jauh di bawah tanah dalam waktu lama sebelum letusan?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe các bước. Sắp xếp theo đúng thứ tự.
vi.audio_text: Đầu tiên núi lửa tích tụ áp suất. Sau đó nó phun trào. Sau đó dung nham chảy ra. Sau đó nó nguội thành đá mới.
hints: Áp suất tích tụ âm thầm trong thời gian dài trước khi có bất kỳ điều gì xảy ra.
vi.worked_example: Hãy hình dung toàn bộ quá trình. Điều gì chắc chắn phải xảy ra đầu tiên?

feedback.correct: Áp suất, phun trào, chảy ra, nguội - toàn bộ quá trình, theo đúng thứ tự. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: Điều gì xảy ra sâu dưới lòng đất trong thời gian dài trước khi phun trào?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen to the steps. Put them in order.
questions.audio_text: First a tadpole hatches from an egg. Then it grows legs. Then its tail shrinks. Then it becomes a frog.
hints: The tadpole starts inside an egg.
questions.worked_example: Picture the whole process. What absolutely has to happen first?

feedback.correct: Hatch, grow legs, lose tail, frog - the whole life cycle, in order. 🐸
feedback.incorrect: Which stage is the very beginning of a frog's life?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: sequencing a spoken science process

life_skill.hidden_lesson: A tadpole looks nothing like a frog at first - the change is huge.

analysis.primary_construct: holding several spoken steps in mind and ordering them correctly
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Science processes (growth, life cycles, water cycle) are inherently sequential - this tests that structure directly.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Correct final state but wrong middle order shows the process's outcome, not its stages, is understood.
analysis.parent_note: Understanding that science happens in stages, not all at once, is a big conceptual step.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Talk through a familiar process (like making toast) in careful order together.

es.instruction: Escucha los pasos. Ponlos en orden.
es.audio_text: Primero un renacuajo sale de un huevo. Luego le crecen patas. Luego su cola se encoge. Luego se convierte en rana.
hints: El renacuajo empieza dentro de un huevo.
es.worked_example: Imagina todo el proceso. ¿Qué tiene que pasar primero sin duda?

feedback.correct: Salir del huevo, crecer patas, perder la cola, rana - todo el ciclo de vida, en orden. 🐸
feedback.incorrect: ¿Qué etapa es el comienzo mismo de la vida de una rana?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute les étapes. Mets-les dans l'ordre.
fr.audio_text: D'abord un tétard sort de l'œuf. Puis il fait pousser des pattes. Puis sa queue rétrécit. Puis il devient une grenouille.
hints: Le tétard commence à l'intérieur d'un œuf.
fr.worked_example: Imagine tout le processus. Qu'est-ce qui doit absolument arriver en premier ?

feedback.correct: Sortir de l'œuf, pousser des pattes, perdre la queue, grenouille - tout le cycle de vie, dans l'ordre. 🐸
feedback.incorrect: Quelle étape marque le tout début de la vie d'une grenouille ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute os passos. Coloque-os em ordem.
pt.audio_text: Primeiro um girino nasce de um ovo. Depois ele desenvolve pernas. Depois a cauda dele encolhe. Depois ele se torna um sapo.
hints: O girino começa dentro de um ovo.
pt.worked_example: Imagine todo o processo. O que precisa acontecer primeiro, sem dúvida?

feedback.correct: Nascer, desenvolver pernas, perder a cauda, sapo - todo o ciclo de vida, em ordem. 🐸
feedback.incorrect: Qual estágio é o início da vida de um sapo?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta i passaggi. Mettili in ordine.
it.audio_text: Prima un girino si schiude da un uovo. Poi gli crescono le zampe. Poi la coda si riduce. Poi diventa una rana.
hints: Il girino inizia dentro un uovo.
it.worked_example: Immagina tutto il processo. Cosa deve assolutamente accadere prima?

feedback.correct: Schiusa, crescita delle zampe, perdita della coda, rana - tutto il ciclo di vita, in ordine. 🐸
feedback.incorrect: Quale fase è l'inizio della vita di una rana?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

de.instruction: Höre die Schritte. Bringe sie in die richtige Reihenfolge.
de.audio_text: Zuerst schlüpft eine Kaulquappe aus einem Ei. Dann wachsen ihr Beine. Dann wird ihr Schwanz kleiner. Dann wird sie zu einem Frosch.
hints: Die Kaulquappe beginnt in einem Ei.
de.worked_example: Stell dir den ganzen Vorgang vor. Was muss unbedingt zuerst passieren?

feedback.correct: Schlüpfen, Beine wachsen, Schwanz verlieren, Frosch – der ganze Lebenszyklus, in der richtigen Reihenfolge. 🐸
feedback.incorrect: Welche Stufe ist der ganz Anfang im Leben eines Frosches?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar de stappen. Zet ze in de juiste volgorde.
nl.audio_text: Eerst komt een kikkervisje uit een ei. Dan krijgt het poten. Dan krimpt zijn staart. Dan wordt het een kikker.
hints: Het kikkervisje begint in een ei.
nl.worked_example: Stel je het hele proces voor. Wat moet absoluut eerst gebeuren?

feedback.correct: Uitkomen, poten krijgen, staart verliezen, kikker - de hele levenscyclus, in volgorde. 🐸
feedback.incorrect: Welke fase is het allereerste begin van het leven van een kikker?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Слушай шаги. Расставь их по порядку.
ru.audio_text: Сначала головастик вылупляется из яйца. Потом у него отрастают лапки. Потом его хвост уменьшается. Потом он становится лягушкой.
hints: Головастик начинает жизнь внутри яйца.
ru.worked_example: Представь весь процесс. Что обязательно должно произойти первым?

feedback.correct: Вылупление, лапки, потеря хвоста, лягушка — весь жизненный цикл, по порядку. 🐸
feedback.incorrect: Какая стадия — самое начало жизни лягушки?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Önce bir kurbağa larvası yumurtadan çıkar. Sonra bacakları uzar. Sonra kuyruğu küçülür. Sonra bir kurbağaya dönüşür.
hints: Kurbağa larvası bir yumurtanın içinde başlar.
tr.worked_example: Tüm süreci gözünde canlandır. İlk önce mutlaka ne olması gerekir?

feedback.correct: Yumurtadan çıkma, bacak büyümesi, kuyruk kaybı, kurbağa - tüm yaşam döngüsü, sırasıyla. 🐸
feedback.incorrect: Bir kurbağanın hayatının en başlangıcı hangi aşamadır?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 听步骤。把它们按顺序排列。
zh.audio_text: 先蝌蚪从卵里孵出来。然后它长出腿。然后尾巴变短。然后它变成一只青蛙。
hints: 蝌蚪最初是在卵里的。
zh.worked_example: 想象整个过程。什么是绝对必须最先发生的?

feedback.correct: 孵出、长腿、失去尾巴、变成青蛙——整个生命周期,顺序正确。🐸
feedback.incorrect: 哪个阶段是青蛙生命最开始的阶段?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 手順を聞こう。正しい順番に並べよう。
ja.audio_text: まずおたまじゃくしが卵から生まれる。それから足が育つ。それから尾が縮む。それからカエルになる。
hints: おたまじゃくしは卵の中から始まる。
ja.worked_example: 全体の流れを想像しよう。絶対に最初に起こることは何?

feedback.correct: 生まれる、足が育つ、尾がなくなる、カエル - 一生のサイクル全部を順番にできたね。🐸
feedback.incorrect: カエルの一生のいちばん最初の段階はどれ?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 먼저 올챙이가 알에서 나와요. 그다음 다리가 자라요. 그다음 꼬리가 줄어들어요. 그다음 개구리가 돼요.
hints: 올챙이는 알 속에서 시작해요.
ko.worked_example: 전체 과정을 떠올려 보세요. 가장 먼저 일어나야 하는 일은 무엇인가요?

feedback.correct: 알에서 나오기, 다리 자라기, 꼬리 없어지기, 개구리 되기 - 한살이 전체를 순서대로 맞혔어요. 🐸
feedback.incorrect: 개구리의 삶에서 가장 처음 단계는 무엇인가요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Pertama berudu menetas dari telur. Lalu ia tumbuh kaki. Lalu ekornya menyusut. Lalu ia menjadi katak.
hints: Berudu mulai di dalam telur.
id.worked_example: Bayangkan seluruh prosesnya. Apa yang pasti harus terjadi lebih dulu?

feedback.correct: Menetas, tumbuh kaki, ekor menyusut, jadi katak - seluruh siklus hidup, secara berurutan. 🐸
feedback.incorrect: Tahap mana yang menjadi awal mula kehidupan katak?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe các bước. Sắp xếp theo đúng thứ tự.
vi.audio_text: Đầu tiên nòng nọc nở ra từ trứng. Sau đó nó mọc chân. Sau đó đuôi của nó ngắn lại. Sau đó nó trở thành ếch.
hints: Nòng nọc bắt đầu cuộc đời bên trong một quả trứng.
vi.worked_example: Hãy hình dung toàn bộ quá trình. Điều gì chắc chắn phải xảy ra đầu tiên?

feedback.correct: Nở ra, mọc chân, mất đuôi, thành ếch - toàn bộ vòng đời, theo đúng thứ tự. 🐸
feedback.incorrect: Giai đoạn nào là khởi đầu của cuộc đời con ếch?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen to the steps. Put them in order.
questions.audio_text: First you get a cut. Then it bleeds a little. Then a scab forms. Then new skin grows underneath.
hints: Bleeding happens right after the cut, before any scab.
questions.worked_example: Picture the whole process. What absolutely has to happen first?

feedback.correct: Cut, bleed, scab, heal - your body's whole healing process, in order. 🩹
feedback.incorrect: What happens to a cut right after it happens, before it scabs over?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: sequencing a spoken science process

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Your body is quietly healing itself, in this exact order, every time you get a small cut.

analysis.primary_construct: holding several spoken steps in mind and ordering them correctly
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Science processes (growth, life cycles, water cycle) are inherently sequential - this tests that structure directly.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Correct final state but wrong middle order shows the process's outcome, not its stages, is understood.
analysis.parent_note: Understanding that science happens in stages, not all at once, is a big conceptual step.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Talk through a familiar process (like making toast) in careful order together.

es.instruction: Escucha los pasos. Ponlos en orden.
es.audio_text: Primero te haces una herida. Luego sangra un poco. Luego se forma una costra. Luego crece piel nueva debajo.
hints: El sangrado ocurre justo después de la herida, antes de la costra.
es.worked_example: Imagina todo el proceso. ¿Qué tiene que pasar primero sin duda?

feedback.correct: Herida, sangrar, costra, sanar - todo el proceso de curación de tu cuerpo, en orden. 🩹
feedback.incorrect: ¿Qué le pasa a una herida justo después de hacerse, antes de formar costra?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute les étapes. Mets-les dans l'ordre.
fr.audio_text: D'abord tu te coupes. Puis ça saigne un peu. Puis une croûte se forme. Puis une nouvelle peau pousse dessous.
hints: Le saignement arrive juste après la coupure, avant toute croûte.
fr.worked_example: Imagine tout le processus. Qu'est-ce qui doit absolument arriver en premier ?

feedback.correct: Coupure, saignement, croûte, guérison - tout le processus de guérison de ton corps, dans l'ordre. 🩹
feedback.incorrect: Que se passe-t-il juste après une coupure, avant qu'une croûte se forme ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute os passos. Coloque-os em ordem.
pt.audio_text: Primeiro você se corta. Depois sangra um pouco. Depois uma casquinha se forma. Depois uma pele nova cresce por baixo.
hints: O sangramento acontece logo após o corte, antes de qualquer casquinha.
pt.worked_example: Imagine todo o processo. O que precisa acontecer primeiro, sem dúvida?

feedback.correct: Corte, sangramento, casquinha, cicatrizar - todo o processo de cicatrização do seu corpo, em ordem. 🩹
feedback.incorrect: O que acontece com um corte logo depois dele, antes de formar a casquinha?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta i passaggi. Mettili in ordine.
it.audio_text: Prima ti fai un taglio. Poi sanguina un po'. Poi si forma una crosta. Poi sotto cresce nuova pelle.
hints: Il sanguinamento avviene subito dopo il taglio, prima della crosta.
it.worked_example: Immagina tutto il processo. Cosa deve assolutamente accadere prima?

feedback.correct: Taglio, sanguinamento, crosta, guarigione - tutto il processo di guarigione del tuo corpo, in ordine. 🩹
feedback.incorrect: Cosa succede a un taglio appena dopo essersi fatto, prima che si formi la crosta?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

de.instruction: Höre die Schritte. Bringe sie in die richtige Reihenfolge.
de.audio_text: Zuerst bekommst du einen Schnitt. Dann blutet er ein wenig. Dann bildet sich ein Schorf. Dann wächst darunter neue Haut.
hints: Das Bluten passiert direkt nach dem Schnitt, bevor sich ein Schorf bildet.
de.worked_example: Stell dir den ganzen Vorgang vor. Was muss unbedingt zuerst passieren?

feedback.correct: Schnitt, Bluten, Schorf, heilen – der ganze Heilungsprozess deines Körpers, in der richtigen Reihenfolge. 🩹
feedback.incorrect: Was passiert mit einem Schnitt direkt nachdem er entstanden ist, bevor sich ein Schorf bildet?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar de stappen. Zet ze in de juiste volgorde.
nl.audio_text: Eerst krijg je een snee. Dan bloedt het een beetje. Dan vormt zich een korstje. Dan groeit er nieuwe huid onder.
hints: Bloeden gebeurt meteen na de snee, voordat er een korstje is.
nl.worked_example: Stel je het hele proces voor. Wat moet absoluut eerst gebeuren?

feedback.correct: Snee, bloeden, korstje, genezen - het hele genezingsproces van je lichaam, in volgorde. 🩹
feedback.incorrect: Wat gebeurt er met een snee meteen nadat die ontstaat, voordat er een korstje op komt?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Слушай шаги. Расставь их по порядку.
ru.audio_text: Сначала ты получаешь порез. Потом он немного кровит. Потом образуется корочка. Потом под ней растёт новая кожа.
hints: Кровотечение происходит сразу после порезa, прежде чем образуется корочка.
ru.worked_example: Представь весь процесс. Что обязательно должно произойти первым?

feedback.correct: Порез, кровотечение, корочка, заживление — весь процесс заживления твоего тела, по порядку. 🩹
feedback.incorrect: Что происходит с порезом сразу после него, прежде чем образуется корочка?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Önce kesilirsin. Sonra biraz kanar. Sonra bir kabuk oluşur. Sonra altında yeni deri büyür.
hints: Kanama, kesikten hemen sonra ve kabuk oluşmadan önce gerçekleşir.
tr.worked_example: Tüm süreci gözünde canlandır. İlk önce mutlaka ne olması gerekir?

feedback.correct: Kesik, kanama, kabuk, iyileşme - vücudunun tüm iyileşme süreci, sırasıyla. 🩹
feedback.incorrect: Bir kesik olduktan hemen sonra ve kabuk tutmadan önce ona ne olur?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 听步骤。把它们按顺序排列。
zh.audio_text: 先你划伤了自己。然后流了一点血。然后结成了痂。然后下面长出新皮肤。
hints: 流血发生在划伤之后,结痂之前。
zh.worked_example: 想象整个过程。什么是绝对必须最先发生的?

feedback.correct: 划伤、流血、结痂、愈合——你身体整个愈合的过程,顺序正确。🩹
feedback.incorrect: 伤口受伤后、结痂之前,会发生什么?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 手順を聞こう。正しい順番に並べよう。
ja.audio_text: まず切り傷ができる。それから少し血が出る。それからかさぶたができる。それから下に新しい皮ふが育つ。
hints: 出血は切り傷のすぐ後、かさぶたができる前に起こる。
ja.worked_example: 全体の流れを想像しよう。絶対に最初に起こることは何?

feedback.correct: 切り傷、出血、かさぶた、治る - 体が治っていく過程全部を順番にできたね。🩹
feedback.incorrect: 切り傷ができたすぐ後、かさぶたができる前に何が起こる?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 먼저 상처가 나요. 그다음 피가 조금 나요. 그다음 딱지가 생겨요. 그다음 그 밑에서 새 살이 자라요.
hints: 피가 나는 것은 딱지가 생기기 전, 상처가 난 직후에 일어나요.
ko.worked_example: 전체 과정을 떠올려 보세요. 가장 먼저 일어나야 하는 일은 무엇인가요?

feedback.correct: 상처, 피, 딱지, 회복 - 몸이 치유되는 전체 과정을 순서대로 맞혔어요. 🩹
feedback.incorrect: 딱지가 생기기 전, 상처가 난 직후에 무슨 일이 일어나나요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Pertama kamu terluka. Lalu sedikit berdarah. Lalu koreng terbentuk. Lalu kulit baru tumbuh di bawahnya.
hints: Berdarah terjadi tepat setelah terluka, sebelum ada koreng.
id.worked_example: Bayangkan seluruh prosesnya. Apa yang pasti harus terjadi lebih dulu?

feedback.correct: Terluka, berdarah, koreng, sembuh - seluruh proses penyembuhan tubuhmu, secara berurutan. 🩹
feedback.incorrect: Apa yang terjadi pada luka tepat setelah terluka, sebelum berkoreng?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe các bước. Sắp xếp theo đúng thứ tự.
vi.audio_text: Đầu tiên bạn bị đứt tay. Sau đó nó chảy một ít máu. Sau đó hình thành vảy. Sau đó da mới mọc lên bên dưới.
hints: Chảy máu xảy ra ngay sau khi bị đứt, trước khi có vảy.
vi.worked_example: Hãy hình dung toàn bộ quá trình. Điều gì chắc chắn phải xảy ra đầu tiên?

feedback.correct: Đứt tay, chảy máu, vảy, lành - toàn bộ quá trình chữa lành của cơ thể, theo đúng thứ tự. 🩹
feedback.incorrect: Điều gì xảy ra với vết đứt ngay sau khi nó xảy ra, trước khi lên vảy?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen to the steps. Put them in order.
questions.audio_text: First energy from the sun reaches a plant. Then the plant uses it to make food. Then an animal eats the plant. Then the animal uses that energy to move.
hints: Energy starts with the sun, before anything else happens.
questions.worked_example: Picture the whole process. What absolutely has to happen first?
