feedback.correct: Sun, plant, animal eats, animal moves - the whole energy chain, in order. ☀️
feedback.incorrect: Where does all this energy ultimately begin?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: sequencing a spoken science process

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Almost all energy on Earth can be traced right back to the sun.

analysis.primary_construct: holding several spoken steps in mind and ordering them correctly
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Science processes (growth, life cycles, water cycle) are inherently sequential - this tests that structure directly.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Correct final state but wrong middle order shows the process's outcome, not its stages, is understood.
analysis.parent_note: Understanding that science happens in stages, not all at once, is a big conceptual step.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Talk through a familiar process (like making toast) in careful order together.

es.instruction: Escucha los pasos. Ponlos en orden.
es.audio_text: Primero la energía del sol llega a una planta. Luego la planta la usa para producir alimento. Luego un animal se come la planta. Luego el animal usa esa energía para moverse.
options: el sol llega a la planta
un animal se come la planta
correct_answer: el sol llega a la planta
un animal se come la planta
accepted_answers: el sol llega a la planta
un animal se come la planta
hints: La energía empieza con el sol, antes de que pase cualquier otra cosa.
es.worked_example: Imagina todo el proceso. ¿Qué tiene que pasar primero sin duda?

feedback.correct: Sol, planta, animal come, animal se mueve - toda la cadena de energía, en orden. ☀️
feedback.incorrect: ¿Dónde empieza en realidad toda esta energía?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute les étapes. Mets-les dans l'ordre.
fr.audio_text: D'abord l'énergie du soleil atteint une plante. Puis la plante l'utilise pour fabriquer de la nourriture. Puis un animal mange la plante. Puis l'animal utilise cette énergie pour se déplacer.
options: la plante fabrique de la nourriture
correct_answer: la plante fabrique de la nourriture
accepted_answers: la plante fabrique de la nourriture
hints: L'énergie commence avec le soleil, avant tout le reste.
fr.worked_example: Imagine tout le processus. Qu'est-ce qui doit absolument arriver en premier ?

feedback.correct: Soleil, plante, animal mange, animal se déplace - toute la chaîne d'énergie, dans l'ordre. ☀️
feedback.incorrect: D'où vient finalement toute cette énergie ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute os passos. Coloque-os em ordem.
pt.audio_text: Primeiro a energia do sol chega a uma planta. Depois a planta a usa para produzir alimento. Depois um animal come a planta. Depois o animal usa essa energia para se mover.
hints: A energia começa com o sol, antes de qualquer outra coisa acontecer.
pt.worked_example: Imagine todo o processo. O que precisa acontecer primeiro, sem dúvida?

feedback.correct: Sol, planta, animal come, animal se move - toda a cadeia de energia, em ordem. ☀️
feedback.incorrect: Onde toda essa energia realmente começa?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta i passaggi. Mettili in ordine.
it.audio_text: Prima l'energia del sole raggiunge una pianta. Poi la pianta la usa per produrre cibo. Poi un animale mangia la pianta. Poi l'animale usa quell'energia per muoversi.
hints: L'energia parte dal sole, prima che accada qualsiasi altra cosa.
it.worked_example: Immagina tutto il processo. Cosa deve assolutamente accadere prima?

feedback.correct: Sole, pianta, l'animale mangia, l'animale si muove - tutta la catena energetica, in ordine. ☀️
feedback.incorrect: Da dove inizia davvero tutta questa energia?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

de.instruction: Höre die Schritte. Bringe sie in die richtige Reihenfolge.
de.audio_text: Zuerst erreicht Energie von der Sonne eine Pflanze. Dann nutzt die Pflanze sie, um Nahrung herzustellen. Dann isst ein Tier die Pflanze. Dann nutzt das Tier diese Energie, um sich zu bewegen.
hints: Die Energie beginnt bei der Sonne, bevor irgendetwas anderes passiert.
de.worked_example: Stell dir den ganzen Vorgang vor. Was muss unbedingt zuerst passieren?

feedback.correct: Sonne, Pflanze, Tier isst, Tier bewegt sich – die ganze Energiekette, in der richtigen Reihenfolge. ☀️
feedback.incorrect: Wo beginnt diese ganze Energie letztendlich?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar de stappen. Zet ze in de juiste volgorde.
nl.audio_text: Eerst bereikt energie van de zon een plant. Dan gebruikt de plant het om voedsel te maken. Dan eet een dier de plant. Dan gebruikt het dier die energie om te bewegen.
hints: Energie begint bij de zon, voordat er iets anders gebeurt.
nl.worked_example: Stel je het hele proces voor. Wat moet absoluut eerst gebeuren?

feedback.correct: Zon, plant, dier eet, dier beweegt - de hele energieketen, in volgorde. ☀️
feedback.incorrect: Waar begint al deze energie uiteindelijk?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Слушай шаги. Расставь их по порядку.
ru.audio_text: Сначала энергия от солнца достигает растения. Потом растение использует её, чтобы производить пищу. Потом животное съедает растение. Потом животное использует эту энергию, чтобы двигаться.
hints: Энергия начинается с солнца, прежде чем происходит что-либо ещё.
ru.worked_example: Представь весь процесс. Что обязательно должно произойти первым?

feedback.correct: Солнце, растение, животное ест, животное двигается — вся цепочка энергии, по порядку. ☀️
feedback.incorrect: С чего в конечном итоге начинается вся эта энергия?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Önce güneşten gelen enerji bir bitkiye ulaşır. Sonra bitki onu besin üretmek için kullanır. Sonra bir hayvan bitkiyi yer. Sonra hayvan bu enerjiyi hareket etmek için kullanır.
hints: Enerji, başka her şeyden önce güneşle başlar.
tr.worked_example: Tüm süreci gözünde canlandır. İlk önce mutlaka ne olması gerekir?

feedback.correct: Güneş, bitki, hayvan yer, hayvan hareket eder - tüm enerji zinciri, sırasıyla. ☀️
feedback.incorrect: Bütün bu enerji sonunda nereden başlar?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 听步骤。把它们按顺序排列。
zh.audio_text: 先太阳的能量到达植物。然后植物用它制造食物。然后动物吃了这株植物。然后动物用这些能量来活动。
hints: 能量最先从太阳开始,然后才发生其他事情。
zh.worked_example: 想象整个过程。什么是绝对必须最先发生的?

feedback.correct: 太阳、植物、动物进食、动物活动——整个能量链,顺序正确。☀️
feedback.incorrect: 这所有的能量最终是从哪里开始的?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 手順を聞こう。正しい順番に並べよう。
ja.audio_text: まず太陽からのエネルギーが植物に届く。それから植物はそれを使って食べ物を作る。それから動物が植物を食べる。それから動物はそのエネルギーを使って動く。
options: 動物がエネルギーを使う
correct_answer: 動物がエネルギーを使う
accepted_answers: 動物がエネルギーを使う
hints: 何かが起こる前に、エネルギーは太陽から始まる。
ja.worked_example: 全体の流れを想像しよう。絶対に最初に起こることは何?

feedback.correct: 太陽、植物、動物が食べる、動物が動く - エネルギーの流れ全部を順番にできたね。☀️
feedback.incorrect: このエネルギーはすべて、最終的にどこから始まる?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 먼저 해의 에너지가 식물에 도달해요. 그다음 식물이 그것을 사용해서 먹이를 만들어요. 그다음 동물이 그 식물을 먹어요. 그다음 동물이 그 에너지를 사용해서 움직여요.
hints: 다른 무엇보다 먼저, 에너지는 해에서 시작해요.
ko.worked_example: 전체 과정을 떠올려 보세요. 가장 먼저 일어나야 하는 일은 무엇인가요?

feedback.correct: 해, 식물, 동물이 먹기, 동물이 움직이기 - 에너지의 전체 연결을 순서대로 맞혔어요. ☀️
feedback.incorrect: 이 모든 에너지는 결국 어디에서 시작되나요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Pertama energi dari matahari mencapai tumbuhan. Lalu tumbuhan menggunakannya untuk membuat makanan. Lalu hewan memakan tumbuhan itu. Lalu hewan menggunakan energi itu untuk bergerak.
hints: Energi dimulai dari matahari, sebelum hal lain terjadi.
id.worked_example: Bayangkan seluruh prosesnya. Apa yang pasti harus terjadi lebih dulu?

feedback.correct: Matahari, tumbuhan, hewan memakan, hewan bergerak - seluruh rantai energi, secara berurutan. ☀️
feedback.incorrect: Dari mana sebenarnya semua energi ini pertama kali dimulai?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe các bước. Sắp xếp theo đúng thứ tự.
vi.audio_text: Đầu tiên năng lượng từ mặt trời chiếu đến một cây. Sau đó cây dùng nó để tạo ra thức ăn. Sau đó một con vật ăn cây. Sau đó con vật dùng năng lượng đó để di chuyển.
hints: Năng lượng bắt đầu từ mặt trời, trước khi bất kỳ điều gì khác xảy ra.
vi.worked_example: Hãy hình dung toàn bộ quá trình. Điều gì chắc chắn phải xảy ra đầu tiên?

feedback.correct: Mặt trời, cây, con vật ăn, con vật di chuyển - toàn bộ chuỗi năng lượng, theo đúng thứ tự. ☀️
feedback.incorrect: Năng lượng này thật ra bắt đầu từ đâu?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen to the steps. Put them in order.
questions.audio_text: First water evaporates from the ocean. Then it forms clouds. Then it falls as rain over land. Then rivers carry it back to the ocean.
hints: Evaporation from the ocean is the very first step.
questions.worked_example: Picture the whole process. What absolutely has to happen first?

feedback.correct: Evaporate, cloud, rain, river - the whole water cycle, in order. 🌊
feedback.incorrect: Where does this whole cycle first begin?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: sequencing a spoken science process

life_skill.hidden_lesson: This cycle has been repeating, non-stop, for billions of years.

analysis.primary_construct: holding several spoken steps in mind and ordering them correctly
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Science processes (growth, life cycles, water cycle) are inherently sequential - this tests that structure directly.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Correct final state but wrong middle order shows the process's outcome, not its stages, is understood.
analysis.parent_note: Understanding that science happens in stages, not all at once, is a big conceptual step.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Talk through a familiar process (like making toast) in careful order together.

es.instruction: Escucha los pasos. Ponlos en orden.
es.audio_text: Primero el agua se evapora del océano. Luego forma nubes. Luego cae como lluvia sobre la tierra. Luego los ríos la llevan de vuelta al océano.
options: los ríos la llevan de vuelta
correct_answer: los ríos la llevan de vuelta
accepted_answers: los ríos la llevan de vuelta
hints: La evaporación del océano es el primer paso.
es.worked_example: Imagina todo el proceso. ¿Qué tiene que pasar primero sin duda?

feedback.correct: Evaporar, nube, lluvia, río - todo el ciclo del agua, en orden. 🌊
feedback.incorrect: ¿Dónde empieza en realidad todo este ciclo?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute les étapes. Mets-les dans l'ordre.
fr.audio_text: D'abord l'eau s'évapore de l'océan. Puis elle forme des nuages. Puis elle tombe en pluie sur la terre. Puis les rivières la ramènent à l'océan.
hints: L'évaporation depuis l'océan est la toute première étape.
fr.worked_example: Imagine tout le processus. Qu'est-ce qui doit absolument arriver en premier ?

feedback.correct: Évaporation, nuage, pluie, rivière - tout le cycle de l'eau, dans l'ordre. 🌊
feedback.incorrect: Où ce cycle commence-t-il vraiment ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute os passos. Coloque-os em ordem.
pt.audio_text: Primeiro a água evapora do oceano. Depois ela forma nuvens. Depois cai como chuva sobre a terra. Depois os rios a levam de volta ao oceano.
options: os rios a levarem de volta
correct_answer: os rios a levarem de volta
accepted_answers: os rios a levarem de volta
hints: A evaporação do oceano é o primeiro passo.
pt.worked_example: Imagine todo o processo. O que precisa acontecer primeiro, sem dúvida?

feedback.correct: Evaporar, nuvem, chuva, rio - todo o ciclo da água, em ordem. 🌊
feedback.incorrect: Onde todo esse ciclo realmente começa?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta i passaggi. Mettili in ordine.
it.audio_text: Prima l'acqua evapora dall'oceano. Poi forma le nuvole. Poi cade come pioggia sulla terra. Poi i fiumi la riportano all'oceano.
hints: L'evaporazione dall'oceano è il primissimo passaggio.
it.worked_example: Immagina tutto il processo. Cosa deve assolutamente accadere prima?

feedback.correct: Evaporazione, nuvola, pioggia, fiume - tutto il ciclo dell'acqua, in ordine. 🌊
feedback.incorrect: Dove inizia davvero tutto questo ciclo?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

de.instruction: Höre die Schritte. Bringe sie in die richtige Reihenfolge.
de.audio_text: Zuerst verdunstet Wasser aus dem Ozean. Dann bildet es Wolken. Dann fällt es als Regen über Land. Dann tragen Flüsse es zurück in den Ozean.
hints: Die Verdunstung aus dem Ozean ist der ganz erste Schritt.
de.worked_example: Stell dir den ganzen Vorgang vor. Was muss unbedingt zuerst passieren?

feedback.correct: Verdunsten, Wolken, Regen, Fluss – der ganze Wasserkreislauf, in der richtigen Reihenfolge. 🌊
feedback.incorrect: Wo beginnt dieser ganze Kreislauf zuerst?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar de stappen. Zet ze in de juiste volgorde.
nl.audio_text: Eerst verdampt water uit de oceaan. Dan vormt het wolken. Dan valt het als regen op het land. Dan brengen rivieren het terug naar de oceaan.
hints: Verdamping uit de oceaan is de allereerste stap.
nl.worked_example: Stel je het hele proces voor. Wat moet absoluut eerst gebeuren?

feedback.correct: Verdampen, wolk, regen, rivier - de hele waterkringloop, in volgorde. 🌊
feedback.incorrect: Waar begint deze hele kringloop voor het eerst?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Слушай шаги. Расставь их по порядку.
ru.audio_text: Сначала вода испаряется из океана. Потом она образует облака. Потом она выпадает дождём над землёй. Потом реки переносят её обратно в океан.
hints: Испарение из океана — это самый первый шаг.
ru.worked_example: Представь весь процесс. Что обязательно должно произойти первым?

feedback.correct: Испарение, облако, дождь, река — весь круговорот воды, по порядку. 🌊
feedback.incorrect: Где начинается весь этот цикл?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Önce su okyanustan buharlaşır. Sonra bulutları oluşturur. Sonra kara üzerine yağmur olarak düşer. Sonra nehirler onu tekrar okyanusa taşır.
hints: Okyanustan buharlaşma ilk adımdır.
tr.worked_example: Tüm süreci gözünde canlandır. İlk önce mutlaka ne olması gerekir?

feedback.correct: Buharlaşma, bulut, yağmur, nehir - tüm su döngüsü, sırasıyla. 🌊
feedback.incorrect: Bu tüm döngü ilk olarak nerede başlar?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 听步骤。把它们按顺序排列。
zh.audio_text: 先水从海洋蒸发。然后形成云。然后以雨的形式落在陆地上。然后河流把水带回海洋。
hints: 从海洋蒸发是这个循环的第一步。
zh.worked_example: 想象整个过程。什么是绝对必须最先发生的?

feedback.correct: 蒸发、形成云、下雨、河流——整个水循环,顺序正确。🌊
feedback.incorrect: 这整个循环最先是从哪里开始的?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 手順を聞こう。正しい順番に並べよう。
ja.audio_text: まず水が海から蒸発する。それから雲になる。それから陸の上に雨として降る。それから川がそれを海へ運び戻す。
hints: 海からの蒸発が、いちばん最初の段階だ。
ja.worked_example: 全体の流れを想像しよう。絶対に最初に起こることは何?

feedback.correct: 蒸発、雲、雨、川 - 水のサイクル全部を順番にできたね。🌊
feedback.incorrect: このサイクル全体は、最初どこから始まる?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 먼저 물이 바다에서 증발해요. 그다음 구름이 돼요. 그다음 육지 위에 비로 내려요. 그다음 강이 그것을 다시 바다로 데려가요.
hints: 바다에서의 증발이 가장 첫 단계예요.
ko.worked_example: 전체 과정을 떠올려 보세요. 가장 먼저 일어나야 하는 일은 무엇인가요?

feedback.correct: 증발, 구름, 비, 강 - 물의 순환 전체를 순서대로 맞혔어요. 🌊
feedback.incorrect: 이 전체 순환은 어디에서 처음 시작되나요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Pertama air menguap dari laut. Lalu ia membentuk awan. Lalu turun sebagai hujan di daratan. Lalu sungai membawanya kembali ke laut.
hints: Penguapan dari laut adalah langkah pertama.
id.worked_example: Bayangkan seluruh prosesnya. Apa yang pasti harus terjadi lebih dulu?

feedback.correct: Menguap, berawan, turun hujan, mengalir di sungai - seluruh siklus air, secara berurutan. 🌊
feedback.incorrect: Dari mana seluruh siklus ini pertama kali dimulai?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe các bước. Sắp xếp theo đúng thứ tự.
vi.audio_text: Đầu tiên nước bốc hơi từ đại dương. Sau đó nó tạo thành mây. Sau đó nó rơi xuống thành mưa trên đất liền. Sau đó sông đưa nó trở lại đại dương.
hints: Bốc hơi từ đại dương là bước đầu tiên.
vi.worked_example: Hãy hình dung toàn bộ quá trình. Điều gì chắc chắn phải xảy ra đầu tiên?

feedback.correct: Bốc hơi, mây, mưa, sông - toàn bộ vòng tuần hoàn nước, theo đúng thứ tự. 🌊
feedback.incorrect: Toàn bộ vòng tuần hoàn này thật ra bắt đầu từ đâu?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Listen to the steps. Put them in order.
questions.audio_text: First a scientist asks a question. Then they make a guess, called a hypothesis. Then they test it with an experiment. Then they look at the results.
hints: A question always comes before a guess about the answer.
questions.worked_example: Picture the whole process. What absolutely has to happen first?

feedback.correct: Question, hypothesis, test, results - real scientific method, in order. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: What does a scientist need before they can even make a guess?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: sequencing a spoken science process

life_skill.hidden_lesson: This exact order is how real scientists work through any new question.

analysis.primary_construct: holding several spoken steps in mind and ordering them correctly
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Science processes (growth, life cycles, water cycle) are inherently sequential - this tests that structure directly.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Correct final state but wrong middle order shows the process's outcome, not its stages, is understood.
analysis.parent_note: Understanding that science happens in stages, not all at once, is a big conceptual step.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Talk through a familiar process (like making toast) in careful order together.

es.instruction: Escucha los pasos. Ponlos en orden.
es.audio_text: Primero un científico hace una pregunta. Luego hace una suposición, llamada hipótesis. Luego la pone a prueba con un experimento. Luego observa los resultados.
options: la pone a prueba con un experimento
correct_answer: la pone a prueba con un experimento
accepted_answers: la pone a prueba con un experimento
hints: Una pregunta siempre viene antes de una suposición sobre la respuesta.
es.worked_example: Imagina todo el proceso. ¿Qué tiene que pasar primero sin duda?

feedback.correct: Pregunta, hipótesis, prueba, resultados - el método científico real, en orden. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: ¿Qué necesita un científico antes de poder hacer una suposición?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute les étapes. Mets-les dans l'ordre.
fr.audio_text: D'abord un scientifique pose une question. Puis il fait une supposition, appelée hypothèse. Puis il la teste avec une expérience. Puis il regarde les résultats.
hints: Une question vient toujours avant une supposition sur la réponse.
fr.worked_example: Imagine tout le processus. Qu'est-ce qui doit absolument arriver en premier ?

feedback.correct: Question, hypothèse, test, résultats - la vraie méthode scientifique, dans l'ordre. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: De quoi un scientifique a-t-il besoin avant de pouvoir même faire une supposition ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute os passos. Coloque-os em ordem.
pt.audio_text: Primeiro um cientista faz uma pergunta. Depois ele faz um palpite, chamado de hipótese. Depois ele testa isso com um experimento. Depois ele observa os resultados.
hints: Uma pergunta sempre vem antes de um palpite sobre a resposta.
pt.worked_example: Imagine todo o processo. O que precisa acontecer primeiro, sem dúvida?

feedback.correct: Pergunta, hipótese, teste, resultados - o método científico real, em ordem. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: O que um cientista precisa antes de poder fazer um palpite?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta i passaggi. Mettili in ordine.
it.audio_text: Prima uno scienziato si pone una domanda. Poi fa una supposizione, chiamata ipotesi. Poi la verifica con un esperimento. Poi osserva i risultati.
hints: Una domanda viene sempre prima di una supposizione sulla risposta.
it.worked_example: Immagina tutto il processo. Cosa deve assolutamente accadere prima?

feedback.correct: Domanda, ipotesi, esperimento, risultati - il vero metodo scientifico, in ordine. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Di cosa ha bisogno uno scienziato prima di poter anche solo fare una supposizione?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

de.instruction: Höre die Schritte. Bringe sie in die richtige Reihenfolge.
de.audio_text: Zuerst stellt eine Wissenschaftlerin oder ein Wissenschaftler eine Frage. Dann machen sie eine Vermutung, die Hypothese genannt wird. Dann testen sie diese mit einem Experiment. Dann schauen sie sich die Ergebnisse an.
hints: Eine Frage kommt immer vor einer Vermutung über die Antwort.
de.worked_example: Stell dir den ganzen Vorgang vor. Was muss unbedingt zuerst passieren?

feedback.correct: Frage, Hypothese, Test, Ergebnisse – die echte wissenschaftliche Methode, in der richtigen Reihenfolge. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Was braucht eine Wissenschaftlerin oder ein Wissenschaftler, bevor sie überhaupt eine Vermutung anstellen können?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar de stappen. Zet ze in de juiste volgorde.
nl.audio_text: Eerst stelt een wetenschapper een vraag. Dan maakt hij een gok, een hypothese genoemd. Dan test hij het met een experiment. Dan kijkt hij naar de resultaten.
hints: Een vraag komt altijd voor een gok over het antwoord.
nl.worked_example: Stel je het hele proces voor. Wat moet absoluut eerst gebeuren?

feedback.correct: Vraag, hypothese, test, resultaten - echte wetenschappelijke methode, in volgorde. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Wat heeft een wetenschapper nodig voordat hij zelfs een gok kan maken?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Слушай шаги. Расставь их по порядку.
ru.audio_text: Сначала учёный задаёт вопрос. Потом он делает предположение, которое называется гипотезой. Потом он проверяет её с помощью эксперимента. Потом он смотрит на результаты.
hints: Вопрос всегда предшествует предположению об ответе.
ru.worked_example: Представь весь процесс. Что обязательно должно произойти первым?

feedback.correct: Вопрос, гипотеза, проверка, результаты — настоящий научный метод, по порядку. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Что нужно учёному, прежде чем он сможет сделать предположение?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Önce bir bilim insanı bir soru sorar. Sonra hipotez denilen bir tahmin yapar. Sonra onu bir deneyle test eder. Sonra sonuçlara bakar.
hints: Soru her zaman cevap hakkındaki tahminden önce gelir.
tr.worked_example: Tüm süreci gözünde canlandır. İlk önce mutlaka ne olması gerekir?

feedback.correct: Soru, hipotez, test, sonuçlar - gerçek bilimsel yöntem, sırasıyla. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Bir bilim insanının bir tahmin yapmadan önce neye ihtiyacı vardır?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 听步骤。把它们按顺序排列。
zh.audio_text: 先科学家提出一个问题。然后他们做出一个猜测,叫做假设。然后他们用实验来检验它。然后他们查看结果。
hints: 问题总是在对答案的猜测之前出现。
zh.worked_example: 想象整个过程。什么是绝对必须最先发生的?

feedback.correct: 问题、假设、检验、结果——真正的科学方法,顺序正确。🔬
feedback.incorrect: 科学家在做出猜测之前,需要先有什么?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 手順を聞こう。正しい順番に並べよう。
ja.audio_text: まず科学者は質問をする。それから仮説と呼ばれる予想をする。それから実験で確かめる。それから結果を見る。
hints: 質問は、答えについての予想よりいつも先に来る。
ja.worked_example: 全体の流れを想像しよう。絶対に最初に起こることは何?

feedback.correct: 質問、仮説、実験、結果 - 本物の科学の方法を順番にできたね。🔬
feedback.incorrect: 科学者が予想をする前に、何が必要になる?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 먼저 과학자가 질문을 해요. 그다음 가설이라고 하는 추측을 해요. 그다음 실험으로 그것을 검증해요. 그다음 결과를 살펴봐요.
hints: 답에 대한 추측보다 질문이 항상 먼저예요.
ko.worked_example: 전체 과정을 떠올려 보세요. 가장 먼저 일어나야 하는 일은 무엇인가요?

feedback.correct: 질문, 가설, 검증, 결과 - 진짜 과학적 방법을 순서대로 맞혔어요. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: 과학자가 추측을 하기도 전에 무엇이 필요한가요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Pertama seorang ilmuwan mengajukan pertanyaan. Lalu mereka membuat tebakan, yang disebut hipotesis. Lalu mereka mengujinya dengan eksperimen. Lalu mereka melihat hasilnya.
hints: Pertanyaan selalu datang sebelum tebakan tentang jawabannya.
id.worked_example: Bayangkan seluruh prosesnya. Apa yang pasti harus terjadi lebih dulu?

feedback.correct: Pertanyaan, hipotesis, uji, hasil - metode ilmiah sesungguhnya, secara berurutan. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Apa yang dibutuhkan seorang ilmuwan sebelum mereka bisa membuat tebakan?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe các bước. Sắp xếp theo đúng thứ tự.
vi.audio_text: Đầu tiên nhà khoa học đặt một câu hỏi. Sau đó họ đưa ra một dự đoán, gọi là giả thuyết. Sau đó họ kiểm tra nó bằng một thí nghiệm. Sau đó họ xem xét kết quả.
hints: Câu hỏi luôn đến trước một dự đoán về câu trả lời.
vi.worked_example: Hãy hình dung toàn bộ quá trình. Điều gì chắc chắn phải xảy ra đầu tiên?

feedback.correct: Câu hỏi, giả thuyết, kiểm tra, kết quả - phương pháp khoa học thật sự, theo đúng thứ tự. 🔬
feedback.incorrect: Nhà khoa học cần gì trước khi họ có thể đưa ra một dự đoán?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.audio_text: Listen and tap every animal that can fly.

distractor_insight.🐶: cannot fly, correctly excluded if not selected
distractor_insight.🐟: cannot fly, correctly excluded if not selected

hints: Check every single animal, not just the first one that flies.
questions.worked_example: Check every single option against the rule before you finish.

feedback.correct: Butterfly, bee, and eagle - all three flying animals found. 🐦
feedback.incorrect: Check each animal one at a time: can it really fly?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: identifying multiple correct items from a spoken category

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Checking every option, not stopping at the first right one, avoids missing any.

analysis.primary_construct: holding a category rule in mind while checking several options against it
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Multi-select tasks are more demanding than single-answer ones - every option must be actively evaluated.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Selecting only the first plausible option instead of continuing to check every one shows the search wasn't exhaustive.
analysis.parent_note: Checking every option, not stopping at the first right one, is a habit that helps far beyond science.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Encourage saying 'and what else?' out loud until no more come to mind.

es.instruction: Escucha. Toca todos los que correspondan.
es.audio_text: Escucha y toca cada animal que puede volar.
hints: Revisa cada animal, no solo el primero que vuela.
es.worked_example: Revisa cada opción con la regla antes de terminar.

feedback.correct: Mariposa, abeja y águila - los tres animales que vuelan encontrados. 🐦
feedback.incorrect: Revisa cada animal uno por uno: ¿puede realmente volar?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute. Touche tout ce qui s'applique.
fr.audio_text: Écoute et touche chaque animal qui peut voler.
hints: Vérifie chaque animal, pas seulement le premier qui vole.
fr.worked_example: Vérifie chaque option par rapport à la règle avant de terminer.

feedback.correct: Papillon, abeille et aigle - les trois animaux volants trouvés. 🐦
feedback.incorrect: Vérifie chaque animal un par un : peut-il vraiment voler ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute. Toque em todos que se aplicam.
pt.audio_text: Escute e toque em todos os animais que conseguem voar.
hints: Verifique cada animal, não apenas o primeiro que voa.
pt.worked_example: Verifique cada opção em relação à regra antes de terminar.

feedback.correct: Borboleta, abelha e águia - os três animais voadores encontrados. 🐦
feedback.incorrect: Verifique cada animal, um por um: ele realmente consegue voar?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. Tocca tutte le opzioni corrette.
it.audio_text: Ascolta e tocca ogni animale che può volare.
hints: Controlla ogni singolo animale, non solo il primo che vola.
it.worked_example: Controlla ogni singola opzione rispetto alla regola prima di finire.

feedback.correct: Farfalla, ape e aquila - tutti e tre gli animali volanti trovati. 🐦
feedback.incorrect: Controlla ogni animale uno per uno: può davvero volare?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Tippe alles Zutreffende.
de.audio_text: Höre zu und tippe jedes Tier, das fliegen kann.
hints: Überprüfe jedes einzelne Tier, nicht nur das erste, das fliegt.
de.worked_example: Überprüfe jede einzelne Option gegen die Regel, bevor du fertig bist.

feedback.correct: Schmetterling, Biene und Adler – alle drei fliegenden Tiere gefunden. 🐦
feedback.incorrect: Überprüfe jedes Tier einzeln: Kann es wirklich fliegen?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Tik op alles wat van toepassing is.
nl.audio_text: Luister en tik op elk dier dat kan vliegen.
hints: Controleer elk dier afzonderlijk, niet alleen het eerste dat kan vliegen.
nl.worked_example: Controleer elke optie afzonderlijk aan de regel voordat je klaar bent.

feedback.correct: Vlinder, bij en arend - alle drie de vliegende dieren gevonden. 🐦
feedback.incorrect: Controleer elk dier een voor een: kan het echt vliegen?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Слушай. Нажми на все подходящие варианты.
ru.audio_text: Слушай и нажми на каждое животное, которое умеет летать.
hints: Проверь каждое животное, а не только первое, которое летает.
ru.worked_example: Проверь каждый вариант по правилу, прежде чем закончить.

feedback.correct: Бабочка, пчела и орёл - все три летающих животных найдены. 🐦
feedback.incorrect: Проверяй каждое животное по очереди: может ли оно на самом деле летать?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Dinle ve uçabilen her hayvana dokun.
hints: Her hayvanı kontrol et, sadece uçan ilk hayvanı değil.
tr.worked_example: Bitirmeden önce her seçeneği kurala göre kontrol et.

feedback.correct: Kelebek, arı ve kartal - uçabilen üç hayvanın hepsi bulundu. 🐦
feedback.incorrect: Her hayvanı tek tek kontrol et: gerçekten uçabiliyor mu?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 听。点一下所有符合的选项。
zh.audio_text: 听一听,点一下每一个会飞的动物。
hints: 检查每一个动物,不要只看第一个会飞的。
zh.worked_example: 完成之前,逐一检查每个选项是否符合规则。

feedback.correct: 蝴蝶、蜜蜂和鹰——找到了全部三个会飞的动物。🐦
feedback.incorrect: 逐一检查每个动物:它真的会飞吗?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。合うものをすべてタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: 聞いて、飛べる動物をすべてタップしよう。
hints: 最初に飛べると気づいた動物だけでなく、すべての動物を確認しよう。

feedback.correct: チョウ、ハチ、ワシ - 飛べる3つの動物をすべて見つけられたね。🐦
feedback.incorrect: 1つずつ動物を確認しよう:本当に飛べる?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 날 수 있는 동물을 모두 듣고 짚으세요.
hints: 처음 날 수 있는 동물만이 아니라 모든 동물을 하나씩 확인하세요.
ko.worked_example: 끝내기 전에 모든 선택지를 규칙에 맞는지 하나씩 확인하세요.

feedback.correct: 나비, 꿀벌, 독수리 - 날 수 있는 동물 세 가지를 모두 찾았어요. 🐦
feedback.incorrect: 동물을 하나씩 확인하세요: 정말로 날 수 있나요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Dengarkan dan ketuk setiap hewan yang bisa terbang.
hints: Periksa setiap hewan satu per satu, jangan hanya yang pertama bisa terbang.
id.worked_example: Periksa setiap pilihan satu per satu sesuai aturannya sebelum selesai.

feedback.correct: Kupu-kupu, lebah, dan elang - ketiga hewan terbang ditemukan. 🐦
feedback.incorrect: Periksa setiap hewan satu per satu: apakah ia benar-benar bisa terbang?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe. Chạm vào tất cả những gì đúng.
vi.audio_text: Nghe và chạm vào mọi con vật có thể bay.
hints: Hãy kiểm tra từng con vật, không chỉ con đầu tiên biết bay.
vi.worked_example: Hãy kiểm tra từng lựa chọn theo đúng quy tắc trước khi hoàn thành.

feedback.correct: Bướm, ong và chim ưng - tìm đúng cả ba con vật biết bay. 🐦
feedback.incorrect: Hãy kiểm tra từng con vật một: nó có thực sự bay được không?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.audio_text: Listen and tap every living thing.

distractor_insight.🪨: non-living, correctly excluded if not selected
distractor_insight.🚗: non-living, correctly excluded if not selected

feedback.incorrect: Check each one: does it grow, eat, and breathe?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Living things share the same basic needs, no matter how different they look.

analysis.primary_construct: holding a category rule in mind while checking several options against it
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Multi-select tasks are more demanding than single-answer ones - every option must be actively evaluated.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Selecting only the first plausible option instead of continuing to check every one shows the search wasn't exhaustive.
analysis.parent_note: Checking every option, not stopping at the first right one, is a habit that helps far beyond science.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Encourage saying 'and what else?' out loud until no more come to mind.

es.instruction: Escucha. Toca todos los que correspondan.
es.audio_text: Escucha y toca cada ser vivo.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa cada uno: ¿crece, come y respira?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute. Touche tout ce qui s'applique.

feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. Tocca tutte le opzioni corrette.

feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

tr.audio_text: Dinle ve her canlıya dokun.
hints: Her seçeneği kontrol et, sadece ilk canlıyı değil.

zh.instruction: 听。点一下所有符合的选项。
zh.audio_text: 听一听,点一下每一个有生命的东西。

hints: 最初に気づいた生き物だけでなく、すべての選択肢を確認しよう。

feedback.correct: イヌ、木、鳥 - 生き物の3つをすべて見つけられたね。🌳
feedback.incorrect: 1つずつ確認しよう:育って、食べて、呼吸する?

ko.worked_example: 끝내기 전에 모든 선택지를 규칙에 맞는지 하나씩 확인하세요.

feedback.correct: 강아지, 나무, 새 - 생물 세 가지를 모두 찾았어요. 🌳
feedback.incorrect: 하나씩 확인하세요: 자라고, 먹고, 숨을 쉬나요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Dengarkan dan ketuk setiap makhluk hidup.

feedback.incorrect: Periksa masing-masing: apakah ia tumbuh, makan, dan bernapas?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

feedback.correct: 太阳、蜡烛和灯泡——找到了全部三个真正的光源。💡
feedback.incorrect: 逐一检查每一个:它是自己发光,还是只是反射别人的光?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。合うものをすべてタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: 聞いて、光の源をすべてタップしよう。
hints: 月は光を反射するだけで、自分では光を作らない - よく考えないといけない難しい選択肢だ。
ja.worked_example: 終わる前に、すべての選択肢をルールと照らし合わせて確認しよう。

feedback.correct: 太陽、ろうそく、電球 - 本物の光の源3つをすべて見つけられたね。💡
feedback.incorrect: 1つずつ確認しよう:自分で光を作っている、それとも他のものの光を反射しているだけ?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 빛을 내는 것을 모두 듣고 짚으세요.
hints: 달은 빛을 반사하지만 스스로 빛을 만들지는 않아요 - 신중하게 생각해야 하는 까다로운 선택지예요.
ko.worked_example: 끝내기 전에 모든 선택지를 규칙에 맞는지 하나씩 확인하세요.

feedback.correct: 해, 촛불, 전구 - 실제 빛을 내는 것 세 가지를 모두 찾았어요. 💡
feedback.incorrect: 하나씩 확인하세요: 스스로 빛을 만드나요, 아니면 다른 것의 빛을 반사하기만 하나요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Dengarkan dan ketuk setiap sumber cahaya.
hints: Bulan memantulkan cahaya tapi tidak membuat cahayanya sendiri - ini yang perlu dipikirkan dengan cermat.
id.worked_example: Periksa setiap pilihan satu per satu sesuai aturannya sebelum selesai.

feedback.correct: Matahari, lilin, dan lampu bohlam - ketiga sumber cahaya sungguhan ditemukan. 💡
feedback.incorrect: Periksa masing-masing: apakah ia membuat cahayanya sendiri, atau hanya memantulkan cahaya orang lain?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe. Chạm vào tất cả những gì đúng.
vi.audio_text: Nghe và chạm vào mọi nguồn sáng.
hints: Mặt trăng phản chiếu ánh sáng nhưng không tự tạo ra ánh sáng - đây là một lựa chọn khó cần suy nghĩ kỹ.
vi.worked_example: Hãy kiểm tra từng lựa chọn theo đúng quy tắc trước khi hoàn thành.

feedback.correct: Mặt trời, nến và bóng đèn - tìm đúng cả ba nguồn sáng thật sự. 💡
feedback.incorrect: Hãy kiểm tra từng vật: nó tự tạo ra ánh sáng, hay chỉ phản chiếu ánh sáng từ vật khác?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.audio_text: Listen and tap every safe thing to do near a road.

distractor_insight.🏃: running near a road is unsafe, correctly excluded if not selected
distractor_insight.📱: a distraction near a road is unsafe, correctly excluded if not selected

hints: Check every single option carefully - some are genuinely unsafe.
questions.worked_example: Check every single option against the rule before you finish.

feedback.correct: Watching the lights, looking both ways, and stopping - all three safe actions found. 🚸
feedback.incorrect: Check each option: would a grown-up say this is safe near a road?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: identifying multiple correct items from a spoken category

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Running and using your phone near a road are both genuinely dangerous habits to avoid.

analysis.primary_construct: holding a category rule in mind while checking several options against it
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Multi-select tasks are more demanding than single-answer ones - every option must be actively evaluated.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Selecting only the first plausible option instead of continuing to check every one shows the search wasn't exhaustive.
analysis.parent_note: Checking every option, not stopping at the first right one, is a habit that helps far beyond science.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Encourage saying 'and what else?' out loud until no more come to mind.

es.instruction: Escucha. Toca todos los que correspondan.
es.audio_text: Escucha y toca cada cosa segura de hacer cerca de una calle.
hints: Revisa cada opción con cuidado - algunas son realmente inseguras.
es.worked_example: Revisa cada opción con la regla antes de terminar.

feedback.correct: Mirar el semáforo, mirar a ambos lados y detenerse - las tres acciones seguras encontradas. 🚸
feedback.incorrect: Revisa cada opción: ¿diría un adulto que esto es seguro cerca de una calle?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute. Touche tout ce qui s'applique.
fr.audio_text: Écoute et touche chaque chose sûre à faire près d'une route.
hints: Vérifie chaque option avec attention - certaines sont vraiment dangereuses.
fr.worked_example: Vérifie chaque option par rapport à la règle avant de terminer.

feedback.correct: Regarder les feux, regarder des deux côtés, et s'arrêter - les trois actions sûres trouvées. 🚸
feedback.incorrect: Vérifie chaque option : un adulte dirait-il que c'est sûr près d'une route ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute. Toque em todos que se aplicam.
pt.audio_text: Escute e toque em todas as coisas seguras para fazer perto de uma rua.
hints: Verifique cada opção com cuidado - algumas realmente não são seguras.
pt.worked_example: Verifique cada opção em relação à regra antes de terminar.

feedback.correct: Observar os sinais, olhar para os dois lados e parar - as três ações seguras encontradas. 🚸
feedback.incorrect: Verifique cada opção: um adulto diria que isso é seguro perto de uma rua?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. Tocca tutte le opzioni corrette.
it.audio_text: Ascolta e tocca ogni cosa sicura da fare vicino a una strada.
hints: Controlla ogni singola opzione con attenzione - alcune sono davvero pericolose.
it.worked_example: Controlla ogni singola opzione rispetto alla regola prima di finire.

feedback.correct: Guardare il semaforo, guardare in entrambe le direzioni e fermarsi - tutte e tre le azioni sicure trovate. 🚸
feedback.incorrect: Controlla ogni opzione: un adulto direbbe che è sicura vicino a una strada?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Tippe alles Zutreffende.
de.audio_text: Höre zu und tippe jede sichere Handlung in der Nähe einer Straße.
hints: Überprüfe jede einzelne Option sorgfältig – manche sind wirklich unsicher.
de.worked_example: Überprüfe jede einzelne Option gegen die Regel, bevor du fertig bist.

feedback.correct: Auf die Ampel achten, in beide Richtungen schauen und stehen bleiben – alle drei sicheren Handlungen gefunden. 🚸
feedback.incorrect: Überprüfe jede Option: Würde ein Erwachsener sagen, dass das in der Nähe einer Straße sicher ist?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Tik op alles wat van toepassing is.
nl.audio_text: Luister en tik op elk veilig ding om te doen bij de weg.
hints: Controleer elke optie goed - sommige zijn echt onveilig.
nl.worked_example: Controleer elke optie afzonderlijk aan de regel voordat je klaar bent.

feedback.correct: Op de lichten letten, beide kanten op kijken en stoppen - alle drie de veilige acties gevonden. 🚸
feedback.incorrect: Controleer elke optie: zou een volwassene zeggen dat dit veilig is bij de weg?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Слушай. Нажми на все подходящие варианты.
ru.audio_text: Слушай и нажми на каждое безопасное действие возле дороги.
hints: Проверь каждый вариант внимательно - некоторые по-настоящему опасны.
ru.worked_example: Проверь каждый вариант по правилу, прежде чем закончить.

feedback.correct: Смотреть на светофор, смотреть по сторонам и остановиться - все три безопасных действия найдены. 🚸
feedback.incorrect: Проверяй каждый вариант: сказал бы взрослый, что это безопасно возле дороги?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Dinle ve yol kenarında yapılacak her güvenli şeye dokun.
hints: Her seçeneği dikkatle kontrol et - bazıları gerçekten güvenli değil.
tr.worked_example: Bitirmeden önce her seçeneği kurala göre kontrol et.

feedback.correct: Işıklara bakmak, iki yöne de bakmak ve durmak - üç güvenli hareketin hepsi bulundu. 🚸
feedback.incorrect: Her seçeneği kontrol et: bir yetişkin bunun yol kenarında güvenli olduğunu söyler mi?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 听。点一下所有符合的选项。
zh.audio_text: 听一听,点一下每一个在马路附近安全的行为。
hints: 仔细检查每一个选项——有些确实不安全。
zh.worked_example: 完成之前,逐一检查每个选项是否符合规则。

feedback.correct: 看信号灯、左右看、停下来——找到了全部三个安全的行为。🚸
feedback.incorrect: 逐一检查每个选项:大人会说这在马路附近是安全的吗?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。合うものをすべてタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: 聞いて、道路の近くで安全なことをすべてタップしよう。
hints: すべての選択肢をよく確認しよう - いくつかは本当に危険だ。
ja.worked_example: 終わる前に、すべての選択肢をルールと照らし合わせて確認しよう。

feedback.correct: 信号を見ること、両方を確認すること、止まること - 安全な行動の3つをすべて見つけられたね。🚸
feedback.incorrect: 1つずつ確認しよう:おとなはこれを道路の近くで安全だと言う?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 도로 근처에서 안전한 행동을 모두 듣고 짚으세요.
hints: 모든 선택지를 신중하게 확인하세요 - 일부는 정말로 안전하지 않아요.
ko.worked_example: 끝내기 전에 모든 선택지를 규칙에 맞는지 하나씩 확인하세요.

feedback.correct: 신호등 보기, 양쪽 살피기, 멈추기 - 안전한 행동 세 가지를 모두 찾았어요. 🚸
feedback.incorrect: 선택지를 하나씩 확인하세요: 어른이라면 도로 근처에서 이것이 안전하다고 할까요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Dengarkan dan ketuk setiap hal yang aman dilakukan dekat jalan raya.
hints: Periksa setiap pilihan dengan cermat - beberapa benar-benar tidak aman.
id.worked_example: Periksa setiap pilihan satu per satu sesuai aturannya sebelum selesai.

feedback.correct: Memperhatikan lampu lalu lintas, melihat kedua arah, dan berhenti - ketiga tindakan aman ditemukan. 🚸
feedback.incorrect: Periksa setiap pilihan: apakah orang dewasa akan bilang ini aman dekat jalan raya?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe. Chạm vào tất cả những gì đúng.
vi.audio_text: Nghe và chạm vào mọi điều an toàn nên làm gần đường.
hints: Hãy kiểm tra kỹ từng lựa chọn - một số thực sự không an toàn.
vi.worked_example: Hãy kiểm tra từng lựa chọn theo đúng quy tắc trước khi hoàn thành.

feedback.correct: Quan sát đèn giao thông, nhìn hai bên và dừng lại - tìm đúng cả ba hành động an toàn. 🚸
feedback.incorrect: Hãy kiểm tra từng lựa chọn: người lớn có nói điều này an toàn gần đường không?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.audio_text: Listen and tap every part of a plant.

distractor_insight.🐛: an animal that might be found on a plant, but isn't part of it
distractor_insight.🦋: an animal that visits plants, but isn't part of them

hints: Check every single option - some are animals, not plant parts.
questions.worked_example: Check every single option against the rule before you finish.

feedback.correct: Flower, leaf, and stem/seedling - all three actual plant parts found. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Check each option: is it actually part of the plant, or a creature near it?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: identifying multiple correct items from a spoken category

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Insects visit plants often, but they're never actually part of the plant itself.

analysis.primary_construct: holding a category rule in mind while checking several options against it
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Multi-select tasks are more demanding than single-answer ones - every option must be actively evaluated.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Selecting only the first plausible option instead of continuing to check every one shows the search wasn't exhaustive.
analysis.parent_note: Checking every option, not stopping at the first right one, is a habit that helps far beyond science.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Encourage saying 'and what else?' out loud until no more come to mind.

es.instruction: Escucha. Toca todos los que correspondan.
es.audio_text: Escucha y toca cada parte de una planta.
hints: Revisa cada opción - algunas son animales, no partes de la planta.
es.worked_example: Revisa cada opción con la regla antes de terminar.

feedback.correct: Flor, hoja y tallo/plántula - las tres partes verdaderas de la planta encontradas. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Revisa cada opción: ¿es realmente parte de la planta, o una criatura cerca de ella?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute. Touche tout ce qui s'applique.
fr.audio_text: Écoute et touche chaque partie d'une plante.
hints: Vérifie chaque option - certaines sont des animaux, pas des parties de plante.
fr.worked_example: Vérifie chaque option par rapport à la règle avant de terminer.

feedback.correct: Fleur, feuille et tige/jeune pousse - les trois vraies parties de plante trouvées. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Vérifie chaque option : fait-elle vraiment partie de la plante, ou est-ce une créature à proximité ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute. Toque em todos que se aplicam.
pt.audio_text: Escute e toque em todas as partes de uma planta.
hints: Verifique cada opção - algumas são animais, não partes da planta.
pt.worked_example: Verifique cada opção em relação à regra antes de terminar.

feedback.correct: Flor, folha e caule/muda - as três partes reais da planta encontradas. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Verifique cada opção: é realmente parte da planta, ou uma criatura perto dela?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. Tocca tutte le opzioni corrette.
it.audio_text: Ascolta e tocca ogni parte di una pianta.
hints: Controlla ogni singola opzione - alcune sono animali, non parti di piante.
it.worked_example: Controlla ogni singola opzione rispetto alla regola prima di finire.

feedback.correct: Fiore, foglia e gambo/germoglio - tutte e tre le vere parti della pianta trovate. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Controlla ogni opzione: è davvero parte della pianta, o una creatura vicino ad essa?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Tippe alles Zutreffende.
de.audio_text: Höre zu und tippe jeden Teil einer Pflanze.
hints: Überprüfe jede einzelne Option – manche sind Tiere, keine Pflanzenteile.
de.worked_example: Überprüfe jede einzelne Option gegen die Regel, bevor du fertig bist.

feedback.correct: Blüte, Blatt und Stängel/Keimling – alle drei echten Pflanzenteile gefunden. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Überprüfe jede Option: Ist es tatsächlich Teil der Pflanze, oder ein Lebewesen in ihrer Nähe?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Tik op alles wat van toepassing is.
nl.audio_text: Luister en tik op elk deel van een plant.
hints: Controleer elke optie - sommige zijn dieren, geen plantendelen.
nl.worked_example: Controleer elke optie afzonderlijk aan de regel voordat je klaar bent.

feedback.correct: Bloem, blad en stengel/zaailing - alle drie de echte plantendelen gevonden. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Controleer elke optie: is het echt een deel van de plant, of een wezen ernaast?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Слушай. Нажми на все подходящие варианты.
ru.audio_text: Слушай и нажми на каждую часть растения.
hints: Проверь каждый вариант - некоторые из них животные, а не части растения.
ru.worked_example: Проверь каждый вариант по правилу, прежде чем закончить.

feedback.correct: Цветок, лист и росток - все три настоящих части растения найдены. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Проверяй каждый вариант: это действительно часть растения или существо рядом с ним?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Dinle ve bir bitkinin her bir parçasına dokun.
hints: Her seçeneği kontrol et - bazıları hayvan, bitki parçası değil.
tr.worked_example: Bitirmeden önce her seçeneği kurala göre kontrol et.

feedback.correct: Çiçek, yaprak ve gövde/fide - gerçek bitki parçalarının üçü de bulundu. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Her seçeneği kontrol et: gerçekten bitkinin bir parçası mı, yoksa yanındaki bir canlı mı?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 听。点一下所有符合的选项。
zh.audio_text: 听一听,点一下每一个植物的部位。
hints: 检查每一个选项——有些是动物,不是植物的部位。
zh.worked_example: 完成之前,逐一检查每个选项是否符合规则。

feedback.correct: 花、叶子和茎/幼苗——找到了全部三个真正的植物部位。🌱
feedback.incorrect: 逐一检查每个选项:它真的是植物的一部分,还是只是在植物附近的生物?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。合うものをすべてタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: 聞いて、植物の部分をすべてタップしよう。
hints: すべての選択肢を確認しよう - いくつかは植物の部分ではなく動物だ。
ja.worked_example: 終わる前に、すべての選択肢をルールと照らし合わせて確認しよう。

feedback.correct: 花、葉、茎(苗) - 植物の本当の部分3つをすべて見つけられたね。🌱
feedback.incorrect: 1つずつ確認しよう:本当に植物の部分、それとも近くにいる生き物?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 식물의 부분을 모두 듣고 짚으세요.
hints: 모든 선택지를 확인하세요 - 일부는 식물의 부분이 아니라 동물이에요.
ko.worked_example: 끝내기 전에 모든 선택지를 규칙에 맞는지 하나씩 확인하세요.

feedback.correct: 꽃, 잎, 줄기(새싹) - 식물의 부분 세 가지를 모두 찾았어요. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: 선택지를 하나씩 확인하세요: 실제로 식물의 부분인가요, 아니면 그 근처에 있는 생물인가요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Dengarkan dan ketuk setiap bagian tumbuhan.
hints: Periksa setiap pilihan - beberapa adalah hewan, bukan bagian tumbuhan.
id.worked_example: Periksa setiap pilihan satu per satu sesuai aturannya sebelum selesai.

feedback.correct: Bunga, daun, dan batang/bibit - ketiga bagian tumbuhan sungguhan ditemukan. 🌱
feedback.incorrect: Periksa setiap pilihan: apakah itu benar-benar bagian tumbuhan, atau makhluk di dekatnya?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe. Chạm vào tất cả những gì đúng.
vi.audio_text: Nghe và chạm vào mọi bộ phận của cây.
hints: Hãy kiểm tra từng lựa chọn - một số là con vật, không phải bộ phận của cây.
vi.worked_example: Hãy kiểm tra từng lựa chọn theo đúng quy tắc trước khi hoàn thành.

questions.subject: Science
questions.audio_text: If you leave ice in the sun, what happens?

distractor_insight.It disappears completely: overstated - it becomes water, not nothing

hints: What does warmth do to ice?

feedback.correct: It melts. Correctly predicted. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Think about what warmth does to something frozen.

academic.skill: predicting an effect from a stated cause

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Melting doesn't make something disappear - it just changes its state.

analysis.primary_construct: reasoning from a stated cause to its most likely effect
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Cause-and-effect reasoning is the seed of all later scientific prediction and experimentation.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Picking an effect from a completely different cause shows the specific link, not general science knowledge, is the gap.
analysis.parent_note: Cause and effect thinking helps a child predict outcomes safely, in science and in daily choices.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Narrate simple cause-and-effect moments out loud during the day: 'because it's raining, the ground will get...'

questions.subject: Science

academic.skill: predicting an effect from a stated cause

life_skill.primary: Understanding a large-scale cause and effect
life_skill.hidden_lesson: Our atmosphere quietly does an enormous amount of protective work, every second.

analysis.primary_construct: reasoning from a stated cause to its most likely effect
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Cause-and-effect reasoning is the seed of all later scientific prediction and experimentation.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Picking an effect from a completely different cause shows the specific link, not general science knowledge, is the gap.
analysis.parent_note: Cause and effect thinking helps a child predict outcomes safely, in science and in daily choices.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Narrate simple cause-and-effect moments out loud during the day: 'because it's raining, the ground will get...'

questions.subject: Science
questions.audio_text: A child predicted a toy boat would float, but it sank instead. What should they do?

questions.correct_answer: Accept what actually happened, even though it wasn't their guess
accepted_answers: Accept what actually happened, even though it wasn't their guess

distractor_insight.Insist the boat really floated anyway: denies real evidence in favour of a prior guess

hints: What should a scientist do when a result doesn't match their guess?

feedback.correct: Accept the real result. Trusting evidence over a guess is real scientific thinking. 🚤
feedback.incorrect: Think about what a good scientist does when their guess turns out wrong.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: reasoning about a simple experiment described aloud

analysis.primary_construct: following and reasoning about a described simple investigation

analysis.behaviour_watch: Answering based on what seems likely rather than what the described experiment actually showed suggests prior belief overriding evidence.
analysis.parent_note: Learning to trust what an experiment actually shows, even over a guess, is real scientific thinking.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Do a simple kitchen experiment together (sink or float, mix colours) and talk through what happened.

questions.subject: Science

questions.correct_answer: Not really - one plant alone isn't enough to be sure
accepted_answers: Not really - one plant alone isn't enough to be sure

distractor_insight.Yes, absolutely, without any doubt: overconfident conclusion from too little evidence
distractor_insight.No test is ever useful: an extreme overcorrection, dismissing all testing

hints: Could just one plant have grown taller for a completely different reason?
questions.worked_example: Focus on what the experiment actually showed, not what you'd expect.

feedback.correct: Not really - one plant alone isn't enough. A genuinely careful, advanced scientific judgement. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Think about whether one single result is really enough to be fully certain.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: reasoning about a simple experiment described aloud

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Testing many plants, not just one, is what makes a result truly trustworthy.

analysis.primary_construct: following and reasoning about a described simple investigation
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Introduces the idea of testing a question systematically, the core of scientific thinking.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Answering based on what seems likely rather than what the described experiment actually showed suggests prior belief overriding evidence.
analysis.parent_note: Learning to trust what an experiment actually shows, even over a guess, is real scientific thinking.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Do a simple kitchen experiment together (sink or float, mix colours) and talk through what happened.

feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 한 과학자가 새로운 식물 영양제를 식물 딱 한 개에만 시험했더니 더 크게 자랐습니다. 그것으로 식물 영양제가 효과가 있다는 충분한 증거가 될까요?
options: 아니요 - 식물 하나만으로는 확신하기에 충분하지 않다
네, 전혀 의심의 여지 없이 확실하다
ko.correct_answer: 아니요 - 식물 하나만으로는 확신하기에 충분하지 않다
accepted_answers: 아니요 - 식물 하나만으로는 확신하기에 충분하지 않다
hints: 식물 하나가 완전히 다른 이유로 더 크게 자랐을 수도 있지 않을까요?
ko.worked_example: 실험이 실제로 보여준 것에 집중하세요. 예상한 것이 아니라요.

feedback.correct: 아니요 - 식물 하나만으로는 충분하지 않다. 진짜 신중하고 수준 높은 과학적 판단이에요. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: 단 하나의 결과만으로 완전히 확신할 수 있을지 생각해보세요.
feedback.second_try: 함께 해볼까요 - 어떻게 하는지 지켜보세요.

id.audio_text: Seorang ilmuwan menguji pupuk tumbuhan baru hanya pada satu tanaman dan tanaman itu tumbuh lebih tinggi. Apakah itu bukti yang cukup bahwa pupuk itu berhasil?
options: Tidak juga - satu tanaman saja tidak cukup untuk benar-benar yakin
Ya, pasti, tanpa keraguan sama sekali
Tidak ada tes yang pernah berguna
id.correct_answer: Tidak juga - satu tanaman saja tidak cukup untuk benar-benar yakin
accepted_answers: Tidak juga - satu tanaman saja tidak cukup untuk benar-benar yakin
hints: Bisakah hanya satu tanaman tumbuh lebih tinggi karena alasan yang sama sekali berbeda?
id.worked_example: Fokus pada apa yang sebenarnya ditunjukkan eksperimen itu, bukan apa yang kamu harapkan.

feedback.correct: Tidak juga - satu tanaman saja tidak cukup. Penilaian ilmiah yang benar-benar cermat dan tingkat lanjut. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan apakah satu hasil tunggal benar-benar cukup untuk sepenuhnya yakin.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.audio_text: Một nhà khoa học thử nghiệm một loại phân bón mới trên chỉ một cây, và cây đó lớn cao hơn. Đó có đủ chứng cứ để nói phân bón này có hiệu quả không?
options: Không hẳn - chỉ một cây là chưa đủ để chắc chắn
Có, hoàn toàn chắc chắn, không nghi ngờ gì
Không thí nghiệm nào có ích cả
vi.correct_answer: Không hẳn - chỉ một cây là chưa đủ để chắc chắn
accepted_answers: Không hẳn - chỉ một cây là chưa đủ để chắc chắn
hints: Liệu chỉ một cây có thể lớn cao hơn vì một lý do hoàn toàn khác không?
vi.worked_example: Hãy tập trung vào điều thí nghiệm thực sự cho thấy, không phải điều bạn mong đợi.

feedback.correct: Không hẳn - chỉ một cây là chưa đủ. Một đánh giá khoa học thực sự cẩn thận, nâng cao. 🌿
feedback.incorrect: Hãy nghĩ xem một kết quả duy nhất có thực sự đủ để hoàn toàn chắc chắn không.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.audio_text: A scientist wants to test if a new medicine works, so some patients get the real medicine and others get a fake pill that looks identical, without knowing which they got. Why might they do that?
options: So people's expectations don't affect the result, making the test fairer
Because fake pills are cheaper to make
Because it's more fun for the patients
questions.correct_answer: So people's expectations don't affect the result, making the test fairer
accepted_answers: So people's expectations don't affect the result, making the test fairer
hints: What might happen to people's results if they knew which pill they had?
questions.worked_example: Focus on what the experiment actually showed, not what you'd expect.

feedback.correct: So expectations don't affect the result. Genuinely advanced scientific reasoning, correctly worked out. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Think about how knowing which pill you got might change how you feel or report feeling.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: reasoning about a simple experiment described aloud

life_skill.primary: Understanding fair testing at an advanced level
life_skill.hidden_lesson: This kind of fair test is used by real medical scientists to make sure results are trustworthy.

analysis.primary_construct: following and reasoning about a described simple investigation
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Introduces the idea of testing a question systematically, the core of scientific thinking.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Answering based on what seems likely rather than what the described experiment actually showed suggests prior belief overriding evidence.
analysis.parent_note: Learning to trust what an experiment actually shows, even over a guess, is real scientific thinking.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Do a simple kitchen experiment together (sink or float, mix colours) and talk through what happened.

es.instruction: Escucha. Toca la respuesta.
es.audio_text: Un científico quiere probar si una nueva medicina funciona, así que algunos pacientes reciben la medicina real y otros reciben una pastilla falsa idéntica en apariencia, sin saber cuál recibieron. ¿Por qué podrían hacer eso?
options: Para que las expectativas de las personas no afecten el resultado, haciendo la prueba más justa
Porque las pastillas falsas son más baratas de hacer
Porque es más divertido para los pacientes
es.correct_answer: Para que las expectativas de las personas no afecten el resultado, haciendo la prueba más justa
accepted_answers: Para que las expectativas de las personas no afecten el resultado, haciendo la prueba más justa
hints: ¿Qué podría pasarle a los resultados de las personas si supieran qué pastilla recibieron?
es.worked_example: Concéntrate en lo que el experimento realmente mostró, no en lo que esperarías.

feedback.correct: Para que las expectativas no afecten el resultado. Un razonamiento científico realmente avanzado, resuelto correctamente. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en cómo saber qué pastilla recibiste podría cambiar cómo te sientes o cómo dices sentirte.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute. Touche la réponse.
fr.audio_text: Un scientifique veut tester si un nouveau médicament fonctionne, alors certains patients reçoivent le vrai médicament et d'autres reçoivent une pilule factice identique en apparence, sans savoir laquelle ils ont reçue. Pourquoi feraient-ils cela ?
options: Pour que les attentes des gens n'affectent pas le résultat, rendant le test plus juste
Parce que les fausses pilules sont moins chères à fabriquer
Parce que c'est plus amusant pour les patients
fr.correct_answer: Pour que les attentes des gens n'affectent pas le résultat, rendant le test plus juste
accepted_answers: Pour que les attentes des gens n'affectent pas le résultat, rendant le test plus juste
hints: Qu'est-ce qui pourrait arriver aux résultats des gens s'ils savaient quelle pilule ils ont reçue ?
fr.worked_example: Concentre-toi sur ce que l'expérience a réellement montré, pas sur ce que tu attendais.

feedback.correct: Pour que les attentes n'affectent pas le résultat. Un raisonnement scientifique vraiment avancé, correctement résolu. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Réfléchis à comment savoir quelle pilule on a reçue pourrait changer ce qu'on ressent ou ce qu'on rapporte ressentir.
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Escute. Toque na resposta.
pt.audio_text: Um cientista quer testar se um novo remédio funciona, então alguns pacientes recebem o remédio real e outros recebem uma pílula falsa idêntica, sem saber qual receberam. Por que ele faria isso?
options: Para que as expectativas das pessoas não afetem o resultado, tornando o teste mais justo
Porque pílulas falsas são mais baratas de fazer
Porque é mais divertido para os pacientes
pt.correct_answer: Para que as expectativas das pessoas não afetem o resultado, tornando o teste mais justo
accepted_answers: Para que as expectativas das pessoas não afetem o resultado, tornando o teste mais justo
hints: O que poderia acontecer com os resultados das pessoas se elas soubessem qual pílula tomaram?
pt.worked_example: Concentre-se no que o experimento realmente mostrou, não no que você esperaria.

feedback.correct: Para que as expectativas não afetem o resultado. Raciocínio científico verdadeiramente avançado, resolvido corretamente. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Pense em como saber qual pílula você tomou poderia mudar como você se sente ou relata se sentir.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. Tocca la risposta.
it.audio_text: Uno scienziato vuole testare se una nuova medicina funziona, quindi alcuni pazienti ricevono la vera medicina e altri ricevono una pillola finta identica all'aspetto, senza sapere quale hanno ricevuto. Perché potrebbero fare così?
options: Così le aspettative delle persone non influenzano il risultato, rendendo il test più corretto
Perché le pillole finte sono più economiche da produrre
Perché è più divertente per i pazienti
it.correct_answer: Così le aspettative delle persone non influenzano il risultato, rendendo il test più corretto
accepted_answers: Così le aspettative delle persone non influenzano il risultato, rendendo il test più corretto
hints: Cosa potrebbe succedere ai risultati delle persone se sapessero quale pillola hanno preso?
it.worked_example: Concentrati su cosa ha effettivamente mostrato l'esperimento, non su cosa ti aspetteresti.

feedback.correct: Così le aspettative non influenzano il risultato. Ragionamento scientifico davvero avanzato, risolto correttamente. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a come il sapere quale pillola hai preso potrebbe cambiare come ti senti o come riferisci di sentirti.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questa insieme - guarda come funziona.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Tippe die Antwort an.
de.audio_text: Eine Wissenschaftlerin möchte testen, ob ein neues Medikament wirkt. Deshalb erhalten manche Patienten das echte Medikament und andere eine identisch aussehende Scheinpille, ohne zu wissen, welche sie bekommen haben. Warum könnte sie das tun?
options: Damit die Erwartungen der Menschen das Ergebnis nicht beeinflussen und der Test fairer wird
Weil es den Patienten mehr Spaß macht
de.correct_answer: Damit die Erwartungen der Menschen das Ergebnis nicht beeinflussen und der Test fairer wird
accepted_answers: Damit die Erwartungen der Menschen das Ergebnis nicht beeinflussen und der Test fairer wird
hints: Was könnte mit den Ergebnissen der Menschen passieren, wenn sie wüssten, welche Pille sie bekommen haben?
de.worked_example: Konzentriere dich darauf, was das Experiment tatsächlich gezeigt hat, nicht darauf, was du erwarten würdest.

feedback.correct: Damit Erwartungen das Ergebnis nicht beeinflussen. Wirklich fortgeschrittenes wissenschaftliches Denken, richtig durchdacht. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Denk darüber nach, wie das Wissen, welche Pille man bekommen hat, verändern könnte, wie man sich fühlt oder sein Befinden beschreibt.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Tik op het antwoord.
nl.audio_text: Een wetenschapper wil testen of een nieuw medicijn werkt, dus sommige patiënten krijgen het echte medicijn en anderen krijgen een identiek uitziende nepolie, zonder te weten welke ze kregen. Waarom zouden ze dat doen?
options: Zodat verwachtingen van mensen het resultaat niet beïnvloeden, wat de test eerlijker maakt
Omdat nepolie goedkoper is om te maken
Omdat het leuker is voor de patiënten
nl.correct_answer: Zodat verwachtingen van mensen het resultaat niet beïnvloeden, wat de test eerlijker maakt
accepted_answers: Zodat verwachtingen van mensen het resultaat niet beïnvloeden, wat de test eerlijker maakt
hints: Wat zou er met de resultaten van mensen kunnen gebeuren als ze wisten welke pil ze hadden?
nl.worked_example: Focus op wat het experiment echt liet zien, niet op wat je zou verwachten.

feedback.correct: Zodat verwachtingen het resultaat niet beïnvloeden. Echt geavanceerde wetenschappelijke redenering, goed uitgewerkt. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan hoe weten welke pil je kreeg je gevoel of rapportage zou kunnen veranderen.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: Учёный хочет проверить, работает ли новое лекарство, поэтому некоторые пациенты получают настоящее лекарство, а другие - фальшивую таблетку, которая выглядит точно так же, не зная, что именно они получили. Почему они могли бы так сделать?
options: Чтобы ожидания людей не влияли на результат, делая тест более справедливым
Потому что фальшивые таблетки дешевле делать
Потому что это веселее для пациентов
ru.correct_answer: Чтобы ожидания людей не влияли на результат, делая тест более справедливым
accepted_answers: Чтобы ожидания людей не влияли на результат, делая тест более справедливым
hints: Что могло бы случиться с результатами людей, если бы они знали, какую таблетку получили?
ru.worked_example: Сосредоточься на том, что эксперимент на самом деле показал, а не на том, чего ты ожидал.

feedback.correct: Чтобы ожидания не влияли на результат. По-настоящему продвинутое научное рассуждение, правильно выведено. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Подумай, как знание того, какую таблетку ты получил, могло бы изменить то, что ты чувствуешь или о чём сообщаешь.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Bir bilim insanı yeni bir ilacın işe yarayıp yaramadığını test etmek istiyor, bu yüzden bazı hastalara gerçek ilaç, bazılarına ise aynı görünen sahte bir hap veriliyor ve hangisini aldıklarını bilmiyorlar. Bunu neden yapmış olabilir?
options: İnsanların beklentilerinin sonucu etkilememesi için, böylece test daha adil olur
Çünkü sahte haplar yapmak daha ucuzdur
tr.correct_answer: İnsanların beklentilerinin sonucu etkilememesi için, böylece test daha adil olur
accepted_answers: İnsanların beklentilerinin sonucu etkilememesi için, böylece test daha adil olur
hints: İnsanlar hangi hapı aldıklarını bilselerdi sonuçlarına ne olabilirdi?
tr.worked_example: Deneyin gerçekte ne gösterdiğine odaklan, beklediğine değil.

feedback.correct: Böylece beklentiler sonucu etkilemez. Gerçekten ileri düzey bilimsel akıl yürütme, doğru şekilde çözüldü. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Hangi hapı aldığını bilmenin, nasıl hissettiğini veya hissettiğini bildirmeni nasıl değiştirebileceğini düşün.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.audio_text: 一位科学家想测试一种新药是否有效,于是让一些病人吃真药,另一些病人吃外观完全一样的假药,而且谁也不知道自己吃的是哪一种。他们为什么要这样做?
options: 这样人们的预期就不会影响结果,使测试更公平
因为这样对病人来说更有趣
zh.correct_answer: 这样人们的预期就不会影响结果,使测试更公平
accepted_answers: 这样人们的预期就不会影响结果,使测试更公平
hints: 如果人们知道自己吃的是哪种药,他们的结果会受到什么影响?
zh.worked_example: 关注实验实际显示了什么,而不是你预期的结果。

feedback.correct: 这样预期就不会影响结果。真正高阶的科学推理,正确得出结论。💊
feedback.incorrect: 想一想知道自己吃的是哪种药,会怎样改变一个人的感受或他们的描述。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。答えをタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: 科学者が新しい薬が効くか調べたいので、一部の患者には本物の薬を、他の患者には見た目が同じ偽の薬を与え、どちらをもらったか患者には分からないようにした。なぜそうするのだろう?
options: 患者の期待が結果に影響しないようにして、実験をより公平にするため
偽の薬を作る方が安いから
患者にとってより楽しいから
ja.correct_answer: 患者の期待が結果に影響しないようにして、実験をより公平にするため
accepted_answers: 患者の期待が結果に影響しないようにして、実験をより公平にするため
hints: どちらの薬をもらったか分かっていたら、人々の結果はどうなるかもしれない?
ja.worked_example: 予想ではなく、実験が実際に示したことに注目しよう。

feedback.correct: 期待が結果に影響しないようにするため。本当に高度な科学的推論を正しく導けたね。💊
feedback.incorrect: どちらの薬をもらったか分かることで、感じ方や伝え方がどう変わるか考えよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 한 과학자가 새로운 약이 효과가 있는지 시험하려고, 일부 환자에게는 실제 약을, 다른 환자에게는 겉보기에 똑같은 가짜 약을 주되, 어느 쪽을 받았는지 모르게 합니다. 왜 그렇게 할까요?
options: 사람들의 기대가 결과에 영향을 주지 않게 해서 시험을 더 공정하게 만들려고
가짜 약이 만들기 더 싸기 때문에
ko.correct_answer: 사람들의 기대가 결과에 영향을 주지 않게 해서 시험을 더 공정하게 만들려고
accepted_answers: 사람들의 기대가 결과에 영향을 주지 않게 해서 시험을 더 공정하게 만들려고
hints: 어느 약을 받았는지 안다면 사람들의 결과에 무슨 일이 일어날 수 있을까요?
ko.worked_example: 실험이 실제로 보여준 것에 집중하세요. 예상한 것이 아니라요.

feedback.correct: 기대가 결과에 영향을 주지 않도록 하기. 진짜 수준 높은 과학적 추론으로, 정확하게 생각해냈어요. 💊
feedback.incorrect: 어느 약을 받았는지 아는 것이 느끼는 방식이나 보고하는 방식을 어떻게 바꿀 수 있는지 생각해보세요.
feedback.second_try: 함께 해볼까요 - 어떻게 하는지 지켜보세요.

id.audio_text: Seorang ilmuwan ingin menguji apakah obat baru bekerja, jadi beberapa pasien mendapat obat sungguhan dan yang lain mendapat pil palsu yang terlihat identik, tanpa tahu mana yang mereka dapatkan. Mengapa mereka mungkin melakukan itu?
options: Agar harapan orang tidak memengaruhi hasilnya, membuat tes lebih adil
Karena pil palsu lebih murah dibuat
id.correct_answer: Agar harapan orang tidak memengaruhi hasilnya, membuat tes lebih adil
accepted_answers: Agar harapan orang tidak memengaruhi hasilnya, membuat tes lebih adil
hints: Apa yang mungkin terjadi pada hasil seseorang jika mereka tahu pil mana yang mereka dapat?
id.worked_example: Fokus pada apa yang sebenarnya ditunjukkan eksperimen itu, bukan apa yang kamu harapkan.

feedback.correct: Agar harapan tidak memengaruhi hasilnya. Penalaran ilmiah yang benar-benar tingkat lanjut, dipecahkan dengan benar. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan bagaimana mengetahui pil mana yang kamu dapat bisa mengubah perasaanmu atau laporanmu.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.audio_text: Một nhà khoa học muốn kiểm tra xem một loại thuốc mới có hiệu quả không, nên một số bệnh nhân được dùng thuốc thật và những người khác dùng viên giả giống hệt, mà không biết mình dùng loại nào. Tại sao họ có thể làm vậy?
options: Để kỳ vọng của mọi người không ảnh hưởng đến kết quả, giúp thử nghiệm công bằng hơn
Vì viên giả rẻ hơn để làm
Vì việc đó vui hơn cho bệnh nhân
vi.correct_answer: Để kỳ vọng của mọi người không ảnh hưởng đến kết quả, giúp thử nghiệm công bằng hơn
accepted_answers: Để kỳ vọng của mọi người không ảnh hưởng đến kết quả, giúp thử nghiệm công bằng hơn

analysis.primary_construct: holding three spoken items in mind and identifying which breaks a shared pattern

academic.skill: classifying by identifying an exception

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Grouping by 'where you'd find it' is a genuinely useful science skill.

analysis.primary_construct: holding three spoken items in mind and identifying which breaks a shared pattern
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Odd-one-out is a demanding classification task - the rule must be inferred, not just applied.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Picking an item at random rather than reasoning about the shared category shows the classification itself wasn't attempted.
analysis.parent_note: Working out the hidden rule connecting two things is real scientific classification, done as a game.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Play odd-one-out with real objects around the house, asking 'what's the rule?' afterward.

analysis.primary_construct: holding three spoken items in mind and identifying which breaks a shared pattern
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Odd-one-out is a demanding classification task - the rule must be inferred, not just applied.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Picking an item at random rather than reasoning about the shared category shows the classification itself wasn't attempted.
analysis.parent_note: Working out the hidden rule connecting two things is real scientific classification, done as a game.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Play odd-one-out with real objects around the house, asking 'what's the rule?' afterward.

es.instruction: Escucha tres cosas. Toca la que no corresponde.
es.audio_text: tomate, pepino, manzana
hints: Dos de estos son en realidad frutas según la ciencia, aunque se usan como verduras al cocinar.
es.worked_example: ¿Qué tienen en común dos de los tres? El otro es la respuesta.

feedback.correct: Manzana. El tomate y el pepino técnicamente también son frutas (tienen semillas), pero esta agrupación los une por su uso en la cocina, así que la manzana es la verdadera fruta de postre que no corresponde.
feedback.incorrect: Esta es realmente difícil - piensa en las semillas y en cómo crece cada uno, no solo en cómo se usa en una comida.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute trois choses. Touche celle qui ne va pas avec les autres.

fr.worked_example: Qu'est-ce que deux des trois ont en commun ? L'autre est la réponse.

feedback.correct: Pomme. Tomate et concombre sont techniquement des fruits aussi (ils ont des graines), mais cette association les regroupe selon leur usage en cuisine, donc la pomme est le vrai fruit-dessert différent des autres.
feedback.incorrect: Celui-ci est vraiment un piège - réfléchis aux graines et à la façon dont chacun est cultivé, pas seulement à son usage dans un repas.
feedback.second_try: Faisons celui-ci ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

feedback.correct: Maçã. Tomate e pepino também são tecnicamente frutas (eles têm semente), mas esse agrupamento os junta pelo uso culinário, então a maçã é a verdadeira fruta de sobremesa que não combina.
feedback.incorrect: Esta é realmente complicada - pense nas sementes e em como cada uma é cultivada, não apenas em como é usada em uma refeição.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.worked_example: Cosa hanno in comune due delle tre? L'altra è la risposta.

feedback.correct: Mela. Anche pomodoro e cetriolo sono tecnicamente frutti (hanno semi), ma qui vengono raggruppati per il loro uso in cucina, quindi la mela è l'unico vero frutto da dessert, diverso dagli altri.
